title: Associate, Capital Markets
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Associate, Capital Markets

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring an Associate to join our capital markets team.

You will support the capital markets function responsible for raising, monitoring and refinancing the debt required to build out Radiant’s AI infrastructure platform. Working closely with senior members of the capital markets, investment and executive leadership teams, you will build financial models, prepare lender materials, help evaluate commercial term sheets, coordinate execution and contribute to the development of the group’s financing strategy. You will interact with teams across the business, from procurement and construction to power and operations, to ensure financings are aligned with GPU delivery schedules and capex requirements.

You will operate at the intersection of power, compute, capital and software — gaining exposure to complex financings while helping deploy significant capital into infrastructure assets that will underpin the next era of the AI economy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support all financing activities for new GPU clusters and AI factories, including project financings, GPU / equipment-backed financings, and corporate facilities.

  • Track broad bank / debt capital markets conditions and market developments relevant to our business.

  • Build and maintain financial models covering debt sizing, cash flow waterfalls, covenant and ratio analysis, sensitivities and downside cases.

  • Analyse offtake arrangements and associated credit support to assess bankability and inform financing structure.

  • Draft lender information memoranda, credit rating agency materials and financing recommendations for senior management.

  • Review and comment on financing documentation (e.g. credit agreements, intercreditor arrangements, and security packages).

  • Coordinate transaction execution, including data rooms, due diligence requests, closing checklists and conditions precedent, through to financial close.

  • Support the platform’s preparation for debt capital markets issuance to term out bank and project financings, including analysis of market comparables, pricing and investor appetite.

  • Contribute to financing strategy discussions and the growth of Radiant’s capital markets capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • 4–6 years of credit experience gained in project finance, acquisition finance, debt capital markets, private credit or infrastructure lending, with a working knowledge of debt structuring and credit documentation.

  • Advanced financial modelling skills, including the ability to build and audit project finance and corporate debt models.

  • Strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience drafting lender presentations, information memoranda and credit papers.

  • Ability to read and interpret commercial contracts, including customer, supply and financing agreements, and identify financing implications.

  • Experience working with guidance and increasing independence in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, managing multiple workstreams and delivering high-quality work under tight timelines.

  • High levels of ownership, accountability and attention to detail together with commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for AI infrastructure.

Desirable:

  • Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, power, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure or hyperscaler ecosystems and their financing considerations.

  • Exposure to interest rate, FX, power or commodity hedging.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Produce robust credit analysis, financial models and lender materials that support sound decisions and execution.

  • Help execute financings efficiently from term sheet through closing and post-close, across multiple deployments.

  • Grow into greater responsibility for structuring, negotiation and financing strategy while contributing to a diversified funding base and lower cost of capital.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

title: Associate Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

The focus of Marketing is to support Sotheby's Luxury departments in promoting their auctions and retail. Marketing will crucially reinforce Sotheby's place in the broader art and luxury market ecosystem via partnerships, collaborations, and events.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager in Europe, the Associate Marketing Manager is responsible for creating and implementing marketing strategies for categories within the Luxury division, aligned with company goals. This includes supporting auctions across the UK, Europe, and Paris. They are a key point of contact for specialist departments in London, Paris, and Geneva, including the Salon, in developing that narrative across all consumer touchpoints.

This role should utilize all of Sotheby's available channels: print, website, content, digital marketing, and events, and work on cross-functional teams to coordinate the execution of marketing campaigns. Key partners will include the Specialist Departments, Press, and Operations, as well as other Marketing functions such as Creative, Special Events, Content and Growth.

An unwavering attention to detail, rigor in execution, and a proven ability to think creatively, strategically, and analytically about marketing campaigns are fundamental to the success of this role.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and execute 360° multi-platform marketing campaigns for online sales across various Luxury categories including sports memorabilia, jewellery, watches, wine, spirits, and others to increase awareness, reinforce positioning, drive new client acquisition, and further engage the existing client base.
  • Brief our Creative Studio on marketing elements requiring design and storytelling, such as advertising, collateral, content, and exhibition assets.
  • Track budget for marketing campaigns to support assigned auctions and sales.
  • Track and update marketing activity calendar, project timelines, media plans, and email/communication schedule.
  • Oversee and work collaboratively with colleagues in Press, Proposals, Creative, Special Events, Content and Growth in the planning, local execution, and strategic promotion of marketing campaigns from start to finish. To include live/virtual events, exhibitions, collateral, and digital marketing, following global guidelines and program parameters. Ensure deadlines are met, and budgets are adhered to.
  • Create and maintain ongoing competitive analysis, identifying key trends in luxury industry programming, including the execution of auctions, events, and exhibitions.
  • Provide ad hoc project support as needed.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor's degree is required
  • 2-3+ years of work experience in a marketing agency and/or an in-house marketing department
  • Background in the luxury goods industry is strongly preferred
  • Experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns
  • A solid understanding of KPIs and campaign performance metrics across online marketing channels
  • A balance of strategic and creative thinking with strong analytical skills
  • An unwavering attention to detail and uncompromising excellent standards, willing to constantly strive for improvement
  • Excellent verbal, written communication, and presentation skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills
  • Solutions-oriented with strong process and project management skills
  • Ability to collaborate in a team environment as well as work independently
  • Able to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environments working on a number of different and varied projects at one time to tight deadlines
  • Highly motivated, organized, proactive, creative, enthusiastic, and resourceful
  • Proficient use of Outlook, Word, PowerPoint presentation development, Excel, and web analytics
  • Fluent English and French, ideally with knowledge of other European languages

title: Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions multilingues à venir selon nos développements à l’étranger.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Un première entretien avec notre Simon, Senior Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Une étude de cas à préparer en amont avec Nathan et Vincent, Associate Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un échange avec une partie de l'équipe de Specialists Support FST (30 min)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

  

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Auditor/in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001 (Berlin, Hamburg, Schleswig-Holstein) als Freelancer
descriptionHtml:
Über unser Institut:

DIQZ | Deutsches Institut für Qualität & Zertifizierung hat sich auf Zertifizierung, Beratung und Fort- und Weiterbildung spezialisiert. Das Institut hat sich als Ziel gesetzt das Thema Zertifizierung insbesondere für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen attraktiv zu gestalten, um den Qualitätsgedanken in Deutschland weiter auszubauen. Im diesem Sinne beraten und unterstützen wir unsere Mandanten ganzheitlich, um die Prozesse und die Kundenorientierung nachhaltig und spürbar zu verbessern.

Aufgaben

  • Als Auditor bei DIQZ vertreten Sie unser Institut bei den Kunden in Norddeutschland
  • Sie erstellen Auditpläne unter Berücksichtigung der Akkreditierungsvorgaben sowie internen Verfahren und stehen unseren Kunden für weitergehende Frage zur Verfügung
  • Nach dem Sie mit den Kunden die inhaltliche Abstimmung des Auditplans abgeschlossen haben, führen Sie eigenständig das geplante Zertifizierungs- oder Überwachungsaudits durch
  • Im Anschluss erstellen Sie einen Prüfbericht und sprechen unserer Zertifizierungsstelle eine Empfehlung aus

Qualifikation

  • Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z.B. IRCA) als ISO 9001, ISO 14001 oder ISO 27001 Auditor
  • Sie verfügen bereits über erste Auditerfahrungen als Third-Party-Auditor im Bereich der ISO 9001, ISO 14001 oder ISO 27001
  • Hohe Serviceorientierung sowie gute Branchenkenntnisse
  • Entscheidungsfähigkeit, Organisationsfähigkeit
  • hohe Reisebereitschaft und Flexibilität
  • Freude an der Übernahme von Verantwortung
  • Routinierter Umgang mit den MS Office-Anwendungen

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Kunden aus allen Branchen
  • Faire und schnelle Bezahlung

Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung per E-Mail an personal(a)diqz. de
Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Ihnen unter 0431 8880-6065 gerne zur Verfügung.

DIQZ | Deutsche Institut für Qualität & Zertifizierung GmbH, Am Kiel-Kanal 2, 24106 Kiel

title: Augsburg - Kundenservice & Fahrzeugaufbereitung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Warum roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • DISCOUNTS UND BENEFITS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte.

Die Rolle – Deine Leidenschaft

  • Du begeisterst unsere Kund*innen bei der Abholung und Rückgabe ihres Campers mit einem strahlenden Lächeln und gestaltest ihre roadsurfer-Reise unvergesslich.

  • Du erläuterst und übergibst unsere Camper persönlich an die Kund*innen.

  • Du packst tatkräftig mit an und kümmerst dich um die gründliche Reinigung – innen wie außen – unserer Camper.

  • Du unterstützt das Stationsteam bei allen täglichen Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unsere #happyroadsurfer mit Freude in den Urlaub starten.

Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen

  • Du bist absolut hands-on und packst jederzeit mit an.

  • Optimalerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice mit.

  • Führerschein Klasse B.

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Dein Gehalt

Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 32.000 EUR und 32.400 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Bereit zur surfen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Für Rückfragen kannst du dich auch gern jederzeit an ----- wenden. Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich über unser Bewerbertool – so geht nichts verloren und wir können deine Bewerbung schnell bearbeiten.

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

roadsurfer was founded in Munich in 2016 by five friends who wanted to make campervan travel easier. What started with 25 VW California vans has grown into the global leader in campervan and motorhome adventures, with 10,000+ vehicles at around 100 stations across Europe and North America. title: Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help develop and scale the Lightning AI platform, spanning APIs, infrastructure, billing, security, and integrations. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key features and drive them end-to-end, working closely with engineering, product, and design to ship high-quality, iterative improvements. This is an opportunity to build systems that support real-world machine learning workloads at scale.

This role is based in one of our hubs (Seattle, NYC, SF, or London), with a minimum of 2 in-office days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You’ll Do

  • Write readable/testable/efficient code in Go (Golang).
  • Build deep expertise in our technology stack to deliver new features, improve system stability, and increase overall performance.
  • Partner with engineering and product leaders on developing the Lightning product while using your experience to set the technical direction for large projects.
  • Evaluate, strengthen, and document technical architecture, tools, and processes.
  • Maintain software quality, implement automation, drive continuous delivery, and reduce time to production while proactively reducing technical debt.
  • Mentor and coach engineers on system design, operating in high uncertainty, and problem-solving to create a supportive, inclusive environment where each engineer can grow.

What You’ll Need

  • Extensive experience writing efficient, maintainable code in Go. Familiarity with best practices in testing, readability, and optimization is essential.
  • Broad knowledge of backend and frontend systems, with experience building and scaling APIs, CLI tools, billing systems, and security protocols. Exposure to frontend frameworks is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure and designing systems that are reliable, performant, and scalable. Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is a strong advantage.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of key features and drive end-to-end development
  • Commitment to software quality, test automation, and continuous delivery. Experience proactively managing technical debt and speeding up time to production.
  • Hands-on experience as a backend or product engineer in a SaaS technology company
  • Communication and collaboration with engineers, product managers, and designers
  • Ability to operate in high uncertainty and rapidly changing environments

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:$180,000—$250,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Mehr als 25.000 Menschen verlassen sich bereits auf uns. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Verve is building a Brand Direct function — a small, senior team that sells and services select brand accounts directly, alongside our existing agency relationships, rather than replacing them. The goal is to get Verve's data, formats, and capabilities into brand planning conversations earlier, and to prove that dedicated brand-side support grows accounts faster than agency coverage alone.

This is a new team and a founding hire. You'll help define what “brand direct” looks like at Verve in practice, working closely with the Global VP of Brand Partnerships from day one.

The role

As Brand Partnerships Director, UK, you'll own a portfolio of named brand accounts in the UK, working as a generalist across categories rather than a single vertical. This is a senior individual contributor role — not a people-management role in the first instance — designed for someone who wants to build something and has the option to grow into managing a local team as the function scales.

You are a hunter first: someone who can open doors at brand (not agency) level, build credibility fast, and turn a first meeting into a durable, revenue-generating relationship. Prior experience or relationships in a specific vertical (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) are a strong plus, as this role has the potential to grow into leading a vertical specialist team.

Responsibilities include

  • Build senior brand relationships — Owning relationships at CMO, Global Head of Media, and VP of Brand level, along with key line-of-business leads such as Data, Creative, and Measurement within the brand.
  • Get ahead of the brief — Getting into brand planning cycles early so Verve's data, formats, and capabilities are already part of the conversation before the brief reaches the agency.
  • Represent Verve in the room — Representing Verve at brand-side (not agency-side) forums, marketing conferences, and roundtables to build Verve's profile with brand teams directly.
  • Commission insight work — Working with the insights and data teams to build brand-specific audience stories, category reports, and trend pieces that give brands a reason to meet and stay engaged.
  • Secure Joint Business Plans — Working towards annual brand frameworks that lock in investment and strategic commitment at brand level, independent of which agency holds the account.
  • Run the pilot — Building and pitching a defined target list of named accounts, with revenue tracked separately from non-brand-direct-supported business to prove the model.
  • Co-sell, don't compete — Partner with the existing agency sales team under a joint commercial framework — this role is additive to agency relationships, not competitive with them; revenue is double-counted so both sides are incentivized to collaborate.

Here are a few indicators that you're the right person

  • You have a track record of building and owning senior client relationships directly with brands or marketers, not solely through an agency or intermediary.
  • You have genuine “hunter” instincts — you're comfortable prospecting, opening new doors, and creating momentum in a newly-created role with no existing playbook.
  • You have an existing network of brand-side contacts in the UK; a specific category or vertical angle (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) is a plus but not required.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and building process as you go — this is a Phase 1 hire into a function that will evolve quickly.
  • You have strong commercial instincts: you can read an account's growth potential and prioritize your time accordingly.
  • You bring experience in media, adtech, data, or a related commercial sales environment as helpful context, though the core skill this role requires is brand-side relationship building.

What We Offer

Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: 

  • Stay healthy with our Bupa HealthCare Plan with easy access to medical care
  • Support your long-term financial security with our Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme, with Verve contributing 5% of your qualifying earnings
  • Pick what matters most to you in our Personalized Benefits Platform, with a budget of£50/month
  • Recharge with 25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays

Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars… and even more reasons to join us!

title: Broker Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

We work with a host of commercial finance brokers and business advisors across the UK to offer finance to their clients, and this channel generates a substantial proportion of iwoca’s total revenues.

As an Account Manager for our Broker Channel you’ll be the first port of call for our brokers and will give them exceptional customer service in managing loan applications for their clients. You will also provide our brokers with an in-depth understanding of iwoca’s product benefits, customer eligibility and use cases.

In addition to building relationships with our brokers, you will also work closely with other teams across the business. The key success factors in this role will be measured in the quality of relationships you build, your speed of service, and overall broker satisfaction. You will also have the opportunity to help shape and develop the future of this valuable channel.

 

Responsibilities

Your mission will be to:

  • Manage the day-to-day working relationship with the brokers in your panel

  • Pre-screen applications, ensuring the broker provides all necessary business documentation for a credit review

  • Provide timely updates for ongoing cases, answering questions related to specific applications or product queries

  • Deliver high-quality product training and onboarding to new brokers to maximise lead flow

  • Work closely with our Credit and Account Management teams to progress deals efficiently

  • Conduct proactive outreach and have the ability to objection handle in order to improve conversion rates and broker satisfaction

  • Support Broker Channel Managers with ad-hoc analysis and gain exposure to other business functions

  • Help organise and attend broker entertainment and industry networking events

 

Requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve. Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent time-management and organisational skills

  • A strong customer service ethic relationship-building mindset

  • Some experience of working in a fast-paced, client facing role

  • Knowledge of the UK business finance market (including our competitors) is a plus

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

We want to pay all of our employees fairly, so that’s why we regularly benchmark salaries based on market rates and to recognise your increasing value to our business. We are looking to pay from £27-35k + uncapped bonus (OTE bonus is 20% which is paid quarterly).

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Business AI Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben
  • Du identifizierst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden KI-Potenziale in Geschäftsprozessen und bewertest Use Cases nach Business Value, technischer Machbarkeit, Risiken und Skalierbarkeit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus Fachbereichen und IT in End-to-End-Architekturen für KI-Lösungen und wählst passende Ansätze, zum Beispiel Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, KI-Agenten oder Workflow-Automatisierung.
  • Du entwickelst Prototypen und Proofs of Concept und integrierst diese über APIs und Datenplattformen in SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemlandschaften.
  • Im SAP-Umfeld arbeitest du je nach Projekt mit SAP Business Technology Platform, SAP AI Core, SAP Generative AI Hub, Joule und Joule Studio.
  • Du berücksichtigst von Beginn an Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Berechtigungskonzepte, Nachvollziehbarkeit und AI Governance.
  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Discovery-, Use-Case- und Architekturworkshops und begleitest Lösungen von der Idee über den PoC bis zur produktiven Skalierung.
  • Du unterstützt Presales-Aktivitäten und entwickelst unser Business-AI-Portfolio sowie wiederverwendbare Lösungsbausteine weiter.

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Generative AI, Machine Learning oder intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen sowie mit modernen Cloud- und Integrationsarchitekturen.
  • Du kennst zentrale Konzepte wie Large Language Models, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Search und KI-Agenten und kannst deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch bewerten.
  • Du kannst Prototypen selbst entwickeln, zum Beispiel mit Python oder JavaScript, und hast Erfahrung mit APIs, Datenintegration und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen.
  • Du kannst Architekturentscheidungen strukturiert herleiten, dokumentieren und gegenüber technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern verständlich vertreten.
  • Du denkst dich schnell in Geschäftsprozesse und fachliche Problemstellungen ein und übersetzt sie in konkrete, umsetzbare technische Lösungen.
  • Know-how in SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, SAP AI Core, SAP Generative AI Hub, Joule, SAP Business Data Cloud oder SAP S/4HANA ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Erfahrung mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LangGraph sowie mit dem Model Context Protocol ist ein Plus.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
Persönlich
  • Du erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und adressatengerecht, vom Entwicklungsteam bis zum Management.
  • Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kunden, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Lösungen eigenständig voran.
  • Du bewertest neue Technologien nach ihrem konkreten Nutzen und ihren Risiken, nicht nach dem Hype.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und gerne im Team und teilst dein Wissen.

Warum wir?

Was Du unter anderem von uns erwarten kannst:

  • Attraktives Gehalt und viele Zusatzleistungen
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Option
  • Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation)

  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Diverse Sportangebote und wöchentliche Massage (zurzeit ausgesetzt wegen der Corona-Pandemie)

As Business Development Manager guide enterprise clients in changing their business, using our AI-powered go-to-market

We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received €20 million in Series A financing round.

Vicos consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e.g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of members work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new way of organizing human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers all essential areas end-to-end: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Why we are looking for you

We are scaling our go-to-market, AI-first and human-led: AI takes over the busywork, people build the relationships and make the decisions. For that we look for people with a builder’s mindset: you have already built or significantly contributed to something, you work with AI as naturally as with email, and you want to grow fast. Maybe you want to found your own company one day.

With us you learn how a disruptive business grows by challenging established practices and offering radically new, superior solutions: from the first contact to the signed contract and the team that delivers. You work on real enterprise deals from the start and take on more responsibility as you grow.

You identify prospects, understand their potential to improve through Vicos and lead them in starting and expanding their work with Vicos. You prepare client meetings, join them with our senior team and Vico Leads (the Vicos’ bosses) and take over your own accounts step by step.

You prepare and execute Vicoland’s event communication aimed at building reputation, raising client interest, and deepening relationships.

This includes support in finding new members or AI agents for Vicos, doing the research, communication and meetings needed. You help Vico Leads to onboard new members, integrate new AI agents, sharpen their profiles and win projects.

Who you are

title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager (CDD 18 mois)
descriptionHtml:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

title: Commercial Counsel Fellowship
descriptionHtml:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

FAQs

  • Are there specific fellowship start dates or can I start anytime?

    • We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round.

  • I am 10 years out of law school. Can I still apply for the fellowship?

    • The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. If you are an experienced lawyer who is early in your commercial counsel career, you are still welcome to apply. Explain your career transition and interest in commercial legal work in your application.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

title: Consultant - Manager, Agentic Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Data, AI, Solutions and Engineering practice are looking for Consultants, Senior Consultants and Managers to join the team. 

The interface between organisations and their data is being rebuilt. Static dashboards remain useful, but they now sit alongside conversational analytics, dynamically generated insight, analytical applications and agents embedded into operational workflows. Making these experiences valuable requires more than an LLM demo. They need trusted data and semantics, robust analytics engineering, appropriate architecture and a deep understanding of how products will be used. 

We are looking for Agentic Analytics Engineers who are strong analytics engineers first and are already applying AI to how they work. You will build analytical products using SQL, Python, semantic and metric models and modern analytics platforms, while also developing Insight Agents, conversational experiences and AI-enabled applications. If you already have substantial delivery experience in agentic analytics, generative BI or LLM-enabled insight, that is highly valuable. We do not, however, expect every strong candidate to have deployed all these capabilities extensively at enterprise scale. 

This is a hands-on engineering role. Across all grades we value people who understand how things are built and can show that they are actively experimenting with AI-enabled analytics in practice. In the UK profile, we also put significant weight on consulting and advisory credibility: working directly with clients, making sense of ambiguous problems, shaping architecture and explaining the trade-offs behind technical choices. 

What you will be doing

  • Understand the business outcome, decision or workflow that the analytical capability needs to improve, and translate that into a robust technical solution. 
  • Design and build Insight Agents, conversational analytics and AI-enabled analytical applications that connect users to trusted enterprise data and tools. 
  • Ensure that any AI is explainable and aligns with the relevant guidelines and guardrails that have been defined. 
  • Design and engineer semantic and metric models so that business definitions, dimensions and measures can be used consistently across BI, applications and AI agents. 
  • Build analytical experiences using platforms such as Microsoft Fabric / Power BI, Databricks and Snowflake, as well as custom applications and APIs where that is the right choice. 
  • Integrate insight into operational workflows through APIs, embedded analytics, applications, events and agentic patterns, including appropriate human judgement and control points. 
  • Work hands-on with SQL, Python and relevant software / platform engineering tools to build, test and deploy production-quality solutions. 
  • Design for security, reliability, observability, performance, cost and responsible use so solutions can move from prototype to sustainable enterprise capability. 
  • Prototype and refine user experiences and work closely with Decision & Insight Leads, designers and end users so generated insight is understandable and actionable. 
  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with client engineers, architects and business teams, shaping solutions as understanding develops rather than simply implementing a fixed specification. 
  • Build reusable assets, patterns and accelerators and actively learn as the agentic analytics technology landscape evolves. 

 
Your skills and experience  

  • Excellent hands-on analytics engineering ability, with evidence of analytical or data-intensive products and capabilities you have personally designed and built. 
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, alongside sound development practices such as Git, automated testing, CI/CD, APIs and well-structured, maintainable code. 
  • Hands-on experience with one or more mainstream analytics platforms. This may come from Microsoft Fabric / Power BI, Databricks, Snowflake or comparable technologies, together with the ability to learn new platforms rather than being defined by one vendor. 
  • Strong understanding of analytical, dimensional, semantic or metric modelling and why shared business meaning is critical when insight is consumed by both people and AI. 
  • A grounded understanding of how AI is changing analytics, supported by practical experimentation with capabilities such as conversational analytics, generative BI, LLM-enabled applications or agents. We are particularly interested in candidates who have already designed or delivered these capabilities, but we do not require extensive enterprise-scale deployment experience across every area. 
  • Evidence that you already use AI practically in your day-to-day analytics or engineering work, for example to explore data, write or review code, prototype solutions, automate tasks or develop analytical products, and can explain what you have learned and where these approaches create value. 
  • Ability to make sound architecture choices across platform-native and custom approaches, including an understanding of security, explainability, cost, maintainability, performance and scale. 
  • Experience building user-facing analytical experiences or working closely enough with designers and users to make sound product and interface choices. 
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills. For UK hiring, previous consulting experience is strongly valued, or equivalent evidence that you can work through ambiguity with clients, shape solutions and influence business and technology stakeholders. 

You may also bring 

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric semantic models, Fabric Data Agents, Power Platform or Copilot Studio. 
  • Databricks capabilities such as lakehouse / SQL, Genie or MLflow; Snowflake and Cortex capabilities. 
  • Experience with Anthropic Claude or OpenAI APIs, MCP, A2A or comparable agent and tool integration patterns. 
  • Front-end or full-stack development and user-centred design experience, for example React / TypeScript or Figma. 
  • Cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, containerisation, DevOps / DataOps, governance, lineage or AI observability experience. 

How the opportunity flexes with experience 

Consultants will typically spend a high proportion of their time designing and building, applying strong analytics engineering foundations and demonstrating active experimentation with AI-enabled approaches. Senior Consultants will increasingly own end-to-end components and workstreams, selecting appropriate patterns and working directly with client stakeholders. Managers combine sustained engineering depth with solution architecture, team leadership and client ownership, making sound choices between conventional analytics, platform-native AI and custom agentic approaches. 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations.
