title: Consultant(e) Support Paie & DSN
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Consultant(e) Support Paie & DSN pour accompagner ses cabinets partenaires sur leurs questions de paie les plus pointues !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris, Aix-en-Provence ou en télétravail complet

  • Équipe : Support

  • Expérience : 3 à 5 ans en paie

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Quand un écart de calcul ou un rejet DSN bloque une paie, le cabinet a besoin d'un expert qui comprend vite et explique clairement. Ta réponse évite une paie en retard et renforce la confiance du cabinet dans Alassio.

Notre support est hybride : Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA, apporte la première réponse ; nos Spécialistes Support Paie prennent le relais sur les questions courantes, et tu interviens sur les cas qui demandent une expertise approfondie.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu prends en charge les demandes de paie et de DSN qui demandent une vraie expertise : tu analyses, tu expliques, et tu donnes vite au cabinet la bonne réponse. Tu es l'expert vers qui le cabinet se tourne quand une paie est bloquée.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Traiter les demandes de niveau 2 escaladées par les Spécialistes Support Paie : écarts de calcul, absences et maintien de salaire, entrées et sorties, régularisations

  • Expliquer les retours DSN (anomalies, rejets, comptes rendus métier) et guider le cabinet dans leur correction

  • Qualifier les bugs et les erreurs de paramétrage : reproduire, documenter et transmettre à l'équipe Tech ou à l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie

  • Escalader avec discernement les sujets d'analyse produit à l'Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et les questions d'interprétation juridique à l'équipe Juridique

  • Faire monter en compétences les Spécialistes Support Paie : relectures, partage de cas, réponses types

  • Capitaliser : fiches pratiques dans notre documentation et dans la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence

  • Remonter au Product les irritants récurrents des cabinets

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. Métier)

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos Spécialistes Support Paie, notre Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN, notre Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et l'équipe Juridique

  • Outils : Alassio, Alassio Intelligence, Intercom, Linear, Notion, Mintlify

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, le moteur de calcul et nos circuits d'escalade, et tu traites tes premières demandes de niveau 2 avec relecture

  • À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le niveau 2, tes escalades vers le Métier et le Juridique sont complètes et justes, et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

  • À 6 mois : tu es la référence DSN de l'équipe Support, et tes contenus font baisser le volume des demandes récurrentes

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie)

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en paie : gestionnaire de paie confirmé(e) en cabinet, ou support et conseil chez un éditeur de paie

  • Maîtrise de la DSN : anomalies, rejets, comptes rendus métier, régularisations

  • Solide pratique des règles de paie en environnement multi-conventions

  • Une écriture claire et pédagogue

Un plus :

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Expérience de support ou de hotline chez un éditeur

  • Connaissance d'un régime particulier : MSA, BTP (caisses de congés payés) ou Outre-mer

 

💎 Qualités

  • Le réflexe d'aller au fond d'un cas avant de répondre

  • La pédagogie : tu sais rendre une règle complexe compréhensible pour un gestionnaire de paie

  • Le calme et la réactivité lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

  

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : analyser un rejet DSN et un écart de calcul, puis rédiger la réponse au cabinet : 45 min

3️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Mettre ton expertise paie et DSN au service d'un logiciel qui change le quotidien des gestionnaires de paie, et voir tes retours transformés en améliorations du produit.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

Certaines personnes hésitent à postuler quand elles ne cochent pas toutes les cases. Si tu hésites, postule quand même : on en parlera volontiers.

title: Credit Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Credit Strategy Analyst (Hybrid in London)

You'll support & refine our lending strategy, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk.

Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses with the funds they need to grow.

The team

The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca's growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London.

 

The role

We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Credit Strategy Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca's lending strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build expertise in the credit domain.

  • Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis.

  • Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions.

  • Partner with key stakeholders in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes).

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards, presenting a clear picture of the state of our lending.

  • Practice turning data into information, and information into insights, so that you and various stakeholders can deliver improvements with real impact for our customers.

The requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • A degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar.

  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to support decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor analysis and recommendations to different audiences.

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving.

  • A bucket-load of common sense.

  • A commitment to using modern tools effectively – including AI – to maximise quality, speed, and rigour, while retaining responsibility for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • Experience in B2B or B2C credit risk lending and strategy.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Looker

The salary

We expect to pay from £40,000–£65,000 for this role, dependent on your experience. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Customer Success - Access Operations Specialist to support our institutional customers and Sales team at AMBOSS.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Institutions can only get value from AMBOSS if their users can reach it easily and know it’s available to them, and as our Customer Success - Access Operations Specialist, you are the person who makes that happen.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring our institutional partners unlock the full value of AMBOSS, helping embed it into daily clinical and teaching routines and strengthening user experience, retention, and growth. Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, Ronald, you will help support our International and US customers and the respective Sales Managers, contributing to our revenue and internationalization company goals.

You will:

  • Manage, prioritize and effectively address requests from our B2B Sales Team and institutional administrators to support their license and trial launches, always keeping the experience and value our users get from AMBOSS at the center.

  • Consult internal Sales stakeholders and institutional customers on the best access method for AMBOSS, using active listening and targeted discovery questions to understand each institution’s needs, explaining complex concepts simply for each audience, and making clear recommendations based on a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of each option in the specific customer situation.

  • Set up the agreed access methods for AMBOSS by following through on the technical details of the implementation with the institution’s IT team and our internal stakeholders, ensuring each access method is configured correctly and ready on time.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing and other departments to jointly tackle difficult customer challenges and to continuously improve how we support sales and our customers.

You bring:

  • Ideally you have a previous experience in customer success or customer support (1-2y or an internship) combined with a degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management or a relevant field.

  • You are an outstanding communicator, both in writing and verbally. You can break down complex topics to their essence and communicate them appropriately based on your audience.

  • You are pragmatic and action-oriented. You work productively through a high volume of requests, focusing on timely, effective solutions rather than perfect ones.

  • You are decisive. You make well-reasoned decisions even when information is incomplete, can explain the thinking behind them, and continuously learn from mistakes by reflecting openly and adjusting your approach.

  • You are able to build rapport with stakeholders across different countries and seniority levels through a mix of authenticity and openness, competence, and clear communication.

  • You have a project management mindset and are able to independently organize your work to ensure you deliver in time and quality, even for more complex projects.

  • You possess an analytical mindset and an affinity for numbers that allows you to interpret usage analytics and derive relevant insights for our customers.

  • You have an eye for efficiency and contribute to continuously improving our internal processes and materials.

You enjoy:

  • Fostering your growth mindset and continuously learning

  • Persevering and staying motivated to achieve your goals even when challenges arise

  • Learning and growing based on feedback and coaching

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

title: Customer Success Manager – Adoption & Accompagnement 80/100%
descriptionHtml:
Le go-live, c’est seulement le début.


Chez RogerHR, notre accompagnement ne s’arrête pas à la mise en production. Une fois la plateforme en place, il reste à aider nos clients à en tirer pleinement parti, au quotidien et sur le long terme. Leurs besoins évoluent, et Roger aussi : de nouvelles fonctionnalités sortent régulièrement, et chacune peut leur faire gagner du temps… à condition de savoir qu’elle existe et de savoir s’en servir.


En tant que Customer Success Manager orienté adoption, tu deviens l’interlocuteur clé de nos clients après le démarrage. Ton rôle a un impact direct sur le quotidien des équipes RH : moins de tâches manuelles, des processus plus fluides, et plus de temps pour ce qui compte vraiment, l’humain.


Ton objectif : que chaque client soit autonome, satisfait et qu’il tire toujours plus de valeur d’une plateforme qui ne cesse de s’enrichir.

Vos missions

Faire vivre la relation client

  • Garder un contact régulier et proactif avec chaque client et faire avec lui le point sur son utilisation de Roger

  • Prendre le pouls de la satisfaction et repérer les signaux faibles (baisse d’usage, frustrations, changement d’interlocuteur)

  • Construire une relation de confiance durable avec les équipes RH, la direction et les key users

Analyser et améliorer les usages

  • Comprendre comment chaque client utilise réellement Roger, avec le recul de l’utilisation au quotidien

  • Analyser ses processus RH pour repérer les irritants, les contournements et les tâches manuelles qui subsistent

  • Proposer des pistes d’amélioration concrètes : paramétrage, fonctionnalités inexploitées, automatisations

  • Challenger avec bienveillance les habitudes en place quand une meilleure façon de faire existe

  • Conseiller les clients sur les bonnes pratiques RH et la bonne application des règles (temps de travail, absences, vacances…) dans Roger

Valoriser le travail accompli

  • Aider les équipes RH à valoriser en interne le travail accompli avec Roger, auprès de leur direction comme de leurs collaborateurs

  • Construire avec elles un business case concret : temps gagné, processus simplifiés, fiabilité des données, retour sur investissement

Rendre les clients autonomes

  • Former les key users et les nouveaux arrivants côté client

  • Expliquer, réexpliquer et vulgariser, avec patience et pédagogie

  • Créer ou enrichir les ressources d’auto-formation (guides, tutoriels, bonnes pratiques) pour garantir des pratiques harmonieuses entre nos clients

Faire découvrir les nouveautés

  • Suivre de près les évolutions de Roger et savoir à quels clients chaque nouveauté sera utile

  • Présenter les nouvelles fonctionnalités et aider les clients à les intégrer dans leurs processus

  • Organiser des sessions de découverte (webinars, démos ciblées, ateliers)

Contribuer à la croissance

  • Identifier les besoins non couverts et les opportunités d’upsell (nouveaux modules, intégrations, nouveau périmètre)

  • Accompagner l’équipe commerciale sur les opportunités détectées

  • Contribuer à la fidélisation et au renouvellement des contrats

Être la voix RH chez Roger

  • Partager ton expertise RH avec l’équipe (Customer Success, produit, développement) pour que Roger colle au plus près de la réalité du terrain

  • Faire remonter les retours clients à l’équipe produit et éclairer les choix grâce à ta connaissance des pratiques et des règles RH

  • Aider tes collègues à monter en compétence sur les sujets RH

Ton profil

Tu viens des RH et tu veux avoir un réel impact sur le quotidien de tes pairs.

title: Data Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Engineering Intern to join our Data and Analytics team, in Amsterdam. As a Data Engineering Intern, you will be involved in turning our clients´ business into a more data-driven one.


Who we are

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering Big Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

What we offer

  • Intensive training from our super skilled Data engineering team on topics like data warehousing, data pipelines, distributed computing using Pyspark, data modelling & data lake.

  • Relevant working experience on a live business case.

  • Interact with clients regularly to drive their business towards impactful change.

  • Play a key role in the team by creating new business solutions via data-driven insights.

  • Receive guidance by a dedicated mentor to make sure you make the most out of your time at Metyis.

  • Experience being part of a fast-growing international and diverse team.

What you will do

  • Assisting in the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines to extract, transform and load data from various sources.

  • Helping with data warehousing and data modelling activities.

  • Participating in the creation of data-driven solutions to support business needs.

  • Collaborating with data scientists, business analysts and software engineers to understand and implement data requirements.

  • Implementing data quality and data governance processes.

  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback.

  • Staying up to date with the latest developments in data engineering technologies and best practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Pursuing a degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work well in a team environment.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Passion for Data: A strong interest in data and technology, and a desire to learn and grow as a data engineer.

At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

title: Data & People analytics Apprentice - January 2027
descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.

2. Your Impact

  • Coordinate learning events end to end, including Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch-and-learns and show-and-tell sessions. Oversee logistics, invitations, learning materials and post-event follow-up.
  • Monitor participation and gather feedback to measure engagement, identify key learnings and implement continuous improvements across learning programmes.
  • Curate and structure learning content by auditing existing AI, enablement and development resources and creating clear, audience-specific learning paths
  • Develop practical learning resources, including guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials, to facilitate knowledge sharing and support the adoption of new skills and practices.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives by collecting and documenting business use cases, designing surveys and knowledge assessments, and consolidating insights to inform People team decisions.
  • Support the delivery of cross-functional People projects across an international scope, including Diversity & Inclusion, HRIS, HR process optimisation and culture-related initiatives in a fast-growing environment.
  • Coordinate stakeholders and contribute to project implementation, ensuring alignment, follow-up and effective communication across teams.
  • Support cross-functional People projects, coordinating stakeholders and helping drive implementation.
  • Contribute to the accuracy and reliability of People data, supporting automation, reporting and more in-depth analysis.

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Master's level degree (Bac+5) in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organizing events
  • Availability for a 12-month apprenticeship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:
  • Rigorous and autonomous, with strong tracking and reporting capabilities
  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English

4. Tools Used

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (C1 level required)

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: Compensation is determined based on your level of study and applicable legal regulations in force.

  2. Perks & Benefits:

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
    • 2 remote work days per month
    • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
    • Gymlib pass for your well-being
    • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
    • Swile meal vouchers
    • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with our recruiter to discuss your profile and expectations
  3. Interview with your future manager
  4. Structured interview using the STAR method to ensure transparency and fairness
  5. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

This position is based in Paris, with up to two days of remote work permitted per month.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Data Science Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation and causal inference.

We're hiring multiple Data Science Managers across different areas of the business. All of these roles are at the same level. Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope and team at the end of the process, based on your background, interview performance, preferences and current business needs.

We're also advertising some opportunities separately where particular domain experience is especially relevant. You only need to submit one application, as we'll consider your profile across all suitable Data Science Manager vacancies. Before an offer is made, you'll have the opportunity to meet the proposed team, either virtually or at our London headquarters, and learn more about the role's scope and priorities.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll own the analytical direction and measurable impact of a product or business area, while leading and developing a high-performing team of data scientists or machine learning engineers.

Our Data Science Managers work across a range of consumer, product and commercial areas. Depending on the team you join, your work could focus on areas such as customer retention and loyalty, pricing and promotions, discovery and personalisation, or customer acquisition and engagement.

Across all roles, you'll lead and develop your team, set the analytical direction for your area and decide which problems are worth solving. You'll ensure data science work translates into better product and commercial decisions, not just analysis.

You'll remain hands-on while managing a team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Ops, Marketing and Finance as a thought partner. You'll set the bar for analytical rigour, prioritisation and impact across noisy metrics, real trade-offs and strong stakeholder opinions.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience line managing data scientists and supporting their career development

  • A strong background as a senior individual contributor, with hands-on experience in experimentation, causal inference or applied machine learning

  • Proven ability to identify high-impact opportunities and turn insights into clear strategy and execution

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where prioritisation and judgement matter as much as technical skill

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll work on real-world problems at global scale, across a three-sided marketplace that is constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more, united by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect:

  • High autonomy to shape strategy and deliver meaningful impact

  • Support to learn and grow through L&D programmes, mentoring and peer learning

  • A strong focus on wellbeing, with benefits that vary by country

  • A place to belong, with a diverse global workforce and active employee communities

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Dealer Experience Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

And here's where you come in

We're looking for talented folks to join our Dealer Experience team – the heart and soul of Motorway. As a Dealer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for our dealers using the Motorway platform, guiding them through the various stages of buying vehicles on our platform and supporting them throughout their journey with Motorway.

What makes us different

We're not your typical call centre. No rigid scripts or endless queues here. We're using tech to shake up the car industry. We're empowering buyers and sellers to get the best deals. And we're building a team of passionate people who are excited to be part of something truly innovative. Here's what that means for you:

  • Impactful Work: You're not just answering calls; you're guiding customers through our cutting-edge online platform, using your skills to solve real problems and make their car selling experience amazing.

  • AI-Powered Technology: We use the latest AI tools, so you can give customers a seamless and efficient experience. Say goodbye to clunky systems!

  • Tangible Results: Every day, you'll directly help people navigate the car selling process, making sure they get the best deal and avoid the stress of traditional methods.

What you'll be doing

  • Building genuine connections: Chatting with car sellers and dealers, answering their questions, and building trust.

  • Finding creative solutions: Using your initiative and problem-solving skills to tackle any challenges.

  • Mastering our systems: Becoming a whiz with our CRM systems, ensuring data accuracy and efficiency.

  • Putting customers first: Always championing the customer and looking for ways to make their experience even better.

About you

  • You genuinely enjoy helping people and have a knack for building rapport.

  • You're a natural communicator, whether it's on the phone, via email, or through chat.

  • You're detail-oriented and take pride in your work.

  • You're a quick learner and enjoy solving problems.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment.

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive

  • £26,000 starting salary

  • Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 8:45am to 5:30pm

  • Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going!

  • Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc!

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and and workplace nursery scheme

  • ... and much more!

Our interview process

  • Initial Call (30 mins): A casual chat to discuss your experience and learn more about Motorway.

  • Team Matching: You will be matched with a team based on your background and preferences and receive additional insight on the team and what to expect in the final interview.

  • Final Interview (60 mins): Meet the team, get a feel for the role, and participate in a skills-based assessment, which may include a role-playing exercise.

We'll get back to you within a week business days of each interview stage. You can chat with a talent partner throughout the process if you have any questions or need anything at all.

Compensation: £26K

title: Deine Ausbildung: Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration
descriptionHtml:
Dein Einstieg in die IT: Technik verstehen, Lösungen finden, Zukunft gestalten.

Du interessierst dich für Computer und Technik und möchtest verstehen, wie eigentlich alles zusammen funktioniert? Vielleicht bist du auch die Person, die zu Hause zuerst gefragt wird, wenn das WLAN nicht funktioniert oder der Computer plötzlich Probleme macht?

Dann könnte die Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Bei der Deutschen Extrakt Kaffee GmbH (DEK) dreht sich vieles um Kaffee. Damit unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen jeden Tag ihre Arbeit machen können, braucht es im Hintergrund aber auch eine zuverlässige IT. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du, wie Computer, Netzwerke und IT-Systeme miteinander verbunden sind, wie man technische Probleme löst und dafür sorgt, dass im Unternehmen alles möglichst reibungslos funktioniert.

Dabei musst du noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, gerne dazulernst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns in die IT-Welt einzutauchen.

Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung

Als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration sorgst du dafür, dass unsere IT-Systeme funktionieren und unsere Mitarbeitenden zuverlässig damit arbeiten können.

In deiner dreijährigen Ausbildung lernst du Schritt für Schritt die verschiedenen Aufgaben unserer IT kennen. Dabei schaust du nicht nur zu, sondern kannst dein Wissen auch praktisch anwenden.

Das bedeutet für dich:

  • Du lernst unsere IT-Welt kennen: Von Computern und Laptops über Server bis hin zu Netzwerken erfährst du, wie unsere technische Infrastruktur aufgebaut ist und zusammenarbeitet.

  • Du bringst Technik zum Laufen: Du unterstützt dabei, neue Geräte einzurichten, Software zu installieren und Arbeitsplätze technisch auszustatten.

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, hilfst du bei der Fehlersuche und lernst, wie sich technische Störungen systematisch beheben lassen.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen: Du beantwortest IT-Fragen und hilfst dabei, technische Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag zu lösen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich mit IT-Sicherheit: Du erfährst, wie wir unsere Systeme und Daten schützen und warum das für unser Unternehmen so wichtig ist.

  • Du entwickelst dich weiter: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben und kannst dich in spannende IT-Themen und Projekte einbringen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast Interesse an Technik, möchtest verstehen, wie IT-Systeme funktionieren, und probierst gerne Neues aus? Dann bringst du schon eine wichtige Voraussetzung für deine Ausbildung bei uns mit.

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Du hast einen guten Schulabschluss oder stehst kurz davor, deinen Abschluss zu machen.

  • Computer, Netzwerke und digitale Technologien interessieren dich. Vielleicht hast du dich auch privat schon mit dem einen oder anderen IT-Thema beschäftigt.

  • Du gehst Dingen gerne auf den Grund und gibst nicht gleich auf, wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb funktioniert.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, denkst gerne mit und hast Spaß daran, Lösungen zu finden.

  • Du bist offen, hilfsbereit und arbeitest gerne mit anderen Menschen zusammen.

  • Du hast Lust, Neues zu lernen, Fragen zu stellen und dich während deiner Ausbildung weiterzuentwickeln.

Und keine Sorge: Du musst weder programmieren können noch ein IT-Profi sein. Alles, was du für deinen Beruf brauchst, lernst du bei uns und in der Berufsschule.

Unser Angebot

  • Bei uns kannst du Ausbildung und Privatleben super verbinden! Dank unserer Gleitzeitregelung hast du die Möglichkeit, deinen Arbeitstag flexibel zu gestalten – so lassen sich Familie, Freizeit und Beruf optimal miteinander vereinbaren.

  • Bei uns startest du im ersten Lehrjahr mit 1.065€ brutto. Dies erhöht sich im zweiten Lehrjahr auf 1.166€ brutto und im dritten Lehrjahr auf 1.319€ brutto. Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und jährliche Gehaltsanpassungen.

  • Unsere Idee ist, dass du nach der Ausbildung bei uns bleibst: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und eine praxisnahe Ausbildung. So hast du die besten Chancen, nach deiner Ausbildung übernommen zu werden und langfristig mit uns gemeinsam zu wachsen.

  • Karriere mit Geschmack: Du erhältst monatliche Freikontingente, damit Du auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee oder Kakao genießen kannst.

  • Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen, u.a. mit Geburtstags- und Weihnachtsgeschenken machen wir Dir regelmäßig eine Freude.

  • Wir bieten Dir weitere Benefits wie unsere betriebseigene Kantine, in der täglich frisch gekocht wird, eine Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vergünstigte Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote über machtfit und ein professionelles Mental Health Angebot durch das Fürstenberg Institut.

Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen?

Familiär. International. Langfristig.

Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren.

Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren.

Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens.

Wir freuen uns über geeignete Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

title: Design Ops
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⚡ The design and research community at Alan

Alan’s Design & Research (D&R) community is the group of designers and researchers behind everything our members see and use. Our goal is simple: build the most member-centric health experience there is, with high standards of craft and a real understanding of the people we design for.

We are growing fast, and AI is changing what is possible in the way we work. We are looking for someone who loves tooling, ops and AI to help us move faster without lowering the bar on quality.

This is a builder role where design, operations and AI meet. You will scope where AI and automation can help us build faster, scale better and catch quality issues earlier, then turn the best ideas into tools the community actually uses. Along the way, you will help us improve our rituals and best practices, and share what we learn inside and outside Alan. You are not a designer or a researcher yourself: you are the enabler that allows the community to go faster and perform better as our member base grows.

🤝 Your missions

You will help D&R work smarter and keep quality high as we grow, in close collaboration with the community, its lead, and the engineering, Product Ops and platform teams we work with. You will help shape our community strategy on AI and tooling, then build and run what comes out of it.

  • Explore: Test new AI tools and automations, find the ones that really save time or improve quality, and share the best with the community. Work with our internal AI tooling teams to bring what’s cutting edge to design and research.

  • Build: Create skills, agents and automated checks that make design and research work more efficient, reliable and of higher quality.

  • Run the tooling: Maintain and upgrade the tools the community relies on, and be our point of contact with Alan’s platform and agentic teams.

  • Improve how we work: Bring in better practices and rituals, push our existing rituals to the next level and help us show what we learn and achieve, inside and outside Alan.

  • Own your roadmap: Identify opportunities, prioritize solutions, set clear goals, track adoption and quality, and adjust as you go.

🚀 You are a good fit if...

You are an ops-minded builder with around 4 years of experience in ops or enablement roles: design ops, tooling, automation, analytics, program management or something close. Design and research interests you, but what drives you is helping teams work better with tools, automation and better rituals.

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience automating work. You have replaced repetitive tasks with automations, internal tools or AI workflows (no-code, low-code or AI tools), at work or on your own projects, and you can tell us what you built and who used it.

  • Familiarity with AI tools. You have built or tested skills, agents or automations, and you care that they are reliable, not just impressive in a demo.

  • Comfort working with engineers. You can build things yourself, you know when to ask for production-grade work, and you speak their language.

  • Experience supporting a team or community, for example through onboarding, rituals, events or internal communications.

  • Strong English communication, to collaborate with our international team. French is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience in or alongside a design or research team.

  • Familiarity with Figma and design systems.

Qualities we look for

title: DevSecOps Engineer (f/x/m)
descriptionHtml:
💸 spotixx is a Frankfurt-based European FinTech building technology for the regulated financial sector. Since 2019, we have grown into a team of 60+ professionals with deep roots in the German and European banking landscape, shaped by years of hands-on experience in fraud investigation and financial crime prevention. We specialize in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and fraud detection, enabling secure, compliant data exchange between financial institutions. Using advanced data science and AI, we are helping shift the industry toward collaborative intelligence and more effective prevention. As a self-funded company, we focus on sustainable growth and real impact. With offices in Frankfurt and Wilhelmshaven and strong inbound demand, we are expanding our team. If you want to work on meaningful problems, grow with the company, and be part of a flexible, hybrid work environment, spotixx offers the opportunity to do just that.

Tasks: what you will do

  • Own the infrastructure as code. Define and maintain every environment in code so they are reproducible and consistent.

  • Secure the delivery pipeline. Keep CI/CD trustworthy end to end - from keyless authentication to verified, attested deployments.

  • Run the cloud and network security controls. Manage edge protection, private networking, and segmentation across the platform.

  • Operate vulnerability management. Keep scanning and posture checks running, triaged, and turned into tracked, time-bound work.

  • Detect, monitor, and respond to threats. Run monitoring and alerting across the platform, investigate security and reliability incidents, and drive them to root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.

  • Manage identity and least-privilege access. Own authentication, access control, and secrets management.

  • Automate compliance evidence. Make the controls provable through automated, retained evidence rather than manual effort.

  • Support security testing. Enable penetration tests and configuration reviews, and act on what they find.

This is a DevSecOps role, not a DevOps role with a security title. You own the controls, not just the infrastructure:

  • Shift-left by default. Scanning, attestation, and policy run in the pipeline; an unsafe artifact fails the build, not a review.

  • Vulnerability management. Findings become tracked tickets with severity-based SLAs; you keep the queue moving and the control demonstrably operating.

  • Least-privilege IAM. Access is group-scoped, time-boxed where appropriate, and reviewed - no standing admin where a bounded grant will do.

  • Audit-ready evidence. Compliance controls (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI DSS) are satisfied by automated, retained evidence - not a scramble before an audit.

  • Security testing. You support external penetration tests and cloud-config reviews, run isolated environments for them, and act on what they find.

Tools and platform

⚠️ Google Cloud Platform is the one fixed requirement - this is a GCP-first role. Beyond that, we expect fluency with the standard DevSecOps toolchain: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container and image security, cloud and edge protection, identity and secrets management, and posture and vulnerability scanning. We use well-established tools in each area, and equivalent experience transfers - we care more that you know the category than any specific product.

What you bring (essential)

  • 4+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or cloud security, with real production ownership.

  • Proven experience running production services, including on-call, incident response, and backup and recovery.

  • Understanding of production change management, so that every change is reviewed, approved, traceable.

  • Google Cloud Platform experience - this role is GCP-first and GCP is a firm requirement.

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or equivalent): modules, state management, drift control.

  • Hands-on CI/CD pipeline engineering, including keyless / OIDC authentication to the cloud.

  • Solid cloud security fundamentals: IAM and least privilege, network segmentation, secrets management, WAF / edge controls.

  • Application security. Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web-application vulnerabilities, and how to mitigate them in the pipeline and at the edge (WAF).

  • Container and image security in practice - building, scanning, and remediating.

  • Comfortable scripting in Python and Bash, and reading other people’s code.

  • Clear written communication - you can explain a control and the risk it addresses to both an engineer and an auditor.

What you bring (optional)

  • 4+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or cloud security, with real production ownership.

  • Proven experience running production services, including on-call, incident response, and backup and recovery.

  • Depth in managed GCP services (serverless compute, cloud WAF, binary/supply-chain authorization, workload identity federation).

  • Background in fintech, banking, healthcare, or another regulated / high-assurance domain.

  • Supply-chain security (SLSA, attestation, Sigstore) and DAST experience.

  • CSPM / CIS benchmark tooling.

  • Production experience with an OIDC / identity provider.

  • Exposure to privacy-enhancing technologies (secure multi-party computation, confidential computing).

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CKA / CKS, OSCP).

Benefits

💰 Attractive compensation.

🏠 Flexible hybrid work model (Frankfurt + home office within Germany).

🚀 High ownership and real impact from day one.

🏇 Flat structures and fast decision-making.

🗺️ Collaborative, international team culture.

🦹 Work on high-impact products that help fight financial crime.

🏎️ Fast growth path: room to grow quickly into a senior product seat.

🌈 We welcome applications from all qualified people, as diversity enriches us. Your perspective matters: regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, or disability. Applicants with disabilities will be given preference when equally qualified.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Digital Producer:in Serious Games & KI
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen: Digital Producer:in Serious Games & KI (m/w/d)

🎯 Mission: Bringe Serious-Games-Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung
💼 Bereich: Projektleitung, Creative Producing, Creative Project Management, Game Design, KI-Allrounder
📍 Standort: Berlin (hybrid möglich)
📅 Start: Q1 2027
🕐 Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (4 Tage)

Wer wir sind

Pfeffermind ist eine führende Agentur für Gamification & Serious Games. Seit 2013 entwickeln wir spielerische Anwendungen und Formate mit Mehrwert für Unternehmen, Organisationen, Bildung und Kultur. Unsere Mission: Must-do-Tasks in Wanna-do-Tasks verwandeln.

In 100+ Projekten haben wir Lernen, Arbeit, Gesundheit und Kommunikation motivierender gemacht. Kunden wie SAP, die Bundesbank oder das Goethe-Institut vertrauen auf unsere Expertise. Ob Escape Game im Museum, Awareness-Kampagne zur Cybersicherheit oder App zur Stressbewältigung: Unsere Lösungen machen ernsthafte Themen spielerisch erlebbar.

Wir entwickeln keine Punkte-und-Badges-Spielereien, sondern bauen Systeme, die Motivation, Lernen und Verhalten verändern. Und wir glauben: In Zeiten von KI braucht es weniger Ausführende – und mehr Architekt:innen. Und genau da kommst du ins Spiel.

Deine Rolle

Ein Kunde will in zwei Wochen etwas Spielbares sehen. Als Digital Producer:in Serious Games & KI sagst du nicht „schwierig“, sondern „klar“ und machst dich mit Claude an die Arbeit. Du setzt digitale Projekte um, vom Briefing bis zur Abnahme. Und wo andere Tickets schreiben, baust du.

Dafür bringst du vielfältige Talente mit: Du verstehst viel von Spielen, ihrem Aufbau und den passenden Mechanismen. Es reicht nicht, dass du gern spielst. Du musst besser als die KI wissen, wie man aus spielerischen Elementen effektive Lernkonzepte entwickelt. Denn das Spannende und Herausfordernde an unserem Job ist es, uns immer wieder in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gute Ideen zu haben, wie man diese Inhalte spielerisch vermittelt.

Gleichzeitig bist du nicht nur Kreativ-Kopf, sondern bringst auch Skills als Creative Project Manager mit. Das heißt, du planst und koordinierst deine Projekte eigenständig, arbeitest strukturiert und stellst sicher, dass alle deine Projekte on time ins Ziel kommen. Zudem kannst du deine Konzepte überzeugend vor unseren Kunden präsentieren und unterstützt unser Team bei der Anbahnung von neuen Projekten und kannst Kundenwünsche in belastbare Angebote übersetzen.

Du arbeitest nicht To-Dos ab. Sondern denkst Projekte von Anfang bis Ende. Unser Ziel ist ein Team aus wenigen, starken Persönlichkeiten, die: vielseitig denken, Verantwortung übernehmen, KI als Beschleuniger verstehen und gemeinsam Dinge bauen, die hängen bleiben. Wenn du dich eher als Architekt:in skalierbarer Systeme verstehst als als Content-Produzent:in, passt das gut.

Was du mitbringst

  • Rasche Auffassungsgabe: Klingt wie ein Bullshitbingo-Wort aus Job-Postings, aber wir meinen es ernst: Du musst dich an einem Tag mit Cybersecurity beschäftigen, am nächsten mit Schulangst und am dritten mit Finanzbildung. Das geht nur, wenn du dich sehr schnell und gerne in Themen reinfuchsen kannst.

  • Game- & Systemverständnis: Du kannst Spiele analysieren, Mechaniken erklären und Motivationslogiken bewusst einsetzen. Du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Features. Und nicht zuletzt: Du kannst ein Spiel von A bis Z konzeptionell verantworten – und mit Spiel meinen wir mehr als das Familienfoto-Puzzle zu Weihnachten.

  • Beratungs- & Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit (Konzern-)Kund:innen oder Projektinteressierten auf Augenhöhe sprechen, Anforderungen strukturieren und Komplexität reduzieren. Du überzeugst in Pitches und Workshops. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch.

  • Branchen-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits digitale Produkte oder interaktive Formate konzipiert – und kannst zeigen, was davon funktioniert hat. Im besten Fall kommst du aus dem Gamification- & Serious-Games-Bereich oder arbeitest dich schnell ein.

  • Selbstorganisation & KI-Mindset: Du schaffst dir in unserem kleinen Team selbst Aufgaben und bearbeitest diese eigenständig. Du nutzt KI nicht als Text-Assistent, sondern als ständigen Denk- und Strukturpartner – und bringst damit eigentlich ein Team kleiner Helferlein mit. Viele deiner Tasks, die 2020 noch Wochen und 2023 noch Tage gedauert haben, machst du heute in wenigen Stunden.

  • Tool-Affinität: Tools zur Erstellung digitaler Produkte beherrschst du sicher, allen voran alles, was mit KI zu tun hat. Dich schreckt die Idee nicht ab, dass du ohne fremde Hilfe eine App entwickelst. Du bist uptodate, was heute geht und was morgen gehen wird.

Was wir bieten

  • Spannende & sinnvolle Projekte: Arbeite an innovativen und abwechslungsreichen Projekten mit namhaften Kunden – vom Konzern über Minsterien bis zur Bildungseinrichtung.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten & Teilzeitmodell: Ob in unserem hellen Wohlfühl-Dachgeschoss in Berlin-Mitte oder im Home Office – wir bieten viele Freiheiten.

  • KI-Spielwiese: Wie wir KI bei Pfeffermind einsetzen, gestaltest du maßgeblich mit. Du bekommst die Tools, die du brauchst, und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren.

  • Schnelle Entwicklung & Impact: Regelmäßige Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche, zeitnahe Leitung eigener Projekte mit Verantwortung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Gründer Philipp.

  • … und ein paar Extras: Monatliche Team-Events, voller Charitea-Kühlschrank und eine Credit Card für den monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.

Wenn du noch unsicher bist, erfahre hier mehr darüber, wer wir sind, wie wir arbeiten und was wir bieten. Und wenn das nach einem Match klingt: Bewirb dich hier oder unter ----- Aber bitte nicht nur mit deinem Lebenslauf – zeig’ uns, wie du denkst!

title: Director of Human Resources
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Director of Human Resources to our team in Munich, Germany. Reporting to the Vice President of Human Resources, this role will lead HR management and service delivery for employees and leaders across Germany, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, partnering with local stakeholders and global HR colleagues as the business grows.

This is a hands-on, multi-country HR leadership role for a builder and operator. As the company expands its engineering, operational, and manufacturing capabilities, you will strengthen HR practices across the three countries, support organizational growth, and help managers and employees navigate change.

This position combines regional HR leadership with practical execution. You will partner with the Vice President of Human Resources and leaders across engineering, manufacturing, operations, programs, and corporate functions, staying close to day-to-day needs while implementing people initiatives across our European operations.

The successful candidate will bring strong HR generalist and business-partnering experience in a technically complex environment, a sound understanding of German employment practices, and the ability to manage effective, locally appropriate HR delivery in Switzerland and the United Kingdom. You will balance business priorities, employee experience, compliance, and hands-on delivery without unnecessary bureaucracy.


JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and develop HR colleagues and coordinate local HR support and service partners across Germany, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, establishing clear service expectations, accountability, and responsive support for employees and managers.
  • Oversee country-level HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, payroll and benefits coordination, and local service provider relationships.
  • Implement and improve HR processes, policies, documentation, and workflows that support workforce growth, operational efficiency, and consistent service delivery while accommodating country-specific requirements.
  • Serve as a trusted HR partner to business leaders across Germany, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, providing guidance on workforce planning, organization design, performance management, employee relations, and organizational change.
  • Develop a strong understanding of CesiumAstro's technology, products, programs, customers, and operating priorities while collaborating with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and other functions to address workforce and organizational challenges.

  • Implement consistent approaches to performance management, talent reviews, career development, succession planning, and internal mobility while adapting company frameworks to local employment requirements.
  • Coach managers on employee development, leadership effectiveness, performance conversations, organizational structures, decision rights, and accountability.
  • Identify talent gaps, employee concerns, leadership challenges, and workforce risks while recommending practical actions that strengthen employee engagement, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Partner with global HR, Legal, Finance, country leadership, and local advisers to align HR policies and practices with employment laws, employee representation or consultation requirements, and data protection obligations across Germany, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
  • Support organizational changes and leadership transitions across the three countries, coordinating with global HR, Legal, and employee representatives or consultation bodies where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate HR data across Germany, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, using workforce metrics and people analytics to identify trends, evaluate workforce risks, and inform management decisions.
  • Support workforce requirements across technical and operational teams, including staffing plans, onboarding, employee engagement, retention, and workforce scheduling.
  • Promote CesiumAstro's culture of speed, ownership, technical excellence, and collaboration while strengthening HR service quality, operational consistency, and organizational effectiveness across Europe.

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Law, or a related field with 11–15 years of related experience, or Master's degree in a related field with 9–12 years of related experience in human resources management, HR business partnering, employee relations, workforce planning, organizational development, or a related human resources discipline.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership or management experience leading human resources initiatives, developing HR professionals and managers, or overseeing HR operations and business partnering activities.
  • Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, hardware technology, or another technically complex organization.
  • Experience improving HR programs or processes in a growing organization; experience in a scale-up environment is an advantage.

  • Good working knowledge of German employment law and HR practices, including works council processes where applicable, together with familiarity with the distinct employment, employee consultation, and data protection requirements of Switzerland and the United Kingdom and an ability to engage local experts.
  • Ability to manage sensitive employee relations matters across different legal and cultural environments with discretion, fairness, and sound judgment.
  • Ability to improve HR processes and implement consistent, workable solutions without unnecessary complexity.

title: Director Service Accounts (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Director Service Accounts @ Sereact 🦾

Director Service Accounts (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites across Europe · Reports to the VP Operations · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

The Site Acceptance Test is where a deployment ends and a customer’s operation begins. From that day our robots pick in someone else’s building, every shift, against targets the customer measures. Many of our customers buy Sereact as a service: they pay for robots that work, not for robots that were delivered.

Our deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the site that performs is the site that grows. We now want one leader who owns every live site from SAT on: keeps it at target, brings it everything we ship in software and hardware, speaks for the customer inside Sereact, and turns a working site into a growing one.

The Real-World Learning Loop runs through your sites

Cortex learns from live deployments. Every station at a customer is part of that loop, so a station that is down is more than a service problem: a cell sitting dark is a stopped sensor.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every live station runs the current policy in a real operation. Your surface on it: each site at target, every shift.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: stations that run and stay connected, so the data keeps coming.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Failures and edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: what your sites tell us reaches engineering and research with the context they need.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. Your surface on it: they land in your customers’ operations on a schedule the customer can plan around, with a way back if something is off.

A site that runs well teaches Cortex more, and it grows.

Responsibilities

  • Take over every site at SAT. Set the standard for what a site needs before your team takes it on: documentation, open points, spare parts, contacts and targets. If a site is not ready, it stays with deployment until it is.

  • Keep every site at target. Own each site’s performance against its contract: availability, throughput and pick success. See a problem coming before the customer does, and run the recovery plan when a site falls behind.

  • Run planned change. Software releases and model updates reach customer operations in a rhythm customers can plan around: release notes, change windows, blackout periods, validation on site and a rollback path.

  • Run hardware updates and retrofits across the installed base, from new gripper generations to station upgrades and fixes, with Hardware Engineering and the field teams, without stopping the customer’s operation.

  • Get every site ready for peak: hypercare and coverage plans for the weeks that matter most to our customers, from Black Friday to the January returns wave.

  • Be the customer’s advocate inside Sereact. Bring their priorities into product, R&D, hardware and operations, make sure what we promised at SAT holds, and own the customer communication when something goes wrong.

  • Take each site from SAT to expansion with Strategic Accounts: the performance evidence, the site capacity and the technical plan for the next stations. Strategic Accounts own the contract; you make the expansion ready to happen.

  • Report site health customers trust: one view of every site, monthly performance reports and the operational part of every business review.

  • Build and lead the Service Accounts team: Service Account Managers who each own a portfolio of live sites, and a playbook that still works when the installed base is ten times larger.

  • Work hand in hand with Deployment, Technical Support & Field Service, Hardware Engineering, R&D and Strategic Accounts, so a live site gets one coordinated answer, not five.

Not in scope, by design

  • Deployment up to SAT stays with our deployment teams. You set the bar for what you take over.

  • Incidents, the support desk, field technicians and spare parts logistics stay with Technical Support & Field Service. You own the site; they own the ticket.

  • Contracts, pricing and the expansion deal itself stay with Strategic Accounts. You make the case; they sign it.

  • Product and hardware design stay with engineering. You bring them what the field needs.

What makes this role hard

  • Every change to a live operation is a risk, and not changing is a risk too: the fleet only gets better if updates reach it. You make both safe.

  • Our robots work in other people’s buildings: their WMS, their conveyors, their shift patterns, their peak. Much of what decides a site’s performance is not ours, and it is still your problem.

  • You sit between the customer and our teams. Sometimes the customer’s priority is not ours. You argue for it, or you explain honestly why not.

  • The installed base grows faster than any team. What works by heroics today breaks at ten times the size.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: know every live site and its people; one named owner, one health view and a clear status against target for each; a handover standard at SAT agreed with deployment.

  • By month 6: releases and retrofits in a rhythm customers can plan around; peak season run on hypercare plans; account plans with Strategic Accounts for the largest customers; the first Service Account Managers hired.

  • By month 12: every site at target or on a dated recovery plan; expansions coming out of the installed base; a playbook ready to take to the US.

What you bring

  • 8+ years owning live installations of complex automation after go-live (warehouse automation, intralogistics, robotics or comparable 24/7 systems), as service account manager, technical account manager, customer success or service delivery lead, including at least three years leading a team.

  • You did it while the installed base grew from tens to hundreds of sites, and you built the processes rather than inheriting them.

  • Technical enough to read a log, follow a root cause and hold your own with engineers. Commercial enough to sit with a customer’s operations director and talk performance, cost and growth.

  • You have run releases, upgrades and retrofit programs in live operations without stopping them.

  • Customers trust you because you tell them early and you tell them straight.

  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a plus.

  • You are happy to spend a large part of your week at customer sites.

Nice to have: subscription or Robotics-as-a-Service models · goods-to-person and AS/RS integrations · e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment · experience in both a scale-up and an established automation vendor.

Not the right fit: account management without technical depth, or running a ticket queue without ever owning a customer.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Tell us about a live site that fell behind its targets. What did you change in the first two weeks, and how did it end?

  2. A customer’s peak starts in four weeks. Engineering wants to ship a model update and a gripper retrofit before then. What do you do?

  3. How do you know a site is about to grow, or about to leave, before the customer tells you?

What we offer

  • A fleet in live production that grows every month, and the mandate to build the team that keeps it at target.

  • A key role in the operations leadership of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity.

  • Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site.

  • Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston.

How we hire

Conversations with our VP Operations and the founders, a working session on a real case from one of our live sites, and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast.
