This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Events Supplier Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
The Events Supplier Manager owns Perk Events' global supplier relationships and commercial agreements. Suppliers are the venues, hotels, agencies and event services behind every event we sell: venues, hotel groups, DMCs, catering, AV, transport, entertainment and activities. Most of the focus for this role will be on hotels to start, but with room to expand scope as we grow.

Today, most supplier deals are negotiated event by event by our Events Specialists and Customer Success Managers. This role builds the layer above that. You set the global supplier strategy, secure preferred agreements, build supplier relationships and give the team better rates, terms and margin on every event.

This is a global role, split roughly as follows:

  • Supplier strategy and agreements (60%): decide which suppliers we focus on, negotiate preferred agreements and run the supplier programme.

  • Deal support and performance (40%): help the team win and deliver large or complex events with the best rates/terms possible, and track how suppliers perform.

What You’ll Do

Supplier strategy

  • Build and own our preferred supplier programme across our key event markets globally.

  • Decide where we need more supply, using data on what customers ask for and where we lose deals

  • Set clear supplier tiers, with defined benefits for the suppliers that bring us the most business

  • Partner with Perk Supplier Relations team to ensure we have a consistent supplier strategy across transient and Groups/MICE business

Negotiation and agreements

  • Negotiate preferred agreements with venues, hotel groups, DMCs and other suppliers: rates, commission, payment terms, cancellation and attrition terms, and added extras for customers

  • Agree group and room block terms, working with the Hotel Supplier Partnerships team so hotel partners hear from one Perk

  • Manage renewals and renegotiate when terms or volumes change

  • Own contract templates and keep supplier terms consistent

Supporting the team

  • Join negotiations on large or complex events when Events Specialists and CSMs need support

  • Give the team a simple guide to preferred suppliers and the best deal for each type of event

  • Provide training to upskill our Events Specialists and CSMs on supplier negotiation

  • Pass on supplier feedback and market changes (pricing, availability, new venues) to keep the Events team informed

  • Partner with our dedicated Builders squad to shape our product, ensuring that your work with suppliers connects with customer experience in the product

Supplier performance

  • Track each supplier's volume, margin, commission, customer feedback and delivery quality

  • Run regular reviews with top suppliers, provide reporting, feedback and act when quality drops

  • Check new suppliers before we work with them: insurance, licences, financial stability

  • Report on supplier results and opportunities to the Perk Events leadership team

  • Lead Perk Events supplier days, partnering with the Supplier Relations team

Relationships and presence

  • Build long-term relationships with senior contacts at key suppliers

  • Represent Perk Events at industry events, trade shows and supplier visits, with some travel

KPIs

  • Margin and commission earned from suppliers

  • Share of events booked with preferred suppliers

  • Value of savings and extras secured for customers

  • Supplier quality and customer feedback scores

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 to 6+ years in Hotels, MICE, corporate events, hospitality sales, venue sourcing or supplier management

  • Proven record of negotiating commercial agreements with hotels (required), and venues, DMCs or event suppliers (plus)

  • Strong with numbers: comfortable working out margin, commission and the real cost of a deal in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Clear communicator who builds trust with suppliers and colleagues

  • Able to manage many suppliers and deadlines at once, with little supervision

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • Willing to travel to supplier meetings and industry events

Nice to have

  • Experience in an events agency, TMC, hotel sales team or event technology company

  • Salesforce and Cvent experience

  • Event certifications (for example CMP or CMM)

  • Spanish or another European language

  • Strong knowledge of venues and destinations in Europe or North America

What makes you succesfull here?

  • Commercial: you know what a good deal looks like and push for it

  • Relationship-focused: suppliers want to work with you

  • Practical: you build simple processes the team actually uses, you are ready to build a new program from scratch

  • An owner: you take responsibility for supplier results, good and bad

  • Collaborative: you work as one team with Events Specialists, CSMs, Account Managers and Hotel Supplier Partnerships

  • Ready to build: comfortable in a scale-up that moves fast, you are excited to proactively define new processes rather than being given a playbook.

Why Perk Events?

  • Build the supplier programme for a new and growing part of Perk

  • See your work in the numbers: better margin, better rates, happier customers

  • Work alongside Events, Account Management and Hotel Supplier Partnerships as one connected group

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will do

  • Assist in the preparation of financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.

  • Support financial analysis efforts by gathering and analyzing financial data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Help maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and accounting standards.

  • Support the accounts payable and accounts receivable functions by processing invoices, payments, and receipts.

  • Assist in the preparation of tax filings and compliance activities, including gathering supporting documentation and completing forms.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Growth, Operations, Tech) to support financial projects and initiatives as needed.

 

Who you are

  • Currently enrolled (or recently graduated) in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

  • Excellent English and German skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and draw meaningful insights.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial analysis tools.

  • Knowledge of accounting principles and practices.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €2.4K per month

title: FinTech Operations Graduate (Customer Support)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

  • Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

  • Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

  • Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

  • Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

  • Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

  • Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

  • Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues


What we're looking for

Essential

  • Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

  • The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

  • Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

  • Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

  • Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

  • Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

  • Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

  • A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how


Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.Interview process


Our Interview Process

We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Make Everything Just Work

Most jobs ask you to keep the lights on. This one asks you to build the machine that keeps an entire company and its customers running.

At Reonic, we’re building the AI operating system for renewable installers, with competitive pay, growth opportunities and a strong culture based on ambition, impact and ownership. And we’re doing it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’re where our product meets the real world. You work hands-on with renewable energy installers and their technical teams, help them build on our API, and solve the problems that stand between them and a setup that just works. Around 80% of your time is spent with customers. The other 20% goes to making Reonic itself run the way an AI-first company should.

What you'll do

With our customers (~80%)

  • Enable our API users: Work with customers’ technical teams as they build on our API and webhooks. Review their approach, answer the tricky questions and get them unblocked fast.

  • Solve problems end to end: When something breaks, you find out why. Reproduce the issue, work with engineering on the fix and keep the customer in the loop until it’s solved.

  • Connect Reonic to their world: Make Reonic work seamlessly with the tools our customers rely on every day, from Microsoft and Google to their CRM, accounting and automation platforms.

  • Make customers self-sufficient: Write guides, examples and snippets that help customers help themselves.

Inside Reonic (~20%)

  • Run our AI tools: Own our Claude and ChatGPT workspaces, from access and connectors to costs.

  • Make AI part of everyone’s job: Help colleagues build integrations, connectors and automations that save them real time.

  • Own our IT setup: Keep our tools, devices and security running smoothly, so everyone at Reonic can do their best work from day one.

What makes you a great fit

  • Technical understanding: You’re comfortable with APIs, webhooks and authentication flows such as OAuth, and you aren’t afraid to dig into the details.

  • AI and automation enthusiasm: You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier or n8n every day and enjoy finding new ways to automate work.

  • Customer orientation: You’d rather solve a problem together on a call than send another ticket reply, and you can explain technical topics in a way non-technical people understand.

  • Microsoft 365 expertise: You have hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and you’re the person others turn to when something in the Microsoft world doesn’t work.

  • Strong communication: Fluent German and C2 English proficiency are required.

  • Nice to have: TypeScript knowledge, experience with Apple Mobile Device Management, and experience with any of the systems we integrate with, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Workspace, lexoffice or sevdesk.

You’ll thrive here if you…

  • Can’t stand a broken process, and fix it before anyone else notices

  • See a messy setup as a challenge, not a reason to complain

  • Automate anything you’ve done twice

  • Would rather get sh*t done than talk about getting it done

  • Are the one friends and colleagues call when their tech doesn’t work

If you want a quiet IT job with a ticket queue, this isn’t it.
If you want to be the reason things run smoothly at a fast-growing company, you’ll love it.

Why join now

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, so your work reaches real users with real-world impact.

  • High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, internally and with our customers.

  • Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering, product and customer teams, make decisions quickly, and see the results of your work right away.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Gym membership or transportation ticket: Pick between Urban Sports Club or Deutschland ticket.

  • Late nights covered: Uber Eats and Uber rides on us when you finish late.

  • Great setup: MacBook, regular team events, coffee and other perks.

  • Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn’t hold you back — we value talent and passion above all.

About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses: from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Location

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg or Berlin.

Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own getting Boltz Lab running inside our enterprise customers' environments, and keeping it running. Large pharma partners often need our platform deployed in their own cloud or tenant, and how fast and smoothly we do that decides how quickly they can start real discovery work; our goal is a full enterprise deployment in under 30 days.

You will work closely with customers' IT, security and cloud teams, our Platform and Product engineers, and our Commercial team.

This role is ideal for someone who likes being the engineer in the room with the customer, is calm when a deployment breaks, and turns every hard install into a faster one next time.

What you'll do

  • Lead deployments of Boltz Lab into customer cloud environments and dedicated tenants, from kickoff to acceptance.

  • Work through each customer's networking, identity, security and compliance requirements, and track blockers to resolution.

  • Support live tenants against agreed service targets: monitoring, upgrades, incident response and root-cause fixes.

  • Automate what you learn into infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and runbooks, so each deployment takes less time than the last.

  • Bring what you see in the field back to Platform and Product, from missing features to security and compliance needs (including our SOC 2 and ISO work).

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience deploying and operating production software on cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP or Azure), as a DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or solutions engineer. We're hiring at Junior to Senior level.

  • Hands-on with Kubernetes, Docker and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), plus solid Linux, networking and scripting (Python or Bash).

  • Working knowledge of enterprise security: identity and SSO, network isolation, secrets management and access control.

  • A track record of getting deployments or migrations over the line under real constraints and deadlines.

  • Clear, confident communication with technical customers, and the judgment to know when to escalate.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering role (forward deployed, solutions or implementation engineering), especially with pharma, biotech or other regulated enterprises.

  • Experience running GPU workloads, or ML systems in production; exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar compliance work.

  • Early-stage startup experience; experience using Boltz models or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Own how Boltz Lab reaches the world's leading pharma teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview: a deployment and troubleshooting scenario

  3. Onsite in London with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

The role

We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.

This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.

You'll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We're looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management.

What you'll do

  • Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel.
  • Start every initiative with why. Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it's worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy. Fospha's business strategy hinges on its product strategy, so every initiative should trace back to it. Say no to good ideas that aren't the most important thing.
  • Stay close to clients. Don't wait to be invited: set up your own client calls as well as joining others', run interviews and prototype sessions, and pair what clients tell you with what the usage data shows. Know what clients see on screen and what they do with it.
  • Decide quickly on imperfect information. Know when the evidence is strong enough to act, make the call, and change course when the evidence changes, including stopping work that isn't landing.
  • Work AI-first. Use AI to compress discovery synthesis, analysis, spec writing and stakeholder communication. Build and refine your own agents, workflows and prototypes, and work with engineers on what can be prototyped with AI coding tools. Share what works with other PMs and feed improvements back to Product Ops, so the whole team gets faster.
  • Prove it worked. Set success thresholds before build starts, check adoption and usage after release, and act on the result. Shipped is not the same as worked.
  • Give people what they need to decide. Know what information a decision-maker needs at each point, and give them exactly that: a one-line recommendation for an exec, the full detail for an engineer. Present with confidence to senior leaders, internally and at clients.
  • Raise the bar. Give direct, useful feedback, take it well, and hold your own work to a high standard.

What you'll bring (must-haves)

  1. 3+ years as a Product Manager, or in an adjacent role with experience you can clearly apply to product management. Either way, you can point to problems you owned end to end: deciding what to do, getting it delivered, and measuring whether it worked against success criteria set upfront.
  2. 2+ years making decisions from data yourself - product analytics (funnels, usage, retention) and commercial data - pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting for an analyst.
  3. A track record of connecting your work to commercial outcomes. You've sized opportunities in revenue or retention terms, built business cases, and shaped pricing, packaging or monetisation decisions with commercial teams.
  4. Hands-on client experience. You've run customer discovery, joined sales and account calls, and turned what clients experience into a clear, evidenced problem statement.
  5. Confidence in presenting to peers and senior stakeholders. You're confident making and presenting recommendations to leaders across the business, advocating for data-backed decisions.
  6. Deep, everyday use of AI in your work. You can describe specific workflows, agents or tools you've built or configured, the work they replaced, and how you check their output.

How you work

  • Conscientious. You close loops, follow through on what you said you'd do, and catch data or quality issues before they reach a client.
  • Relentless about prioritisation. You can explain why this, why now and what it's worth, and you're comfortable leaving lower-value work undone.
  • Decisive. You'd rather make a well-reasoned call today than a perfect one next month, and you're open about the assumptions behind it.
  • Analytical. You break a problem down, work out what would need to be true, and go and find the data to test it.
  • Clear and concise. You write and present crisply, lead with the recommendation, and cut what the audience doesn't need.
  • Open on feedback. You give it directly and kindly, ask for it, and act on it.
  • A doer. You'd rather build a prototype and a short one-pager than write an extensive PRD about one.

Nice to have

  • Product experience within a complicated B2B data platform business.
  • Product experience within marketing or advertising technology.

Benefits (UK)

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal - Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year

  • Opportunities to travel - including to our India and North America offices

descriptionHtml:
Join Ark at an exciting stage and learn first-hand how a startup is built.

Ark builds platforms for public administrations. We entered the market about a year ago with our best-known tool, a platform for local climate action, and now work with more than 60 cities, counties and states, from Schleswig-Holstein, Munich and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised €2.4 million in pre-seed and grant funding and are approaching €1 million in annual revenue.

As our Founders Associate Intern (all genders), you work side by side with our Chief of Staff Lennart, who is your day-to-day lead, and team up with our founder & CEO Ruth on selected projects. Your week has two halves. In the mornings you are part of our growth team and help win new public administrations as customers. This is the core of the role. In the afternoons you work with Lennart on whatever matters most for the company at that moment, from strategy and finance to HR and company initiatives.

You will see from the inside how a fast-growing GovTech startup wins customers, makes decisions and builds its team. If you are thinking about founding your own company one day, there are few better places to learn.

Tasks

Joining Ark as a Founders Associate Intern means a new mix of topics every week. Here is a range of potential challenges:

You learn how public sector sales work and see your impact in our pipeline every week. You'll receive a bonus for each qualified demo booked.

  • Strategy: Work with Lennart on strategic questions, prepare analyses and decision papers for management and turn decisions into concrete next steps.

title: Founding Customer Success Manager (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.

We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

You will be our first dedicated Customer Success hire. Initially, you will work hands-on with customers while building the playbooks, processes, and team that will eventually allow Customer Success to scale.

This is not a reactive support role. You will become a trusted partner to customers, help them embed BoWatt into real engineering workflows, and take responsibility for adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Build BoWatt’s Customer Success playbook, including onboarding, success planning, account reviews, health metrics, renewals, and expansion

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s software, customers, and target industries

During your first six months, you will work closely with our CEO and Product team to develop the product, industry, and customer knowledge needed to take ownership of increasingly complex customers.

You

  • You genuinely enjoy working with customers and building strong, long-term relationships

  • You care about whether customers achieve meaningful outcomes—not simply whether meetings happen

  • You communicate confidently and can build trust with technical users, internal champions, and senior executives

  • You are highly structured and take ownership of driving customer initiatives to completion

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and willing to go the extra mile to make customers successful

  • You want to build a function rather than inherit an established playbook

  • You want to grow into a domain expert across our software, customers, and industry

Requirements

  • At least two years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing B2B software role

  • Alternatively, relevant experience in a technical customer-facing role at an industrial manufacturer, engineering company, or technology business

  • Experience onboarding customers and driving ongoing product adoption

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders and customer initiatives in parallel

  • The ability to understand technical products and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Four days per week in our Munich office at Balanstraße

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • A clear path towards leading Customer Success as BoWatt grows

  • Significant ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to customers, Product, Engineering, and the founders

  • The opportunity to build BoWatt’s Customer Success function from the ground up

  • Company retreats

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, building the function, and being responsible for its results.

 

As our founding Customer Success hire, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and have the opportunity to build Customer Success from the ground up. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

title: Founding Engineer, AI on CAD Geometry
descriptionHtml:
Founding engineer: AI that reads mechanical designs (Berlin ):

LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manufacture and own.

We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing. Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform.

The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ER and PLM systems.

What you would own:

  • The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling.

  • The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions.

  • Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline.

  • Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not.

  • Reasoning Engine and live context retriever

Who you probably are:

  • Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now.

  • You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five.

  • Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000.

  • You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks.

  • Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing

Nice to have:

  • OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience.

  • MCP servers, agent tooling, or LLM-in-the-loop CAD work.

Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the thrid engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top.

title: Founding Full Stack Engineer – AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Berlin · Full-time · Start ASAP

About Limetax

Limetax is building the agentic-first accounting and tax group for German SMEs.

We acquire established accounting and tax advisory firms and onboard them to our proprietary agentic platform, combining deep industry expertise with AI-native technology.

Backed by $40m in equity and debt from top-tier investors, we're building and scaling a new kind of accounting & tax group in Germany.

Our founders bring significant experience across M&A, operations, and AI-native technology, having previously built and scaled unicorns, Razor Group and Augustus.

The Role

As a Founding Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product our tax professionals use every day, from databases and backend services to the interfaces and AI features that bring it together.

Your initial focus will be bookkeeping: understanding how documents become accounting entries, where manual work slows people down, and how software and AI can make the process better.

You'll work directly with tax professionals to understand their workflows, decide what's worth building, and turn ambiguous problems into useful product features. You'll prototype quickly, test with users, and take what works into reliable production.

You'll work closely with our engineering team and founders, with real ownership of the features you ship and how they perform in practice.

What You'll Work On

  • Full-stack Product Engineering. Build complete features across our TypeScript stack, with React on the frontend and NestJS on the backend. Own the user experience, APIs, and data model together.

  • Bookkeeping Workflows. Build systems for document processing, booking proposals, review, and accounting integrations. Make workflows and their exceptions explicit so users and engineers can understand how they work.

  • Applied AI. Build LLM-powered features, agents, and retrieval systems that reduce manual work. Decide where AI adds value, where deterministic logic is needed, and where users should stay in control.

  • Rapid Prototyping. Turn user problems into small, working versions quickly. Use modern development tools, including AI coding tools, to experiment, learn, and improve what you ship.

  • Backend & Data Integrity. Design APIs, relational data models, and integrations with systems such as DATEV. Handle validation, duplicate processing, and failures deliberately.

  • Production Ownership. Take features through testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Evaluate AI behavior against real examples and investigate failures across the stack.

  • Direct User Feedback. Stay close to German-speaking tax professionals, understand what helps them, and use their feedback to guide the next improvement.

Your Profile

  • You are a strong software engineer. You have shipped full-stack products that real users rely on. You're comfortable writing frontend code and have strong backend, API, SQL, and database design skills.

  • You have strong product intuition. You ask why a problem matters, challenge assumptions, and choose a useful first version. You care about whether people can use what you build and whether it improves their work.

  • You have high agency. You move from an unclear problem to working software, make pragmatic decisions, and take responsibility for your delivery. You enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches.

  • You make complex workflows understandable. You can explain the process, sketch its states and exceptions when useful, and communicate what changed and how you validated it. You keep this practical and lightweight.

  • You build with AI. You have hands-on experience building features with LLMs, agents, or AI-enabled workflows, and understand their limitations. Experience operating these features in production is a plus.

  • You care about reliability. You know when a quick prototype is enough and what needs to change before users depend on it, especially when handling financial data.

  • You speak professional German and fluent English. You can work directly with our tax advisory teams in German and collaborate with our engineering team in English. You're based in Berlin or willing to relocate for on-site work.

Why Limetax

  • Immediate operational impact. Build software that directly changes how accounting and tax work gets done.

  • End-to-end ownership. Take features from understanding the workflow through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.

  • Tight feedback loops. Work directly with the people using your product, with access to real workflows, documents, and domain expertise.

  • Applied AI in production. Solve problems where accuracy, reliability, and human judgment matter.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Das baust du mit uns auf

Wo kann KI unseren Kunden weiterhelfen und unseren Mitarbeitenden Arbeit abnehmen? Du entwickelst die Lösungen dafür.

Wir bauen ein neues digitales Brokerage auf - mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Als AI Engineer gestaltest du von Anfang an mit, wo und wie wir Sprachmodelle sinnvoll einsetzen: vom Kundenservice-Assistenten bis zur automatisierten Dokumentenverarbeitung. Dabei bringst du praktische Umsetzung, nachvollziehbare Ergebnisse und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten zusammen.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

  • Du entwickelst Anwendungen auf Basis großer Sprachmodelle (LLMs), beispielsweise Kundenservice-Assistenten, FAQ-Bots auf geprüftem Wissen, Dokumentenverarbeitung oder interne Assistenz für die Fachbereiche.

  • Du stellst interne KI-Tools bereit und automatisierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen wiederkehrende Abläufe durch Assistenten und Workflows.

  • Du baust Wissensbasen für KI-Anwendungen auf und bindest sie über Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) an. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass relevante Informationen auffindbar und aktuell bleiben.

  • Du gestaltest Prompts, Workflows und technische Leitplanken (Guardrails), um fehlerhafte Antworten zu begrenzen, Quellen nachvollziehbar zu machen und vorgegebene Nutzungsgrenzen umzusetzen.

  • Du bindest Sprachmodelle gemeinsam mit den IT- und Plattformteams an bestehende Systeme und Datenquellen an und begleitest die Anwendungen in den produktiven Einsatz.

  • Du testest die Anwendungen anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle, wertest Fehler und Nutzerfeedback aus und verbesserst Antworten und Abläufe gezielt.

  • Du bewertest neue KI-Tools und Modelle pragmatisch nach Nutzen, Qualität, Aufwand und Kosten.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem AI Quality & Governance Specialist, der Informationssicherheit und dem Datenschutz zusammen und setzt abgestimmte Anforderungen technisch um.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast KI- oder Automatisierungsanwendungen praktisch umgesetzt und bereits eigene Lösungen von der Anforderung bis zur Nutzung begleitet.

  • Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung mit.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Schnittstellen, Retrieval-Augmented Generation und Prompt-Design.

  • Du setzt KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Abläufe sicher in Python um und arbeitest dabei mit geeigneten Frameworks und Workflow-Tools, beispielsweise LangChain oder n8n.

  • Du verstehst die Grenzen von Sprachmodellen und kannst Antworten, Fehlerfälle und die Qualität eingebundener Wissensquellen kritisch beurteilen.

  • Du kennst die für deine Arbeit relevanten Anforderungen aus Datenschutz und EU AI Act und kannst sie gemeinsam mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern in technische Lösungen übersetzen.

  • Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, erklärst KI verständlich und entwickelst Lösungen im engen Austausch mit den späteren Nutzern.

  • Du bist neugierig, testest Ideen zügig und entwickelst sie anhand von Ergebnissen und Feedback weiter.

  • Du arbeitest pragmatisch, eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert, setzt klare Prioritäten und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Anwendungen im Finanzsektor oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenservice-Assistenten, Dokumentenverarbeitung oder internen Wissensassistenten.

  • Erfahrung mit systematischen Tests und der laufenden Überwachung von LLM-Anwendungen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Raum für deine Ideen: Hier kannst du nicht nur mitreden, sondern mitgestalten. Deine Ideen sind gefragt und du hast die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln.

Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbruchstimmung treffen auf die Sicherheit und Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Deine Benefits

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten.

title: Global Network Growth Executive Director
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

The Role

As the Growth Network Director, you will hold one of the most senior and consequential commercial roles within WPP Enterprise Solutions. You will be responsible for turning the most valuable market signals, client relationships, and WPP network intelligence into high-quality, strategically shaped growth opportunities and for creating the momentum that moves them from first conversation to qualified pursuit.

Operating at the intersection of consultative selling, transformation strategy, and executive relationship management, you will bring a rare combination of commercial instinct and intellectual rigour. You do not wait for a brief to arrive fully formed. You identify signals others miss, impose strategic clarity where ambiguity exists, shape the opportunity narrative before the client has fully articulated the need, and mobilise the right combination of WPP expertise around a live, credible commercial path. This is enterprise growth leadership in its most active and most demanding form.

Working fluidly across WPP Network Growth, you will engage at the highest levels of the organisation and the market, operating credibly alongside Global Client Leads, agency CEOs, senior client stakeholders, consulting and technology partners, and ES capability heads. Your effectiveness will be measured not by the volume of relationships you manage, but by the quality of the opportunities you originate, the rigour with which you qualify and shape them, and your ability to connect the right people, at the right moment, around the right commercial proposition.

Core Responsibilities

Generate:

  • Proactively identify and progress high-value opportunities across existing WPP relationships, direct enterprise demand, senior stakeholder networks and strategic market signals, converting early intelligence into commercially viable pursuits before the opportunity has fully formed
  • Build genuine, durable trust at the highest levels with Global Client Leads, agency leaders, WPP Media, WPP Creative, WPP Open, consulting and alliance partners, and senior client stakeholders, creating the access and relationships that sustain commercial momentum over time
  • Assess each live opportunity with commercial discipline and strategic clarity, evaluating client need, ES relevance, revenue potential, urgency, stakeholder access, winnability and the required path to activation so that the team's energy is concentrated where it matters most

Shape:

  • Translate ambiguous client problems into a clear, compelling Enterprise Solutions opportunity narrative, spanning CRM, commerce, CX, content, data, AI, platforms, marketing technology, managed services and operating model transformation, making the complex feel navigable and the case for action feel urgent
  • Lead the pursuit strategy for priority opportunities from end to end; owning problem framing, stakeholder mapping, commercial logic, solution direction, proof points and activation needs and carry that strategy through to a result
  • Know exactly when and how to bring in solution, commercial, technical, delivery, alliance and subject-matter expertise, assembling the right combination of people at the right point in the opportunity lifecycle, not before they add value and not after the moment has passed

Activate & Lead:

  • Provide clear, decisive leadership readouts on priority opportunities, covering blockers, decision points, commercial potential, next actions and escalation needs and ensuring senior stakeholders always have an accurate, current picture of where the most important pursuits stand
  • Help define how WPP Enterprise Solutions shows up to the network and to enterprise clients as a credible transformation and growth partner, contributing not just to individual opportunities but to the commercial infrastructure and positioning that makes future growth possible
  • Set a high bar for MD and Group Director colleagues across opportunity quality, client readiness, strategic thinking and commercial discipline, multiplying your impact well beyond your own pipeline and raising the performance of the team around you

Who you are

  • You are an executive-level growth leader with a demonstrated record of creating and converting large enterprise opportunities, not inheriting them
  • You operate with credibility in complex matrix environments, moving fluently across consulting, technology, agency, platform, media, creative and client leadership groups, adapting your register without losing your point of view
  • You are commercially sharp and consultative in equal measure, equally comfortable shaping a transformation strategy at the outset and driving the commercial execution that turns it into a win
  • Your executive presence is substantive, not performative. You can simplify complex transformation topics for senior client and internal audiences without losing the depth that makes your perspective worth having
  • You are an entrepreneurial operator, capable of building a new growth motion from the ground up while advancing live opportunities that cannot wait for the infrastructure to be in place

What you'll need

  • You typically bring 15 or more years of experience across enterprise growth, transformation consulting, technology consulting, digital transformation, marketing transformation, integrated agency leadership, strategic sales or complex client leadership, with a career that has consistently placed you in rooms where large, complex decisions were being made
  • You have worked directly with C-suite and senior enterprise stakeholders across marketing, technology, customer, operations, data, AI, commerce and transformation agendas and with enough regularity that it is your natural operating environment, not an occasional stretch
  • Your background may have been built inside a consulting firm, systems integrator, technology business, digital transformation firm, large agency network, media network, WPP operating company or enterprise sales organisation. The path matters less than what it gave you: commercial depth, network credibility and the strategic range to operate at the level this role demands
  • You have direct experience shaping large pursuits, managing strategic accounts, navigating multi-market opportunities, driving partner-led growth or leading multi-capability transformation programmes, and you understand the difference between being close to those efforts and being accountable for them
  • You hold yourself and others to a high standard across revenue accountability, pipeline discipline, complex stakeholder management and opportunity qualification, not as processes you follow, but as disciplines that define how you work

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: GRC Automation Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We’ve consolidated separate compliance programs (Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail, and Superhuman Go) into a single program. We’re rapidly replacing the point-in-time approaches with continuous, automated, code-defined evidence, and this role continues to build on that.

The job is to automate your way out of the manual toil: our GRC automation platform is the evidence-automation backbone, agentic systems (Claude Code and similar) are the force multiplier, and GitHub is where the program lives as code. If your instinct on seeing a manual control-testing process is to turn it into a repeatable, automated pipeline, this role is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Automate evidence collection. Configure and operate the GRC automation platform: wire up data sources, build evidence plugins, scope data sets, author analysis rules, and stand up continuous monitoring operations, replacing screenshot-and-upload workflows with automated collectors mapped to controls.

  • Automate GRC workflows and run compliance as code. Use Claude Code (or similar) and MCPs for evidence requests, control mapping, gap analysis, vendor reviews, and reporting; build and curate the team’s agent harness; and manage policies, control definitions, and automation in GitHub through branches, pull requests, and review.

  • Design control testing and drive remediation. Instrument testing across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and ISO 42001 for continuous assurance rather than point-in-time snapshots, and work with control owners and engineering to close gaps with automated evidence behind every finding.

What Ramping Up Looks Like:

You will be configuring our GRC automation platform, not just clicking through it, within your first few weeks. In your first 90 days, we’d expect you to learn the platform configuration, ship your first automated evidence collectors, retire a batch of manual screenshot evidence, and get at least one agent-assisted workflow running end-to-end.

Why This Role:

  • You’ll design the automation architecture for compliance across four products, rather than maintaining an existing checklist.

  • You get the mandate and the tooling to retire manual evidence collection: a GRC automation platform, agentic AI, and compliance-as-code.

  • We actually run LLMs and AI agents in production GRC workflows today. This is how the team operates day-to-day.

  • Small team, high ownership, and a direct line to Legal and Engineering leadership. You’ll shape the program, not just sustain it.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in compliance, GRC, or IT audit, hands-on with the frameworks above (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and adjacent).

  • 1+ year using agentic AI systems (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to do real compliance work, with automation you have delivered, not just prototypes.

  • Comfortable in GitHub: repos, branches, pull requests, and code review. CI/CD familiarity is a strong plus.

  • Fast on new tooling. You can pick up a GRC automation platform and be productive in weeks, configuring it directly rather than relying on others to do so.

  • Deep GRC fluency: control design, evidence, risk, and how auditors actually think.

  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP): IAM, compute, storage, networking, and security controls, because that’s where the evidence lives.

  • Systems thinker who prefers to automate repetitive manual work rather than repeat it.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Reads APIs, JSON, and logs comfortably; scripting (Python, bash, TypeScript).

  • Prior hands-on experience with a GRC automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or similar).

  • Scripting/light coding and API integration experience.

  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or similar.

  • AI governance, AI risk management, or ISO 42001 exposure.

  • Background in a technology, SaaS, or engineering-adjacent environment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.
