title: GRC Lead
descriptionHtml:
GRC Lead

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Legal touches everything that matters in a business: every deal, every hire, every launch, every risk. Sales runs on Salesforce. Engineering runs on GitHub. In-house legal runs on inboxes, chat threads and tools that weren’t built for it.
Wordsmith is changing that. We’re building the platform in-house legal runs on.

Requests from across the business come in through one front door. AI agents handle the routine work. Lawyers stay in control where judgment matters. Legal finally gets to triage by risk, not by whoever shouted loudest.

We’re built for in-house teams, not law firms. Our customers want to spend less on outside counsel, not more, and we’re on their side of that equation.

More than 500 companies run on Wordsmith, including Financial Times, Canva, Trip.com, Revolut, Adyen, Trustpilot, and Sage. We’ve raised $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, and we’re growing fast.

Our customers are some of the most demanding enterprise legal departments in the world, and they hold us to a high bar on security, privacy, and responsible AI.

We're looking for a senior leader to take ownership of security and compliance as we scale.

The Role

GRC Leads own security and compliance at Wordsmith end-to-end — setting the strategy for IT and infrastructure security, running our certification program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001, embedding responsible-AI practices into how we build and ship product, and making sure privacy and regulatory obligations (GDPR and beyond) are handled properly as we grow.

This is a senior role that blends strategy and hands-on execution. You'll set multi-year direction, represent Wordsmith's security posture to executives, customers, and — as we grow — the board, and build the team, tooling, and controls the company needs at the next stage, not just maintain what exists today.

What You'll Do

Security Strategy & Leadership

  • Own Wordsmith's multi-year IT security and compliance roadmap — setting priorities, budget, and tooling decisions in partnership with Engineering and company leadership.

IT & Infrastructure Security

  • Own security architecture across corporate IT and infrastructure — identity & access management, endpoint protection, and cloud/network security — and lead incident response when issues arise.

Compliance & Certification

  • Own SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27017/27018, and ISO 42001 end-to-end — policies, controls, audit evidence, and the audits themselves.

AI Governance

  • Run our AI governance program, including AI Impact Assessments and model/AI-vendor risk reviews, ensuring responsible, compliant AI use across the product.

Privacy Operations

  • Own privacy operations end-to-end — GDPR and other regulatory obligations, DPIAs, RoPA maintenance, sub-processor management, and Data Subject Request fulfilment.

Third-Party & Vendor Risk

  • Assess vendors and AI tools for security, privacy, and AI risk before they're adopted, and put the right contractual safeguards in place at a program level.

Team & Function Building

  • Build the people, process, and tooling the function needs as it scales — starting as the senior owner of the program today, with a mandate to build out a team as Wordsmith grows.

Executive & Board Reporting

  • Own risk and compliance reporting to leadership and, as we scale, the board — translating technical risk into business terms.

Customer & Deal Support

  • Act as the senior voice on security for enterprise deals — security questionnaires, DPAs, and our Trust Center — partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Legal to unblock deals without cutting corners.

Automation & Tooling

  • Build lean, automation-first tooling (e.g. Vanta) for evidence collection and ongoing compliance monitoring, so the program scales without scaling headcount unnecessarily.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 8-10+ years in security, IT, or compliance roles, including a track record of owning a security or compliance function end-to-end at a fast-growing SaaS or tech company.

  • Proven experience building or scaling a security/compliance program from an early stage — ideally including time as the sole or founding owner of the function.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 series, and ideally ISO 42001.

  • Strong grounding in core IT security fundamentals — identity & access management, endpoint/device security, and cloud or network infrastructure security.

  • Practical, working knowledge of GDPR and related privacy regulation (ePrivacy or similar).

  • Experience presenting security posture, risk, and roadmap to executives, boards, or investors.

  • Experience building and/or managing a team — or a clear point of view on how you'd grow one as the function scales.

  • Comfortable owning budget and vendor decisions at a strategic level, not just executing against someone else's plan.

  • A strong cross-functional operator and executive communicator, bridging Security, IT, Legal/Privacy, Engineering, and GTM.

Valued

  • Prior experience as a Head of Security, Director of Security/IT, or similar senior/leadership title.

  • Relevant certifications — e.g. CISSP/ISC2, CISM, AIGP, CIPP/E, CIPT, CCSK, or FIP.

  • Experience in legal tech, AI, or another highly regulated SaaS environment.

  • Experience designing AI risk or impact-assessment processes from scratch.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Datagrail, MineOS, Whistic, or SafeBase.

Why this role matters

You'll take a senior leadership seat over security and compliance, with real ownership over how the function is shaped and grown.

You'll sit at the centre of trust for a fast-growing legal AI platform, directly enabling enterprise sales and customer confidence.

You'll have a clear path to building and leading a team as the function scales with the company.

A small, focused leadership group where your work has visible, immediate impact.

Competitive compensation, benefits, and meaningful equity.

How we work

We're an in-office team in Edinburgh. We work together because it helps us collaborate closely across product, engineering, and legal teams. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

This is a high ownership role. You'll be trusted to set strategy, represent security to executives and customers, and drive outcomes without heavy oversight.

title: GTM Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We’re now on the hunt for a brilliant all-rounder who wants to make an enormous impact on Spruce’s growth trajectory as we add thousands of installers over the next 18 months. You’ll work on marketing, commercial strategy, RevOps, reporting & analytics, and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.

This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo getting stuck into pretty much everything that goes on across the growth side of business. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:

  • Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers.

  • Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers.

  • Supporting sales & customer success – building the systems that allow our commercial teams to scale hyper-efficiently and deliver exponentially more value per hour of work they do.

  • Data analysis & reporting – digging into how our customers are using the platform, breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack.

🫵 About You

You’ll have somewhere between 1 and 6 years work experience (doesn’t matter if it’s not directly related to this role) and you’ll ideally be:

  • Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh*t done;

  • A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;

  • Highly analytical — you have a real affinity for numbers, love diving into data, and are comfortable working in Excel;

  • A natural “people person” — you love working with people, find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;

  • An AI whizz – you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;

… and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 Base salary £50-70k, with quarterly bonus aligned to company targets

  • 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • 🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

Compensation: £50K – £70K • Offers Equity • Quarterly bonus linked to company targets

title: Head of Direct Marketing
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Marketing is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Marketing to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment. Addressed direct mail is the core today, and you’ll have the scope to extend into other formats.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct marketing roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build and extend a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct marketing, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Commercial ownership: you build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, and judge results on a marginal CAC basis rather than vanity metrics.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct marketing strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

About the Role

As our Head of People, you’ll own everything related to our growing workforce (65 people today). Compensation, leveling, performance, org design: most of it exists today and yours, and it’s yours to upgrade to make sure it remains best-in-class as we scale. You’ll lead a lean team across Talent Acquisition and Talent Development (2 people for now), work directly with the CEO and Head of Ops, and have a real say in how ScorePlay scales internationally.

It’s also a rare chance to answer a question most People leaders are only starting to ask: what does a high-performing company look like when AI changes roles, team sizes and what we hire for?

This is a hands-on builder role. You’ll design the frameworks yourself, make decisions with data and ship them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organizational design & workforce planning: Design organizational structure, spans, team composition, and headcount plans as we scale, including how AI changes roles, team sizes, and what we hire for.

  • Performance, leveling & talent management: Build consistent leveling and performance frameworks across functions. Oversee performance cycles and calibration, and own talent reviews, succession planning, and the resolution of legacy leveling inconsistencies.

  • Compensation, equity & benefits: Build competitive, internally consistent compensation bands, equity frameworks, and regional benefits. Own compensation benchmarking, offer governance, and compensation cost discipline, with particular attention to US-market competitiveness.

  • Hiring strategy & talent standards: Define hiring priorities, workforce needs, and senior hiring, and set a consistently high talent bar, including AI fluency.

  • High-performer retention & growth: Identify and retain top talent, build meaningful career paths, and own succession and development plans. Monitor regretted attrition and address systemic retention risks.

  • Manager effectiveness: Equip managers to hire, develop, evaluate, and retain strong teams. Set practical management standards and oversee manager development, with clear accountability for performance and people decisions.

  • Culture & organizational health: Maintain a cohesive, high-performance culture across regions and hybrid teams. Identify and address organizational friction, engagement risks, and gaps in accountability or collaboration.

  • People analytics & governance: Define clear People KPIs, review cadence, and decision frameworks. Lead strategic employment-structure decisions, including entity/EOR considerations, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

  • People function leadership: Lead and develop the People team, ensuring strong execution of recruiting, employee lifecycle, employee relations, compliance, and HR operations through the team and appropriate external experts.

Qualifications

  • Experience building People programs in high-growth tech companies, ideally with 8+ years of progressive experience across People Operations, People Strategy, HRBP, or related roles.

  • Proven ability to design and implement People frameworks, in at least two of the following areas: compensation and job leveling, performance management and calibration, talent development, or organizational design.

  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to use data to diagnose organizational problems, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations that balance employee experience, performance, and financial discipline.

  • A first managerial experience required, having led and developed at least a small People or HR team.

  • Comfort operating hands-on in a lean, fast-moving organization, building practical first versions of processes and systems rather than relying on large teams or extensive external support.

Why ScorePlay?

  • Join at a pivotal moment: the V1s are live and working well, and now we’re building the next version together as we scale fast

  • A global People agenda: teams in Paris, New York and across Europe, with US and European comp, employment and culture questions on your desk.

  • Real influence: you’ll work with the CEO and Head of Ops and bring People expertise into the decisions that shape the company.

  • A high bar: the goal is to have the best possible person in every seat, and you set the standard for what that means.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

title: Head of Software Architecture (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Minerva is STARK’s command‑and‑control software — the system that connects operators to autonomous platforms across multiple domains in real time. Our team is a small, senior group based in Berlin and Munich, working closely with hardware, autonomy, and systems engineering to deliver mission‑critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments. We operate under constraints most engineers never encounter: low‑bandwidth networks, air‑gapped devices, and high‑stakes decision loops. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.

YOUR MISSION

This is not a standard engineering role; it is a high‑impact leadership position at the intersection of hardware, software, and human factors. We have world‑class architects leading separate workstreams across C2, Perception, and Autonomy. As Head of Software Architecture, your mission is to lead, align, and govern these architectural workstreams under a unified, delivery-focused engineering strategy that results in concrete artifacts, architecture diagrams, and actionable software components. You will set the architectural direction for STARK’s software ecosystem, ensure coherence across domains, and provide the systems‑engineering rigor required to meet the complex requirements of our customers. You will not only unify architecture - you will own it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  1. Architectural Alignment & Leadership
  • Software System Engineering — You will act as the System Engineer on the software side, responsible for defining the V-Model process, leading requirements engineering, and directing V&V planning.
  • Cross‑Platform Alignment — You will guide stakeholders toward common architectural solutions adopted across the product portfolio.

title: Human Data Collection Lead
descriptionHtml:
Type: Full-time Location: London, UK · On-site Compensation: £60,000–£95,000/year, in accordance with experience Travel: Potential occasional international travel as we stand up collection sites in other locations

About Netholabs

Netholabs is a frontier neuroscience and AI research company working at the intersection of deep learning, ethology, and physical engineering. We are on a mission to defend and enhance human agency in the age of superhuman artificial intelligence.

Instead of training AI solely on internet text, we build biological foundation models grounded in evolutionary intelligence. We design custom hardware, ultra-high-density neural recording systems, and complex tracking environments to capture petabyte-scale neurobehavioral datasets. By mapping these biological dynamics to digital organisms, we are building Whole Brain Emulations (WBE) to unlock structurally safe, human-compatible artificial general intelligence.

At Netholabs, you will work alongside world-class neuroscientists, machine learning researchers, and engineers to build the data infrastructure and neural models that will define the future of safe AGI. We have offices in London and San Francisco.

The Role

We're looking for a Human Data Collection Lead to own the quality and integrity of everything we record. We capture people performing real-world tasks, from physical manipulation to computer use, across many precisely synchronised modalities at once: motion tracking, eye tracking, multi-camera video, and neural signals such as EEG.

Right now this is a hands-on technical role. You'll set up and operate the recording rigs, get every device aligned in time and space, and apply the craft that makes neural data clean and trustworthy. Once the data is proven and collection volume grows, the role expands to building and managing the participant pipeline.

Responsibilities

Now: rigs, sessions, and data quality

  • Set up, calibrate, and operate multimodal recording rigs: motion tracking, eye tracking, camera arrays, and neural and physiological sensors

  • Own temporal synchronisation and spatial calibration across every device, so all data streams line up

  • Run recording sessions spanning manipulation tasks and computer use, with neural data recorded throughout

  • Apply neuroimaging best practices: careful sensor placement, signal and impedance checks, artefact and noise reduction

  • Verify each session is complete, correctly logged, and meets quality standards before it reaches the research team

  • Obtain informed consent and handle participant data under UK GDPR; keep clear, versioned SOPs as protocols evolve

As we scale: participants and team

  • Build and manage the participant panel, recruitment, screening, and scheduling; structure repeat sessions and drive retention

  • Help stand up new collection sites internationally and keep protocols, consent, and data handling consistent across them

Requirements

You don't need to tick every box; please lean towards applying if the role seems interesting to you.

  • Background in neuroscience or a related field, with hands-on experience collecting neurophysiological data (EEG or other modalities) and keeping it clean

  • Comfortable setting up, calibrating, and troubleshooting recording hardware

  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail; systematic, documents everything, lets nothing slip

  • Strong interpersonal skills; participants trust you and colleagues want to work with you

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where you define the process

  • Right to work in the UK, and willing and able to travel internationally on occasion

Valued

  • Experience with multimodal or time-synchronised recording setups (motion capture, eye tracking, multi-camera video)

  • Experience running human-subjects research operations (lab manager, clinical research coordinator, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of informed consent, UK research ethics, and UK GDPR

  • Prior startup experience

descriptionHtml:
Unsere Mission

Wir bei DeWarmte sind davon überzeugt, dass die Energiewende nur dann funktioniert, wenn sie für alle zugänglich und attraktiv ist. Dieser Kerngedanken leitet uns bei DeWarmte. Deshalb entwickeln und installieren wir unsere eigenen Wärmepumpen. So machen wir nachhaltiges Heizen intelligenter, bezahlbarer und für immer mehr Haushalte zugänglich.

Gemeinsam mit einem stark wachsenden Team von aktuell mehr als 70 Mitarbeitenden konzipieren und montieren wir unsere Wärmepumpen und übernehmen auch die Installation. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, offener Kommunikation und einem starken Teamgeist.

Als Installation Coordinator trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden in Deutschland bei der erfolgreichen Installation einer DeWarmte-Anlage einen reibungslosen Ablauf erleben.

Du unterstützt die Vorbereitung und Koordination von Installationen und Servicemaßnahmen und sorgst dafür, dass Kunden, Installationspartner sowie weitere Dienstleister aufeinander abgestimmt sind. Dein Profil

Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst klar, begleitest Projekte gerne von Anfang bis Ende und gehst gerne die Extrameile, um eine reibungslose Installation sicherzustellen.

title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
descriptionHtml:
Build what most people think is impossible.

Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability.

We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people.

Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before.

We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment.


The Opportunity

This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do.

You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes.

Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as:

  • Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations.

    • The exact problem matters less than how you approach it.

    You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions.

    If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it.


    Who we are looking for

    We are not simply looking for the highest grades. We are looking for people with exceptional potential. People who are deeply curious. People who ask why something has to be done a certain way. People who are not restricted by what they already know, what has been done before, or what others believe to be possible.

    You might be a great fit if:

  • You learn extraordinarily quickly.
  • You enjoy solving difficult problems with incomplete information.
  • You naturally break problems down to first principles.
  • You build things because you are curious about whether they can be built.
  • You are comfortable being wrong, learning quickly and trying again.
  • You care deeply about the quality of your work.
  • You want feedback and are equally comfortable giving it.
  • You can communicate clearly with people very different from yourself.
  • You want responsibility rather than supervision.
  • You would rather create something than inherit a finished system.

    • What we value
  • Mission alignment.
  • Exceptional subject matter ability.
  • The ability to execute in ambiguity.
  • A builder mindset.
  • A willingness to be on site, close to the hardware and the people building it.

  • Real hardware.
  • Real problems.

  • And, if you are exceptional, the opportunity to build a career with us after university.

    • Who should apply
    We are interested in outstanding students from leading universities across the Germany and Europe, including Oxford, Cambridge, TUM, LMU and others, however:
  • Your university matters less than your ability.
  • Your degree matters less than what you can do with it.
  • Your experience matters less than how quickly you can learn.
  • We are particularly interested in people who can point to something they have built, researched, competed in, broken, redesigned, coded, tested or taught themselves simply because they wanted to understand whether it could be done.

    • Security and Eligibility Requirement
    Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

    One final thing

    If you are looking for a comfortable internship with a clearly defined playbook, Hypersonica probably is not for you.

title: Investment Banking AI Evaluator
descriptionHtml:
About Aptura

Aptura is building the reinforcement learning data company that powers frontier model training globally. We combine deep expertise in finance with cutting-edge in-house tech to deliver tailored, domain-specific training data and feedback loops.

At work, we're building a high-performance, people-first culture. We move quickly, think ambitiously, and set a high bar for ourselves, all while staying open, collaborative, and genuinely enjoyable to work with. The best ideas here win regardless of who they come from, teams sit close to leadership, and every voice has a say in what comes next.

The Opportunity

In this 3-month contract, you will apply your knowledge to improve AI reasoning across complex financial workflows. You will help develop, evaluate, and refine high-quality training data that enables AI models to reason more accurately about financial analysis, valuation, transactions, and investment banking use cases.

In this role you will

  • Develop realistic investment banking scenarios, prompts, and reference solutions that reflect real-world analytical workflows.

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for financial accuracy, reasoning quality, technical rigor, and completeness using structured evaluations.

This role will be a great fit if you

  • 2+ years of professional experience in investment banking, private equity, equity research, transaction advisory, valuation, corporate finance, or a closely related analytical role.

title: iOS Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. Nice to Have

  • Experience with feature flags, remote configuration or automated iOS release pipelines

title: IT Architect - Business Domain
descriptionHtml:
Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein.

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten.

Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein:

- Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes.
- Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering.
- Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes.
- Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten.
- Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen.
- Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten.


Wat vragen we van jou?

- Wo werk- en denkniveau.
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen.
- Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling.
- Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren.
- Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen.
- Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam.
- Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop.
- Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré.
- Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 17 HAY is de range € 5.991,23 tot € 7.988,31 op basis van 36 uur.

Von Microsoft 365 bis zu neuen KI-Werkzeugen sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Technik im Alltag sicher und sinnvoll nutzen können.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

Wir besetzen mehrere Stellen. Je nach Erfahrung und Stärken liegt dein Schwerpunkt im Service Desk, in der Betreuung unserer Arbeitsplätze oder im Service Management.

  • Du bearbeitest Störungen und Anfragen im First- und Second-Level-Support und löst sie selbst oder gemeinsam mit unseren Dienstleistern.

  • Du richtest Konten und Zugriffe nach genehmigtem Antrag ein, setzt Passwörter zurück und begleitest Mitarbeitende bei Ein- und Austritten.

  • Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung für die Servicequalität, wertest Kennzahlen aus, gehst wiederkehrenden Störungen auf den Grund und koordinierst Vertretungen.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung im IT-Service-Management und Kenntnisse nach ITIL, gerne mit entsprechender Zertifizierung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine IT-Ausbildung abgeschlossen oder bringst vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk mit.

title: Java Entwickler / Product Engineer → Du gestaltest AI-Assisted Software Egineering mit *
descriptionHtml:
Hier schreibst du nicht nur Java. Hier prägst du, wie das ganze Entwicklungsteam künftig mithilfe von KI Software baut.

(Please note: C1-level German proficiency required)

Für ein international führendes Publishing-Tech-Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Java-Entwickler, der KI-gestützte Entwicklung zum Standard macht. Das Ziel ist Spec Driven Agentic Software Entwicklung bzw. ein echter AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle). Weitere Themen sind Compliance, Datensicherheit & Co. (ISO 27001 zertifiziert).

Das Unternehmen ...

... hinter dieser Stelle bringt seit über 15 Jahren Bücher in die digitale Welt. Auf einer selbst entwickelten Cloud-Plattform verwalten mehrere tausend Verlage ihre E-Books, Hörbücher und Podcasts und bringen sie von dort in alle relevanten Shops, Streaming- und Abo-Dienste weltweit.

Die Company ist in den letzten Jahren stark gewachsen, wird von einem der großen internationalen Software-Investoren unterstützt und beschäftigt ca. 230 Menschen an Standorten in Europa sowie Nord- und Südamerika. Das Herz der Software-Entwicklung schlägt in Dortmund.

KI ist hier kein Buzzword, sondern Geschäftsfeld: Von KI-vertonten Hörbüchern über die Lizenzierung von Verlagsinhalten an KI-Unternehmen bis zur besseren Auffindbarkeit von Inhalten. Derzeit werden auch neue KI-basierte Funktionen und -Services für die Nutzer der Plattform entwickelt.


Der aktuelle Tech-Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL, TypeScript/React, Python, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Linux, Claude Code, Open Code.

Deine Mission

Das Entwicklungs-Team arbeitet bereits mit AI Coding Agents. Jetzt geht es darum, KI-gestütztes Entwickeln tief in den Prozess zu verankern. Du entwickelst die bestehenden Java-Produkte weiter, baust Neues - und zwar so, dass KI-Agenten einen großen Teil des Codes schreiben, während du Architektur, Qualität und Richtung verantwortest. Dabei nimmst du dein Team mit - mit funktionierenden Workflows, klaren Standards und ansteckender Begeisterung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst im Produktteam die Java-Plattform weiter und baust neue Lösungen für die internationale Publishing-Branche.

  • Du machst KI-gestützte Entwicklung zum Standard: Du baust Workflows mit Claude Code, Open Code & Co. auf, definierst Spezifikationen, Prompts, Konventionen und Review-Prozesse und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du sprichst direkt mit Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern, verstehst Anforderungen aus erster Hand und übersetzt sie in präzise Vorgaben für Mensch und Maschine.

  • Du gestaltest Software-Architektur, Systemdesign und Schnittstellen maßgeblich mit.

  • Du reviewst, testest und integrierst KI-generierten wie selbst geschriebenen Code und stellst Sicherheit, Performance und Wartbarkeit sicher.

  • Du befähigst dein Team durch Pairing, Wissensaustausch und interne Sessions und machst aus Skepsis Neugier.

  • Du bewertest neue Technologien, KI-Tools und Modelle für spezifische Aufgabenstellungen und entscheidest mit, welche den Entwicklungsprozess wirklich voranbringen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Java, Spring Boot und JPA/Hibernate

  • Solide Datenbank-Kenntnisse, idealerweise mit PostgreSQL

  • Erfahrung mit AWS, Linux und idealerweise TypeScript/React, Python

  • Praxis mit KI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot oder OpenCode. Du weißt, wo sie glänzen und wo man genau hinschauen muss.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Architektur, Design Patterns und Clean Code sowie Sicherheitsbewusstsein (Secure Coding, OWASP) und Debugging-Fähigkeiten

  • Freude am direkten Austausch mit Fachbereichen/Stakeholdern und Interesse daran, fachliche Zusammenhänge selbst zu verstehen, statt nur Spezifikationen umzusetzen. Fähigkeit, Anforderungen kritisch zu hinterfragen und eigenständig fachlich fundierte Entscheidungen bei der Umsetzung zu treffen.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort & Schrift (C1) und gutes Englisch

Was dich erwartet

  • Ein attraktives Gehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung in Java & AI-Assisted Coding

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit einem Team, das vor Ort in Dortmund sitzt (2 Tage/Woche remote)

  • Eine Rolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie hier künftig entwickelt wird

  • Zugang zu aktuellen KI-Coding-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren

  • Ein Produkt mit Sinn: Bücher und Wissen in vielen Sprachen und Formaten zugänglich machen

  • Internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen

  • Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um dich up-to-date zu halten

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Weitere Corporate Benefits

  • Mitarbeiter-Rabatte

  • Eine JobRad Leasing-Option

Klingt das interessant & passend für dich?

Wenn ja, nimm jetzt Kontakt zu uns auf - dann können wir dir mehr über diese spannende Stelle erzählen und du kannst in Ruhe entscheiden, ob das eine tolle Option für dich wäre.

Du kannst einen professionellen Prozess und zeitnahe Reaktionen von uns erwarten. Auch unterstützen wir dich dabei, dich optimal zu präsentieren und begleiten dich mit Rat & Tat im Prozess.

Wir freuen uns schon sehr über deine Kontaktaufnahme!

- Ilias & Team

title: Junior Consultant (Werkstudent:in, m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Wirtschaft von morgen entsteht heute. Unter alles andere als einfachen Bedingungen.

Viele Unternehmen stehen unter erheblichem Druck. Kosten müssen gesenkt, komplexe regulatorische Anforderungen bewältigt und bestehende Geschäftsmodelle hinterfragt werden. Gleichzeitig eröffnen neue Technologien, Innovationen und veränderte Märkte große Chancen.

Wir sind überzeugt: Die Antwort liegt nicht allein darin, das Bestehende effizienter zu machen. Unternehmen müssen sich weiterentwickeln, neue Geschäftsmodelle gestalten, die langfristig wirtschaftlich erfolgreich sind – innerhalb planetarer Grenzen und mit Blick auf die Menschen.

Daran arbeiten wir bei Better Earth.

Wir suchen eine:n Junior Consultant, die/der etwas kann, etwas lernen und etwas bewegen möchte. Jemanden mit Freude daran hat, komplexe Fragen zu durchdenken, strukturiert zu arbeiten und gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Menschen konkrete Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Hast Du bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Unternehmensberatung gesammelt? Möchtest Du verstehen, wie Unternehmen funktionieren und wie man Transformation gestaltet? Suchst Du ein Umfeld mit hohen Ansprüchen, persönlichem Vertrauen und viel Gelegenheit zum Lernen?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Über uns

Better Earth steht für Business Transformation für eine zukunftsfähige Wirtschaft.

Wir unterstützen Menschen in Unternehmen und Unternehmer:innen, die wirtschaftlichen Erfolg und die Gestaltung einer positiven Zukunft miteinander verbinden wollen. Wir sind pragmatisch aber folgen einem klare Kompass.

Unsere Arbeit reicht von der Entwicklung zukunftsfähiger Geschäftsmodelle über den Aufbau wirksamer ESG-Funktionen inkl. Berichtswesen bis zur Integration langfristiger ökologischer und gesellschaftlicher Anforderungen in unternehmerische und Investitionsentscheidungen.

Dabei wissen wir, dass unsere Partnerunternehmen unter erheblichem wirtschaftlichem und organisatorischem Druck stehen. Wir helfen etablierten Unternehmen, Gründungs- und Investmentteams, handlungsfähig zu bleiben und die richtigen Weichen zu stellen.

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten, ist uns genauso wichtig wie das, woran wir arbeiten.

Better Earth hat ein kleines Kernteam und arbeitet bewusst mit einem Netzwerk langjährig vertrauter, erfahrener Berater:innen, Unternehmer:innen und Fachexpert:innen. Wir stellen Teams zusammen, die fachliche Tiefe, unternehmerische Erfahrung und Perspektiven verbinden.

Für Dich bedeutet das: Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit erfahrenen Menschen, lernst ihre Herangehensweisen kennen und kannst früh Verantwortung übernehmen. Statt vieler Ebenen gibt es bei uns kurze Wege, persönliche Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen.

Unser Büro liegt in Berlin-Mitte. Dort teilen wir uns die Räume mit der Deep-Tech-Investmentplattform Marvelous. Unsere Partnerunternehmen sitzen in Berlin, im Ruhrgebiet, in Müchen und an der Küste.

Was Du bei uns machst

Du arbeitest eng mit einem Co-Founder von Better Earth zusammen und unterstützt ihn direkt in Kundenprojekten sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt zunächst auf der Zusammenarbeit mit etablierten Unternehmen.

Inhaltliche Arbeit

  • Du recherchierst, analysierst und strukturierst Informationen und bereitest sie in Präsentationen und Berichten auf

  • Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Strategien, die Ausgestaltung von ESG-Funktionen und die Integration von Nachhaltigkeitsinformationen in Geschäftsprozesse.

  • Du hilfst Unternehmen, ihre Berichtsfähigkeit wirkungvoll und bürokratiearm aufzubauen und regulatorische Anforderungen pragmatisch umzusetzen

Organisation und Projektsteuerung

  • Du unterstützt die Zusammenarbeit in Projektteams aus Better Earth, unseren Netzwerkpartner:innen und unseren Partnerunternehmen

  • Du koordinierst Aufgaben, Termine und Informationen, verfolgst Ergebnisse nach und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen umgesetzt werden

  • Du übernimmst zunehmend eigenständig Aufgaben und bist für unsere Projektpartner:innen eine verlässliche Ansprechperson

Weiterentwicklung von Better Earth

  • Du bringst Dich bei der Geschäftsentwicklung, beim Marketing und bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation ein

  • Du hilfst, unsere internen Prozesse und die sinnvolle kontrollierte Nutzung von KI-Werkzeugen weiterzuentwickeln

  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, unser Wissen systematisch zu nutzen und strukturiert verfügbar zu halten. Du baust eigenes Wissen auf

Dabei geht es nicht darum, alles gleichzeitig zu machen. Wir setzen gemeinsam Prioritäten und achten darauf, dass Du Dich schrittweise weiterentwickeln kannst.

Wen wir suchen

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Aber wir wünschen uns, dass du bereits eine Vorstellung davon hast, was gute professionelle Arbeit ausmacht.

Was du mitbringst:

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrungen in einer Strategie-, Management- oder Unternehmensberatung gesammelt, beispielsweise im Rahmen eines Praktikums

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder ein vergleichbares Fach, idealerweise im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, Nachhaltigkeitsbezug ist hilfreich

  • Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest strukturiert, präzise und gewissenhaft. Auch dann, wenn es einmal "nur" darum geht, Kaffeebohnen nachzubestellen

  • Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufbereiten und gehst sicher mit Excel und PowerPoint um, auch wenn KI Dir vieles abnehmen kann

  • Du kommunizierst und arbeitest mühelos auf deutsch (mind. C1 ist Pflichtvoraussetzung) und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Du lebst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin arbeiten. Reisen musst Du nur in Ausnahmefällen

Was uns darüber hinaus besonders wichtig ist:

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Arbeit. Wenn Du eine Aufgabe bekommst, möchtest Du zuerst verstehen, worum es eigentlich geht. Du überlegst Dir einen Lösungsweg, stimmst Dich bei Bedarf ab und setzt ihn strukturiert um.

Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, hältst du inne, fragst nach und passt Deinen Ansatz an. Du kannst und musst nicht alles wissen. Du solltest aber neugierig sein, eigenständig denken und den Anspruch haben, Deine Arbeit richtig gut zu machen.

Wir schätzen Menschen, die zwischen dem unterscheiden können, was sorgfältig ausgearbeitet werden muss, und dem, wo eine pragmatische Näherung genügt – und die diese Unterschiede transparent machen.

Was du bei uns findest

Erfahrene Menschen, von und mit denen Du lernen kannst. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit langjährig erfahrenen Berater:innen und Expert:innen zusammen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen und selbst neugierig geblieben sind.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit einem Co-Founder. Du erhältst unmittelbare Einblicke in seine Arbeit als Berater und lernst aus erster Hand, wie Kundenprojekte, strategische Entscheidungen und die Weiterentwicklung einer Beratung ineinandergreifen.

Hohe Ansprüche und ein vertrauensvolles Umfeld. Wir arbeiten sorgfältig, geben einander Feedback und sprechen offen über Fehler und Unsicherheiten. Niemand muss hier Kompetenz vorspielen, aber alle sollten echte Kompetenz wertschätzen.

Unternehmerische Einblicke. Du lernst nicht nur, wie Beratung funktioniert, sondern kannst auch erleben und mitgestalten, wie sich eine schlanke, netzwerkbasierte Organisation weiterentwickelt. Wir interessieren uns für Deine Ideen.

Faire und flexible Rahmenbedingungen.

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, mind. 1 voller Tag Präsenz, abgestimmt auf Dein Studium

  • 15–20 € brutto pro Stunde, abhängig von Qualifikation und Vorerfahrung

  • Arbeitsplatz in unserem Büro in Berlin, leistungsfähige Hardware, ordentlicher Kaffee

title: Junior Data Consultant

title: (Junior) Data Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Pharma Data (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help make medicinal product data useful for all!

At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our platform identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in line with global standards such as the ISO standard for the Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP), and some of the world's largest pharma companies use it to bring products to patients faster and more safely.

You will join our Services department, a group of interdisciplinary experts who help our pharma customers adopt our platform and make it truly useful for their data. Within it, you are part of the data engineering team, which works in a clear, well-documented way: state-of-the-art tools, flexible processes, and agentic AI used in a structured, reliable way. You see your results in live customer projects within weeks, and learn the pharma data domain from people who have worked in it for years.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • You transform data from a wide range of structured sources (such as CSV, JSON, RDF, and SQL and NoSQL databases) into the IDMP data model, and build the pipelines that keep it up to date.
  • You use AI to turn unstructured sources such as documents and texts into structured, verifiable data.
  • You bring a DevOps mindset to data: with AI as your everyday tool, used responsibly, you keep data flows and tooling tested, automated, documented and reliable, as the regulated pharma industry demands.
  • You support the design of data models for IDMP knowledge graphs, leveraging the IDMP ontology, and learn to navigate graphs with SPARQL and agentic tooling.
  • As part of a joint team with our customers, you work directly with their domain experts to understand their data and make their medicinal product data useful.

What helps you succeed:

  • A background in computer science, data science or a life-science subject such as biology, chemistry or pharmacy. A formal degree is welcome but not required.
  • First hands-on experience in data engineering, data transformation or data preparation.
  • You understand how software and data systems fit together and can read and judge code, whether you or an AI wrote it.
  • Experience with version control (e.g. Git) and working in a team where changes are reviewed.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and with customers.
  • You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
  • Business-fluent English. German is a plus.
  • Coding experience in any language is a bonus. What matters to us is that you understand how programs work, not which language you learned it in.
  • It's a plus if you have worked with RDF, SPARQL or knowledge graphs, have experience with AI-based information extraction, know the basics of data governance, or bring knowledge of the pharma domain and/or IDMP.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Salary range of €50,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Hybrid work from our office in the KölnTurm with a view over the city and free parking
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Personal learning budget for trainings, conferences and certifications
  • Your choice of a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a City Plus Card with €50 per month
  • Hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux or Windows)
  • A team of around 20 people with short decision paths, where your work is visible from day one
  • A structured onboarding, together with other new colleagues starting at the same time

Not ticking every box?

Apply anyway! We care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn than about a perfect checklist.

At Accurids we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented groups in tech, science and data to apply.

title: (Junior/Mid/Senior) Sales Development Representative (gn)
descriptionHtml:
sofatutor ist ein führender Anbieter von digitalen Bildungsangeboten, der es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht hat, Schüler*innen und Lehrkräften innovative Lernlösungen zur Verfügung zu stellen.

Als  Sales Development Representative (gn) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erste Phase des Sales-Zyklus und hilfst uns so dabei, unsere Produkte im Schulbereich weiter zu etablieren.

Hinweis:

Unser Bewerbungsprozess findet aktuell komplett ortsunabhängig statt.
Du wohnst nicht in Berlin? Kein Problem, denn du kannst die Arbeit remote innerhalb von Deutschland und auch in vielen weiteren Ländern ausüben. Bitte bewirb dich unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatums.

Deine Mission

Als wichtiger Teil unseres Schulteams besteht deine Hauptaufgabe darin, den Erstkontakt mit potenziellen Schul-Kunden herzustellen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner*innen an Schulen zu identifizieren. Du begeisterst sie für sofatutor Schul-Lösungen und gewinnst sie für weiterführende Gespräche mit den sofatutor Sales Managern. Das sind deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Erstkontaktaufnahme mit Schulen:

    • Proaktive Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Kunden primär via Telefon und E-Mail

    • Personalisierte und bedürfnisorientierte Kommunikation mit potenziellen Neukunden (Schulen), um diese für einen Info-Termin mit einem Sales Manager zu gewinnen

  • Terminvereinbarung für Sales Manager:

    • Koordination von Gesprächen zwischen qualifizierten Leads und den Sales Managern

    • Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Übergabe aller relevanten Informationen über den Lead an den Sales Manager (z.B. Ansprechperson, Schulbedarf, Herausforderungen, Budget)

  • CRM-Datenpflege und -Management:

    • Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten und Interaktionen mit Schulen im CRM-System Pipedrive

    • Regelmäßige Pflege und Aktualisierung von Lead-Daten, um den Überblick über den Verkaufsfortschritt zu behalten und die Berichterstattung zu unterstützen

  • Berichterstattung und Performance-Tracking:

    • Wöchentliche und monatliche Berichterstattung über die Anzahl generierter und qualifizierter Leads, Kontaktversuche und Termine

    • Überwachung von KPIs wie Anzahl der täglichen Anrufe/E-Mails, Conversionrate von Leads zu qualifizierten Sales Opportunities, vereinbarte Termine und Verkaufsabschlüsse

  • Lead-Generierung & Recherche:

    • Identifizierung neuer potenzieller Kunden in der definierten Zielgruppen aus dem Schulbereich

    • Nutzung von Tools wie Datenbanken, Google, LinkedIn und anderen Plattformen, um relevante Entscheidungsträger und Ansprechpersonen zu identifizieren

    • Aufbau von Zielkundenlisten in Absprache mit den Sales Managern und der Teamleitung



Du bringst erste Erfahrungen im Sales Bereich mit, hast Freude am Beziehungsaufbau und klare vertriebliche Ziele motivieren dich? Außerdem suchst du eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit und hast Lust, die digitale Lehr- und Lernqualität an Schulen zu gestalten? Dann bist du hier genau richtig. 

Das sind die weiteren Anforderungen:

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast ein präsentes Auftreten am Telefon und findest immer den richtigen Gesprächseinstieg. Mit vielen unterschiedlichen Menschen zu sprechen und dich auf sie einzulassen macht dir Freude. Das Knüpfen von Beziehungen fällt dir leicht und gibt dir Energie.

  • Ziel-Orientierung: Du lässt dich von einem "Nein" nicht entmutigen, sondern nutzt es als Motivation, andere Herangehensweisen auszuprobieren. Das Erreichen von ambitionierten Sales-Zielen ist für dich ein Ansporn.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du bringst Lernfreude und Neugierde auf die Schulwelt mit und möchtest die Bedürfnisse und Interessen von Lehrkräften und Schulleitungen kontinuierlich besser verstehen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrscht Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst dich schriftlich gut ausdrücken. Du hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Auf dich ist Verlass, wenn es um die Weitergabe von Informationen an das erweiterte Team und das Einpflegen von Daten in das Customer Relationship Management System geht.

  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest eng und vertrauensvoll mit anderen zusammen und unterstützt deine Kolleg*innen im Team.

Du findest dich in diesen Punkten wieder und du bist daran interessiert, die Zukunft des digitalen Lernens mitzugestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – auch wenn du aktuell vielleicht (noch) nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen kannst.

Unser Versprechen

Neben einem monatlichen Festgehalt plus einer erfolgsbasierten Provision bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, von Beginn an vollumfänglich mit einzusteigen und deine Expertise bei uns einzubringen. Nach deinem Onboarding bist du selbstständig für deine Aufgaben verantwortlich. Bei Fragen stehen wir dir aber natürlich auch weiterhin jederzeit zur Seite. Bei sofatutor ist es uns außerdem besonders wichtig, dass wir transparent arbeiten und uns gegenseitig regelmäßig Feedback geben.

Hier siehst du auf einen Blick, was dich im Hinblick auf unsere Unternehmenskultur erwartet:

  • individuelle Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote für deine professionelle Weiterentwicklung

  • Hybrid-Office-Modell für flexibles Arbeiten (auch im Ausland) zum besseren Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit, Freizeit und Familie

  • Mental Health Benefits, wie die kostenlose Nutzung der Online-Plattform „Bloom”, über die du Zugang zu individueller Beratung und vielen verschiedenen Masterclasses erhältst

  • Rabatte auf nachhaltige Produkte über unsere Kooperation mit „FutureBens”, sowie weitere attraktive Vergünstigungen für mehr als 1.500 Anbieter über „Corporate Benefits”

Wir bei sofatutor arbeiten jeden Tag daran, unser integratives Arbeitsumfeld so weiterzuentwickeln, dass deine Entwicklung unabhängig von Geschlecht, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung, Religionszugehörigkeit, Alter, Behinderungsgrad, Bildungsstand oder Ethnie gefördert wird. title: Lead Engineer (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
