Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Mobile Engineer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for mobile engineer to build Doit's AI Finance Agent across Android and iOS.

 

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified.

  • Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run.

  • Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results.

  • Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities.

  • Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team.

  • Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence.

  • Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness.

  • Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers.

  • Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following:


What we would love to see from you

  • Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns.

  • Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it.

  • Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).

  • Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics).

  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.

  • Structured, precise, and ownership-driven, with the ability to align multiple subsystem teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience in flight software on spacecraft or launch vehicles.

  • Familiarity with NASA & ECSS standards for space software and verification.

  • Experience operating or setting up SIL, PIL, HIL and/or vehicle-in-the-loop facilities.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Operations Data & Automation Apprentice
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is the leading global marketplace dedicated to refurbished tech. We give electronic devices a second life by connecting customers with professional refurbishers, making more sustainable technology accessible to everyone.

Trade-in enables customers to sell their used devices, including smartphones, tablets, gaming consoles and more to professional refurbishers through Back Market. It is an important part of our circularity strategy: it helps customers recover value from their devices while giving Sellers access to the supply they need to grow their refurbished business.

Trade-in is currently operated across several markets, including 4 EU countries, the UK and the US, with further country and category expansion planned. Operations cover many different operational areas including logistics, fraud, CRM, customer care, payments, catalog and more.

 

Trade-in Operations is a transversal scope covering the entire Trade-in journey, including payments, customer care, CRM, catalog, pricing, seller operations, logistics, fraud & more.

Our mission is to make sure that customers and sellers experience a smooth, reliable and efficient Trade-in service. This means understanding how the service works end to end, getting hands-on with operational issues, managing incidents, finding solutions and continuously improving the way we work.

You will work close to the day-to-day operations, executing processes and understanding where problems really occur. The objective is then to use data, automation, AI and process improvement to make these operations simpler, faster and more scalable.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

1. Ensure smooth operations from day one

You will take ownership of operational processes and checks, making sure that important tasks are completed accurately and on time. This may include:

  • Maintaining the Trade-in Catalog and product matching

  • Monitoring pricing and identifying inconsistencies

  • Supporting Seller limit adjustments and Seller reactivation processes

  • Updating customer and agent-facing content

  • Supporting transactional CRM communications

  • Monitoring fraud-related processes

  • Investigating operational issues and coordinating incident resolution

These activities are essential to understanding the service and building the expertise needed to improve it.

2. Improve operations and create measurable impact

You will identify opportunities to improve, simplify and automate processes:

  • Analyse data to identify recurring issues and root causes

  • Build or improve reports, dashboards, alerts and monitoring

  • Simplify manual workflows and reduce unnecessary steps

  • Prototype automation using available tools, AI and workflow platforms

  • Improve incident detection and reduce resolution time

  • Track the impact of your improvements on incident rates, manual effort, customer satisfaction and seller experiences

  • Document processes and create reliable playbooks for the teams

  • Contribute to the evaluation and improvement of our AI chatbot for customer support

The goal is to turn recurring operational work into measurable improvements, not simply to execute tasks more efficiently.

3. Enable Trade-in to scale

Trade-in plans to open additional countries and categories while continuing to improve its performance. We cannot rely on increasing operational resources in proportion to the business.

You will help prepare the service for this growth by:

  • Standardising processes and making them easier to replicate

  • Designing scalable workflows and controls

  • Automating repetitive checks and actions

  • Making operational knowledge easier to share across markets

  • Helping ensure that new launches do not create an equivalent increase in manual work

Success in this role means helping Trade-in handle more volume, countries and categories with fewer incidents, faster resolution times, better customer and seller experiences, and less manual effort.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are hands-on, curious and solutions-oriented

  • You enjoy investigating problems and finding ways to make things work better

  • You are comfortable starting with operational execution to understand how things work and using it as a foundation for improvement

  • You are comfortable with spreadsheets and data extraction (SQL) and analysis

  • You are curious about processes, automation, AI and tools such as Braze (CRM), Intercom (Customer Care), Zapier and Workato (automation), Tableau and Omni (data visualization)

  • You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and verbally

  • You want to see the concrete impact of your work on a real, 360 business scope

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Video-call interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Live business case/Skills Fit interview with a team member

  • Skills and cultural fit interview with the Hiring Manager

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1,250 – €1,450 per month

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Partner Account Manager - France
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste

Ce poste de direction est essentiel : il consiste à construire et à faire passer à l’échelle les partenariats d’Anthropic avec les cabinets de conseil, les intégrateurs de systèmes mondiaux (GSI) et les boutiques partenaires nativement IA en France.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe commerciale pour que les clients adoptent l’IA grâce à nos partenaires.

Ce poste est un poste de construction, et non de gestion. Compte tenu du stade de développement d’Anthropic, nous recherchons un profil qui a déjà fait ses preuves en faisant passer des partenariats de zéro à des moteurs de revenus à grande échelle, un profil qui a bâti ces relations de A à Z, et non simplement hérité de relations existantes pour les gérer.

Responsabilités

  • Partenariats et exécution
    • Vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe commerciale pour comprendre comment les partenaires peuvent soutenir l’adoption de Claude par les clients.
    • Vous accompagnerez les partenaires dans la création de solutions clients reproductibles, répondant à des cas d’usage précis dans de nombreux secteurs : services financiers, santé, distribution, industrie, secteur public et services professionnels.
  • Performance et pilotage des indicateurs clés (KPI)
    • Vous portez la responsabilité des indicateurs clés de performance et vous les pilotez : revenus influencés par les partenaires, livraison réalisée par les partenaires, nombre de personnes consultantes formées et certifiées.
    • Chaque deal influencé par votre portefeuille de partenaires doit être conçu pour la réussite du client et la croissance de sa valeur à long terme. Vous définirez des critères de réussite pour les comptes communs, veillerez à la qualité de la mise en œuvre et de l’accompagnement à l’adoption, et mettrez en place des boucles de retour d’expérience favorisant l’amélioration continue.
    • Vous rendrez compte de la santé des partenariats, de leur avancement et de leurs résultats commerciaux, en vous appuyant sur des analyses fondées sur les données.
  • Développement du marché et construction de la marque
    • Vous renforcerez la notoriété de la marque Anthropic en France grâce à des relations stratégiques avec les partenaires.
    • Vous élaborerez et déploierez des stratégies de mise sur le marché (GTM) propres à chaque marché, adaptées aux pratiques commerciales et aux nuances culturelles locales.
    • Vous composerez avec les enjeux locaux de réglementation, de conformité et de souveraineté des données.
    • Vous créerez un avantage concurrentiel grâce aux capacités singulières des partenaires et à des propositions de valeur élaborées en commun.

Votre profil

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si vous réunissez les atouts suivants :

  • Vous avez l’esprit d’initiative et le goût de construire : vous êtes à l’aise pour partir de zéro et créer des partenariats d’envergure.
  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais et le français.
  • Vous comptez au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats technologiques à destination des entreprises, idéalement dans le cloud, l’IA/ML ou les activités de plateforme.
  • Vous avez une culture de la donnée, tournée vers les résultats mesurables et l’atteinte des KPI, et un historique avéré de revenus additionnels générés grâce aux partenariats dans la région.
  • Vous avez démontré votre capacité à assurer la réussite des clients et la protection de la marque via les canaux partenaires.
  • Vous avez l’esprit de compétition : la victoire et la différenciation sont votre moteur.
  • Vous avez une approche collaborative et savez travailler de façon transversale avec les équipes commerciales, produit, marketing et régionales.
  • Vous nourrissez une vraie passion pour l’IA et vous vous reconnaissez dans la mission d’Anthropic : développer une IA bénéfique.

Relations de travail

Votre rattachement hiérarchique se fera auprès de la direction des partenariats internationaux, tandis que votre activité quotidienne sera pilotée par la personne responsable des partenariats EMEA Sud. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec la direction commerciale régionale d’Anthropic et ses Account Executives, ainsi qu’avec les équipes Customer Success et Applied AI de la région.

Lieu et déplacements

Ce poste est basé à Paris, en France, avec des déplacements à prévoir pour rencontrer les partenaires et les clients.

About the Role

This is a critical leadership role responsible for building and scaling Anthropic's consulting, GSIs and AI-native boutique partners in France.
You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure customers are adopting AI through our partners.

This is a builder role, not a manager role. Given Anthropic's stage, we need someone who has proven they can take partnerships from zero to scaled revenue engines — someone who has built these relationships from the ground up, not just inherited and managed existing ones.

Responsibilities:

  • Partnerships and execution:

    • You will guide partners in creating repeatable customer solutions that address specific use cases across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, public sector, and professional services.
  • Performance and KPI ownership:
    • Own and drive key performance indicators, partner-influenced revenue, partner delivery, consultants trained and certified
    • Every deal influenced through your partner portfolio must be architected for customer success and long-term value expansion. You will establish success criteria for joint accounts, ensure proper implementation and adoption support, and create feedback loops that drive continuous improvement.
    • Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights
  • Market Development & Brand Building
    • Amplify the Anthropic brand in France strategic partner relationships
    • Develop and execute market-specific GTM strategies adapted to local business practices and cultural nuances
    • Navigate local regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty considerations
    • Create competitive differentiation through unique partner capabilities and joint value propositions

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Builder mentality — comfortable starting from zero and creating scaled partnerships

Fluent in English and French

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology partnerships, ideally within cloud, AI/ML, or platform businesses
  • Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes and KPI attainment. Track record of driving incremental revenues through partnerships in the region
  • History of delivering exceptional customer success and brand protection through partner channels
  • Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation
  • Collaborative approach with ability to work cross-functionally across sales, product, marketing, and regional teams
  • Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our South EMEA Partnerships lead. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Applied AI teams.

Location and Travel

This role will be based in Paris, France with travel expected to engage with partners and customers externally.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:€220.000—€260.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK

 

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care, changing how the UK finds, manages and pays for care. Most families start looking in a crisis, and many turn first to someone they already trust: their employer, council, the NHS or a charity. We want Lottie to be where those organisations send them.

Partnerships already bring families to Lottie. Through Seniorcare by Lottie, large employers give their people expert support when a relative needs care. Referral partners like Kinly introduce families to our marketplace.

You'll own these partnerships and build the next wave. About half your time goes on growing existing partners, and half on opening new ones across the public sector (like local authorities) and the private and charity sectors. We're early, so you'll shape the proposition from the ground up.

You'll be an individual contributor reporting to our VP Commercial, Matt Morgan. Success means enquiries from your partnerships and, ultimately, families placed in care.

 

💻 What does this role involve?

  • Own our relationships with the employers who use Seniorcare by Lottie, acting as their senior point of contact, keeping them engaged and maintaining the number of employees who use the service.

  • Take over our marketplace referral partnerships, including Kinly, managing performance, commercials and the quality of the enquiries they refer.

  • Build and run a pipeline of new demand-generating partnerships for the marketplace, exploring local authorities, the NHS and national old-age charities.

  • Design the commercial model for each new partnership, from referral fees to co-marketing, and negotiate the terms.

  • Track enquiries and placements by partner, so we know which partnerships are working and where to invest next.

  • Work with our Care Experts, marketing and product teams to make every partner referral a great experience for the family and easy for the partner.

 

💪 What problems will you be solving?

  • The moment care becomes urgent, families turn to the people they already trust. Your job is to make Lottie the first name those organisations think of.

  • A partnership is only as valuable as the families it brings. You'll make sure partner referrals turn into placements, not just leads.

  • Local authorities, the NHS and charities work to different incentives, budgets and timelines from commercial partners. You'll work out where Lottie genuinely helps them, from easing pressure on hospital discharge to supporting families who fund their own care, and build partnerships that last.

 

👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if…

  • You have experience in partnerships, business development or account management, ideally in a marketplace, employee benefits, health or care business.

  • You've grown existing partners and landed new ones from scratch.

  • You're commercially minded: you think in volume, conversion and unit economics, and you're comfortable negotiating terms.

  • You build credibility quickly with very different people, from an HR director to a council commissioner.

  • You're organised and AI-savvy, so long-cycle deals and day-to-day partner management both move forward and neither slips.

 

💔 This role isn’t for you if…

  • You're not passionate about elevating later life for everybody - our mission is at the heart of everything we do.

  • You only want to manage existing relationships, or only want to hunt new ones. This role is both.

  • You need quick wins to stay motivated. Some partnerships will take many months to land, and we measure them by the families they bring, not logos signed.

  • You're not up for using AI and process improvement to move fast in a growing startup.

     

📝 Application

We'd love to see a short video (about 2 minutes) answering this question:

Introduce yourself and tell us why you're interested in Lottie and why you feel you'd be a good fit for the role.

We appreciate this takes time. We receive a high volume of applications and this helps us assess you on more than your CV.

 

🔢 Lottie’s Interview Process

  1. Screening interview led by Lottie's Talent Acquisition team - remote

  2. Task/exercise, completed independently and talked through with your Hiring Manager - remote

  3. Final interview with your Hiring Manager - in person (London Bridge)

 

🤩 Candidate Experience: All candidates will be informed of their application status.

  • Final Interview: for final-stage candidates who are not offered the role, we will provide feedback via a phone call.

     

🚀 Meet Lottie

Founded with a mission to build the care sector of the future, Lottie is creating the AI operating system for social care - designed to unlock profitability for care providers and to make finding care as easy as booking a holiday on Airbnb.

Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie has raised over £25m from tier 1 venture capital funds (Accel and General Catalyst) and is widely recognised as one of UK's fastest growing tech companies. Most recently, Lottie was the acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50, LinkedIn Top Startups, The Sunday Times Tech 2026 and Startups 100.

As of today, Lottie offers three core products:

  • Lottie (B2B2C Marketplace) - Free service that helps families find the UK's best care homes and home care services.

  • Found by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - AI-native OS software supporting care providers to effectively manage their enquiries, occupancy and finances. Eliza by Found is our newest Found module: AI agents that handle care home enquiries - so no family goes unanswered. Launch video here.

  • Seniorcare by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - Employee benefit helping companies deliver outstanding eldercare support to their employees.

 

🤩 Why Lottie?

  • Career Opportunity - Join the Commercial team at one of the UK's fastest growing startups and build a partnerships channel that reaches families at national scale.

  • Early Hire Benefits - Be an early hire at one of the UK's fastest growing startups and benefit from fast career progression, as well as a generous stock options package.

  • Mission - Tech for good that aims to build the care industry of the future and to positively impact millions of people's lives. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology.

  • Investors - Series A backed startup having raised £25m+ from tier 1 venture capital investors including Accel and General Catalyst.

  • Global Opportunity & Scalability - Be part of a company solving a real, tangible problem that every family around the world faces at some point in their life.

You'd be using this now, not waiting on a roadmap or permission. Sona's just been shortlisted for Tech Product of the Year 2026 and selected for Tech Nation's Future Fifty cohort, real recognition of the pace this team moves at.

title: Praktikum Financial Consulting / Junior Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
PFP – PrivateFinancePartners ist eine ganzheitliche und unabhängige Finanzberatung für vermögende Privatkunden mit Schwerpunkt im Rhein-Main-Gebiet. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden in allen wesentlichen finanziellen Fragestellungen und entwickeln individuelle, langfristig tragfähige Finanzkonzepte.

Unser Anspruch ist eine fachlich fundierte Beratung, die die persönliche Lebenssituation unserer Kunden präzise erfasst und daraus klare Empfehlungen für ihre finanzielle Zukunft ableitet – von Vermögensaufbau und Vermögensverwaltung über Absicherung und Altersvorsorge bis hin zu Immobilien, Finanzierung und vielen weiteren Fragestellungen.

Gleichzeitig lernen wir Sie kennen: Ihre Leistung, Ihre Haltung, Ihre Entwicklung und Ihr Commitment. Das Praktikum ist damit eine intensive Kennenlernphase für beide Seiten – mit der Perspektive, bei gegenseitiger Passung anschließend als selbstständiger Junior Consultant bei PFP einzusteigen.

Aufgaben

Die fachliche Beratung unserer Kunden erfolgt durch unsere zugelassenen Consultants. Ihr Schwerpunkt im Praktikum liegt auf der konzeptionellen Mitarbeit, der vertrieblichen Praxis und dem gezielten Aufbau Ihrer Kompetenzen.

Qualifikation

Sie befinden sich in der Abschlussphase Ihres Studiums und stehen spätestens innerhalb der nächsten drei Monate vor Ihrem Abschluss oder haben diesen gerade erfolgreich erreicht. Sie möchten den Einstieg ins Berufsleben bewusst nutzen, um sich in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld zu beweisen und eine Karriere im Financial Consulting aufzubauen.

Idealerweise studieren Sie Wirtschafts- oder Sportwissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit wirtschaftlichem Bezug. Erste Erfahrungen im Consulting, Vertrieb, Finanzumfeld oder im direkten Kundenkontakt bilden eine gute Grundlage.

Noch wichtiger als Ihr Studiengang ist Ihre Haltung:

  • Sie begeistern sich für Vertrieb und gehen offen, sicher und mit echtem Interesse auf Menschen zu.
  • Anspruchsvolle Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse und wirtschaftlicher Erfolg motivieren Sie.
  • Sie erkennen Chancen, handeln eigeninitiativ, nehmen Feedback auf und bringen Aufgaben zuverlässig zum Abschluss .
  • Sie kommunizieren verbindlich, hören aufmerksam zu und treten empathisch auf.
  • Sie streben eine langfristige Perspektive im Financial Consulting an und können sich eine selbstständige berufliche Tätigkeit vorstellen.
  • Sie verfügen über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und kommunizieren auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächssituationen sicher und professionell.

Benefits

Wir geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Financial Consulting nicht nur theoretisch zu verstehen, sondern innerhalb von drei Monaten intensiv zu erleben, was fachliche Beratung, Vertrieb und unternehmerisches Arbeiten bei PFP bedeuten.

  • Fundierte fachliche Ausbildung: Sie lernen die zentralen Bereiche der ganzheitlichen Finanzplanung kennen. Dabei entwickeln Sie ein Verständnis dafür, wie finanzielle Entscheidungen im Gesamtkontext betrachtet und sinnvoll miteinander verbunden werden.
  • Einblicke in professionelle Finanzberatung: Sie lernen die besonderen finanziellen Fragestellungen vermögender Privatkunden kennen und erleben unmittelbar, wie bei PFP Beratung auf hohem fachlichem und persönlichem Niveau umgesetzt wird.
  • Persönliches Mentoring & Teamunterstützung: Ein erfahrener Partner oder Equity Partner begleitet Sie persönlich, gibt Ihnen regelmäßiges Feedback und unterstützt Sie bei Ihrer Entwicklung. Gleichzeitig profitieren Sie vom Wissen und der Erfahrung des gesamten Teams und können sich auch im Arbeitsalltag auf die Unterstützung Ihrer Kollegen verlassen.
  • Lernen durch direkte Anwendung: Sie erhalten Einblicke in reale Kundenfälle, nehmen an Beratungssimulationen teil und wenden neue Inhalte unmittelbar an. So sammeln Sie früh praktische Erfahrung und lernen, fachliches Wissen in konkrete Beratungssituationen zu übertragen.
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen & Workshops: Ergänzend zur täglichen Zusammenarbeit nehmen Sie an Schulungen und Workshops teil, die Ihre fachlichen, vertrieblichen und persönlichen Fähigkeiten gezielt erweitern.
  • Unterstützung bei der IHK-Qualifizierung: PFP begleitet Sie bei den für Ihre spätere Beratungstätigkeit relevanten IHK-Prüfungen und gewerberechtlichen Nachweisen in den Bereichen Versicherungen, Finanzanlagen, Immobilien und Finanzierungen.
  • Anspruchsvolles Leistungsumfeld: Sie arbeiten mit erfolgreichen Persönlichkeiten und erleben ein Umfeld, in dem Engagement, Eigeninitiative und Verbindlichkeit zählen. Klare Erwartungen und direktes Feedback geben Ihnen die Möglichkeit, an Ihren Aufgaben zu wachsen und zu zeigen, was Sie leisten können.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitiger Passung bietet sich Ihnen im Anschluss die Möglichkeit, als selbstständiger Junior Consultant bei PFP einzusteigen und Ihren weiteren Weg bei uns aufzubauen.

Kurz gesagt: Wenn Sie ehrgeizig, kommunikationsstark und bereit sind, sich mit vollem Einsatz einzubringen, finden Sie bei PFP ein Umfeld, das Sie fordert, fördert und Ihnen echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet.

Das Praktikum dauert drei Monate und findet als Vollzeitpraktikum in unserem Frankfurter Büro statt. Die Vergütung wird passend zur jeweiligen Praktikumsform vor Beginn individuell und transparent vereinbart.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr persönliches Anschreiben.

Nutzen Sie Ihr Anschreiben, um uns zu zeigen, warum Sie ins Financial Consulting möchten, was Sie an PFP interessiert und was Sie bei uns erreichen wollen.

Ihre Ansprechpartnerin ist Maya Meineke. Sie freut sich darauf, Sie kennenzulernen und beantwortet Ihnen gerne alle Fragen zum Praktikum.

title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
descriptionHtml:
AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken.

Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

  • Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

  • Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

  • Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

  • Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

  • Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

  • Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.


We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

  • De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

descriptionHtml:

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

In partnership with our Business Units, we form multidisciplinary teams and work with data scientists, engineers and delivery colleagues to create durable AI-powered software solutions for clients across a variety of industries.

Both product management and design are critical disciplines to create impact with AI. While data science and machine learning offer a powerful means to build insight and predictive capability, those insights are often consumed within a complex operational environment where human and organisational factors determine whether solutions are adopted and ultimately successful.

Closing the gap between the outputs of a model and the outcomes desired by our clients requires us to go beyond data and technology to address the human side – product and design are critical to this.

About the role

As a Principal Designer at Faculty, you will own and develop design as a core discipline within Applied AI while delivering high-impact work as a senior leader. You will shape our capabilities across both product and service design, defining progression frameworks and embedding modern practices. Operating as a trusted partner to executive-level clients, you will bridge the gap between technical AI capabilities and real-world commercial outcomes. This high-leverage position balances strategic client delivery with building an entrepreneurial design function from the ground up.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning and developing the product and service design disciplines at both individual and organisational levels across Applied AI.

  • Defining comprehensive skill frameworks to directly inform talent acquisition, career progression, and team development.

Who we're looking for

  • You have deep expertise in product or service design, with a strong emphasis on user experience, product architecture, and human-centred solutions.

  • You carry an entrepreneurial mindset, driven to articulate and champion the commercial value of design to diverse stakeholders.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. title: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer - Munich, Germany
descriptionHtml:
About Vinci

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software.

By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will utilize deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition—showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges. This includes both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. Additionally, you will serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team..

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions — either as a practitioner running simulations, or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI, Be part of a team that is actively redefining how the next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state of the art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.
