title: Mobile Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 2-3+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  1. Quick call with a Recruiter

  2. 15 minute cognitive test

  3. Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  4. Technical interview (90 minutes)

  5. Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: (Senior) Account Manager - Existing Customers (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Description

In ganz Europa stehen Fuhrparks unter enormem Druck. Kraftstoffkosten steigen, regulatorische Anforderungen werden komplexer und der Umstieg auf emissionsärmere Fahrzeuge nimmt Fahrt auf. Gleichzeitig verwalten noch immer rund 70 % der europäischen Unternehmen ihre Flotten mit Excel-Tabellen, isolierten Tools und Prozessen, die für die heutigen Herausforderungen nie ausgelegt waren.

Shiftmove macht genau das einfacher. Wir sind ein profitables B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen und die am schnellsten wachsende Flottenmanagement-Plattform Europas. Entstanden aus dem Zusammenschluss von Avrios und Vimcar, unterstützen wir heute zehntausende Geschäftskunden in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, der Schweiz, Polen und weiteren europäischen Märkten. Mit den jüngsten Akquisitionen von Optimum und Ocean in Frankreich haben wir unsere Präsenz weiter ausgebaut und unsere Position in einem der größten Flottenmärkte Europas gestärkt.

Unsere KI-gestützte Plattform verbindet Fahrzeugdaten in Echtzeit mit intelligenter Software, damit Unternehmen ihre Fahrzeuge smarter beschaffen, Kosten kontrollieren, Compliance sicherstellen und die Mobilitätswende aktiv gestalten können – alles an einem Ort.

Über die Rolle

Als Account Manager:in übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum von Shiftmove bei. Dein Ziel ist es, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen nicht nur langfristig zu sichern, sondern ihr Potenzial gezielt auszuschöpfen – durch Renewals, Upselling, Cross-Selling und die Entwicklung neuer Umsatzmöglichkeiten.

Dabei betreust du ein umfangreiches Portfolio an B2B-Kunden mit einem Geschäftsvolumen von rund 4–5 Mio. €. Du erkennst kommerzielle Chancen, gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen und bringst Opportunities erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success Team zusammen, übernimmst aber die eigenständige Verantwortung für die kommerzielle Entwicklung deiner Accounts.

Das erwartet dich

  • Account Management & Kundenentwicklung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio aus Mid-Market-Kund und ausgewählten Enterprise Accounts. Du behältst den Überblick über deine Accounts, priorisierst Chancen und Risiken und definierst klare nächste Schritte.
  • Renewal Management: Du verantwortest die Verlängerung bestehender Verträge – von der Vorbereitung des Angebots über die Abstimmung mit Kund bis hin zur Preisverhandlung und zum Abschluss.
  • Expansion: Gemeinsam mit Customer Success identifizierst du Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale und entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kund und kannst nachvollziehbar vermitteln, welchen Mehrwert zusätzliche Produkte oder Lösungen für sie schaffen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner auf Kundenseite und lernst, auch komplexere Entscheidungsprozesse strukturiert zu steuern.
  • Pipeline & Forecasting: Du dokumentierst relevante Entwicklungen in Salesforce und Planhat, hältst deine Opportunities aktuell und erstellst realistische Forecasts für deine Pipeline.

Was du mitbringst

  • B2B Sales Erfahrung: Du bringst ca. 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, z.B. im Account Management, Existing Customer Sales oder als Account Executive.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick & Closing: Du hast bereits eigenständig Verkaufsgespräche geführt, kommerzielle Verhandlungen gesteuert und Deals erfolgreich abgeschlossen, idealerweise im fünfstelligen Bereich.
  • Portfolio Management: Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung und kommerziellen Entwicklung eines größeren Kundenportfolios und weißt, wie du Accounts und Opportunities effektiv priorisierst.
  • Sales Drive & Proaktivität: Du gehst aktiv auf Kunden zu, erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und hast Freude daran, Umsatzpotenziale in konkrete Abschlüsse umzuwandeln.
  • Consultative Selling: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und kannst den Mehrwert einer Lösung überzeugend vermitteln, statt dich ausschließlich auf Produktfeatures zu konzentrieren.
  • Lernbereitschaft & Coachability: Du bist offen für Feedback, möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Warum uns?

  • Produkte mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Herausforderungen für tausende Unternehmen in ganz Europa und machen komplexe Flottenprozesse einfacher, effizienter und datengetriebener.
  • Etwas Sinnvolles skalieren: Als profitables, PE-finanziertes Scale-up mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen verbinden wir Stabilität mit Geschwindigkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Über 40 Nationalitäten, Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und Teams in ganz Europa sorgen für spannende Perspektiven und echte Zusammenarbeit.
  • Verantwortung statt Micromanagement: Wir geben Menschen den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ideen einzubringen und Dinge voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Workation: Bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr remote von überall auf der Welt arbeiten
  • Hundefreundliches Büro: Weil tierische Kolleg einfach dazugehören 🐶
  • Weiterentwicklung: 2.000 € jährliches Budget für persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung
  • Benefits nach Wahl: Urban Sports Club, Hrmony, JobRad oder Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket/BVG-Ticket
  • Wellbeing: 1 Mental Health Day plus Zugang zu nilo.health
  • Für Foodies: Kostenloses Mittagessen einmal pro Woche, gemeinsames Frühstück alle zwei Wochen sowie Snacks und Getränke rund um die Uhr 🍕

We mean it!

Mit über 40 Nationalitäten verbindet uns vor allem eines: der gemeinsame Anspruch, Mobilität für Unternehmen einfacher zu machen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven machen unsere Arbeit besser.

Uns ist nicht wichtig, ob dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Uns interessieren Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge ins Rollen bringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Du bist nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Und wenn du im Bewerbungsprozess etwas brauchst oder Anpassungen notwendig sind, sag einfach Bescheid – wir finden eine Lösung.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

💊 Benefits

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

  • Free books & learning material

descriptionHtml:

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

  

🎁 What we offer

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

  1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

🤝Hiring process

  • You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  • You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

  • You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Revenue Operations Manager - Demand Generation
descriptionHtml:
About SoSafe

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

Your Role: Architect of Our Demand Engine

As Revenue Operations Manager for Demand Generation, you will own the end-to-end operational architecture connecting Marketing, our SDR organization, and Account Executives into a single, cohesive pipeline creation engine. Rather than viewing demand in isolated channel silos, you will design the infrastructure, data routing, and AI-native automations that fuel both Inbound and Outbound motions.

You will ensure that every inbound handoff is seamless and that outbound prospecting is hyper-targeted toward our highest-converting opportunities; directly counteracting broader SaaS industry trends where late-stage conversion rates have tightened..

What you will own (key responsibilities)

  • Own the Holistic Lead & Pipeline Lifecycle: Design, optimize, and oversee the full demand funnel from initial buyer signal to Closed-Won deal. Bridge the gap between HubSpot Marketing automation, Salesloft cadences, and Salesforce CRM to eliminate lead leakage and friction.

  • Operationalize Our 2026 ICP & Intent Signals: Hardwire our target ICP criteria, EU mid-market organizations with 500–5,000 employees in regulated industries (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Finance, Public Sector), into our lead scoring and routing logic. Use Clay and Zapier to enrich accounts based on Microsoft 365 tech stack indicators and regulatory pressure signals (e.g., NIS2, DORA compliance deadlines).

  • Supercharge SDR & AE Outbounding: Build automated prospecting workflows that allow SDRs and AEs to discover, enrich, and add target ICP contacts into Salesloft cadences with one click.

  • Channel Efficiency & Attribution: Track and optimize lead-to-opportunity conversion metrics across all GTM motions. Capitalize on data showing that AE-sourced pipeline yields significantly higher win rates than traditional cold marketing leads, using insights to reallocate GTM focus dynamically.

  • Introduce AI-Native Lead Generation: Partner with our dedicated GTM Engineer to implement cutting-edge AI use cases across the top of the funnel. Drive automated lead enrichment, intent-based account prioritization, and automated meeting scheduling to maximize representative output per hour.

  • Pipeline Health & Target Setting: Partner with Marketing Leadership, Sales Leadership, and the Revenue Operations team to set MQL/SQL targets, track funnel velocity, and maintain a robust unweighted pipeline coverage ratio of 3-4x across all territories.

What You Bring (requirements)

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Sales Operations within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Why Join the SoSafe RevOps Team?

title: Sales Manager Italien (m/w/d) – Emissionsminderung & Umwelttechnik
descriptionHtml:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung in Italien und weit darüber hinaus.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Emissionsminderungssysteme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und anspruchsvolle Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Unsere Lösungen finden Anwendung in unterschiedlichen Bereichen der Energie-, Industrie- und Umwelttechnik. Und genau darin liegt für uns eine große Chance: unsere Erfahrungen aus bestehenden Märkten auf neue Anwendungen und Kunden zu übertragen.

Italien spielt dabei eine zentrale Rolle. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Sales Manager Italien entwickelst du unseren italienischen Markt weiter. Du betreust bestehende Kunden, gewinnst neue Geschäftspartner und identifizierst Anwendungen, in denen unsere Technologien zur Emissionsminderung einen echten Mehrwert schaffen.

Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Vertriebsgebiet verwalten, sondern einen Markt entwickeln, Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und die weitere Expansion von Emission Partner in Italien aktiv mitgestalten? Dann werde Emission Partner.

Was du bei uns bewirkst



Du bringst unsere Technologie dorthin, wo Emissionen entstehen und Lösungen gebraucht werden.

Italien bietet für uns vielfältige Möglichkeiten: von Energieerzeugung und Biogas über Industrie- und Feuerungsanlagen bis hin zu neuen Anwendungen der Abgas- und Abluftnachbehandlung.

Du bist nah am italienischen Markt, erkennst neue Möglichkeiten und entwickelst daraus konkrete Kundenprojekte.

Dabei geht deine Aufgabe deutlich über klassischen Produktvertrieb hinaus. Du baust Beziehungen auf, verstehst technische Anforderungen, erkennst Marktpotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Fachbereichen passende Lösungen.

Kurz gesagt: Du verkaufst nicht einfach unsere Produkte. Du entwickelst mit uns Emission Partner in Italien weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebs und unserer Marktposition in Italien.
  • Du betreust bestehende Kunden und entwickelst daraus langfristige und belastbare Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Du identifizierst potenzielle Neukunden und übernimmst die aktive Neukundenakquise.
  • Du erschließt neue Markt- und Anwendungsfelder in den Bereichen Energie, Industrie und Umwelttechnik.
  • Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Fachbereichen passende Lösungen zur Emissionsminderung.
  • Du begleitest Projekte vom ersten Kundenkontakt über die technische und kaufmännische Beratung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Du präsentierst unsere Lösungen bei Kunden, Partnern, Messen und Fachveranstaltungen.
  • Du baust ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Kunden, Geschäftspartnern und Multiplikatoren auf.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Vertriebspartner und führst bei Bedarf Produkt- und Anwendungsschulungen durch.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leitest daraus neue Vertriebschancen ab.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb und den technischen Fachbereichen in Deutschland zusammen.
  • Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem italienischen Markt aktiv in unsere Vertriebs- und Produktstrategie ein.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, dass du den italienischen Markt verstehst, Kunden entwickeln kannst und Interesse an unserer Technologie mitbringst, als ein vollkommen geradliniger Lebenslauf.

  • Dein Lebensmittelpunkt liegt in Italien, idealerweise in Norditalien oder Südtirol.
  • Du sprichst sehr gut Italienisch und kannst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren.
  • Du hast eine technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung beziehungsweise ein entsprechendes Studium abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb, Außendienst oder Business Development mit.
  • Idealerweise kennst du bereits Märkte aus der Energie-, Industrie-, Anlagenbau-, Umwelt- oder Emissionstechnik.
  • Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und ihren Nutzen überzeugend für unterschiedliche Ansprechpartner vermitteln.
  • Du hast Freude an Neukundenakquise, Netzwerkaufbau und Geschäftsentwicklung.
  • Du trittst sicher und professionell auf und kannst technische sowie kaufmännische Verhandlungen führen.
  • Du möchtest Verantwortung für einen Markt übernehmen und arbeitest entsprechend selbstständig und strukturiert.
  • Du bist bereit, innerhalb Italiens regelmäßig zu reisen.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit digitalen Systemen, CRM und den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen.
  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Vielleicht kennst du den italienischen Markt sehr gut, hast aber bisher noch nicht mit Abgasnachbehandlung gearbeitet. Oder du kommst aus einem technischen Umfeld und möchtest deine Erfahrung stärker in Vertrieb und Geschäftsentwicklung einbringen.

Du arbeitest direkt aus Italien heraus und bist nah an unseren Kunden und Geschäftspartnern.

Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst Italien. Gerade in Norditalien bestehen für uns interessante industrielle Strukturen und kurze Wege zu vielen potenziellen Kunden und Partnern.

Gleichzeitig bist du eng mit unserem Team in Deutschland verbunden. Bei komplexen technischen Aufgabenstellungen bist du nicht auf dich allein gestellt, sondern kannst auf das Know-how aus Entwicklung, Anwendungstechnik und Vertrieb zurückgreifen.

Du bekommst damit echte Verantwortung für deinen Markt und gleichzeitig den technischen Rückhalt eines spezialisierten Teams.

Das bieten wir dir



Natürlich soll nicht nur deine Arbeit zu uns passen, sondern Emission Partner auch zu deinem Leben.

Verantwortung für einen ganzen Markt
Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, unsere Entwicklung in Italien aktiv mitzugestalten, statt lediglich ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio zu verwalten.

Dienstwagen auch zur privaten Nutzung
Für deine Kundentermine bist du mobil ausgestattet und kannst deinen Firmenwagen auch privat nutzen.

30 Tage Urlaub
Zeit für Erholung, Familie und Freizeit.

Mit wachsender Erfahrung, Kompetenz und Verantwortung entwickelt sich auch dein Gehalt weiter.

Umfassende Einarbeitung
Wir machen dich mit unseren Produkten, Technologien, Anwendungen und Märkten vertraut.

Individuelle Weiterbildung
Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner fachlichen, vertrieblichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Technischer Rückhalt
Du musst beim Kunden nicht jedes technische Detail allein lösen. Unsere Fachbereiche stehen dir bei anspruchsvollen Projekten zur Seite.

Du bist nah an den Menschen, die Produkte entwickeln und Entscheidungen treffen, und kannst Marktanforderungen direkt ins Unternehmen zurückspielen.

Team & Firmenevents
Auch wenn dein Arbeitsplatz in Italien liegt, gehörst du fest zu unserem Team.

Arbeiten mit Sinn
Du bringst Technologien zur Emissionsminderung in Anwendungen, in denen sie konkret dazu beitragen können, Schadstoffemissionen zu reduzieren.

Klingt nach deinem Job?



Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Kein kompliziertes Anschreiben. Kein Bewerbungsmarathon.

Bewirb dich einfach und erzähl uns kurz, wer du bist, welche Märkte und Kunden du kennst und welche Erfahrungen du im technischen Vertrieb mitbringst.

Jetzt bewerben und Emission Partner Italien mitgestalten.

descriptionHtml:
About Team & Role

Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and you'll do it for one of the fastest-growing corners of the data estate: unstructured data on NAS. As the Sales Specialist for NAS Cloud Direct, you own the number for this product in your territory. You'll be the go-to expert in the field, with the tools, enablement and One Rubrik selling motion to take your career, and your earnings, as far as your results allow.

You'll work alongside Core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners, and you'll be the consolidated voice of the field and customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.

What You'll Do

  • Own bookings growth for NAS Cloud Direct across new and existing accounts, building and executing a territory plan that meets and exceeds quota
  • Drive daily pipeline generation to land net new logos, opening doors with customers who need to protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding more on-prem backup infrastructure
  • Qualify, build and close strategic opportunities in mid-enterprise accounts, and expand within the existing Rubrik base alongside Core AEs
  • Present NAS Cloud Direct within complex data center and cloud design conversations, helping customers see how they get faster, simpler recovery from ransomware and other disruption
  • Co-sell with Core AEs, Sales Engineers, distributors, resellers and VARs to build repeatable partner-led momentum
  • Champion and evangelize the product inside and outside Rubrik, training the field on positioning, objection handling and competitive differentiation so more teams can sell it with confidence
  • Bring market and customer feedback to Product Management and Product Marketing, shaping what we build next and how we take it to market
  • Share what's working with fellow Product Line Specialists, so the whole team learns faster

Experience You'll Need

  • 5+ years of field technology sales experience, ideally selling data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions
  • A consistent track record of landing net new logos and consistently overachieving quota
  • Strong experience building and managing pipeline across many accounts and verticals
  • Comfort positioning a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments, and building champions across technical and business buyers
  • Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory
  • A driven, goal-oriented "get it done" mindset and the self-direction to generate your own momentum

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms
  • Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions into mid-enterprise accounts
  • Background in product-specialist or overlay sales models
  • Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage
  • Understanding of MEDDPICC for sales qualification & COtM sales methodology

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

title: SAP Integration Architect
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €70K – €130K • Offers Equity

title: Science Manager – Nature-based Solutions (80-100%)
descriptionHtml:
As a Science Manager in Climeworks Solutions, you make sure that our nature-based solutions (NBS) portfolio meets the same demanding quality bar we apply to all our carbon dioxide removal offerings. Your focus is on Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (ARR), Improved Forest Management (IFM) and Mangroves, but you are not limited to these. You will screen the market, identify and assess priority projects, and carry out due diligence on potential partners. You form and defend Climeworks Solutions' own, independent scientific view on the quality, risks and fit of NBS projects. You keep our assessment criteria up to date and apply them in practice. You work closely with the sourcing team to shape our approach to nature credits, from first supplier contact to partnerships and product positioning. This role gives you real influence on how we build our nature offering and how the wider removal market develops.

  • Quality framework development: You adapt and sharpen Climeworks' quality assessment frameworks for nature-based pathways. You draw on the newest published methodologies and on standards as they evolve.

  • Supplier assessment and monitoring: You build constructive relationships with relevant suppliers. You rate and benchmark their projects. Over time, you track how project quality and delivery change and flag any concerns early.

  • Project due diligence: You run in-depth technical, scientific and commercial reviews of key projects. These cover additionality, measurability, carbon accounting, co-benefits, reversal risk and delivery risk. You combine many data sources, including GIS analysis, project documents and registry information, into clear recommendations.

  • Pathway segmentation: As the CDR industry matures, you group projects into sub-pathways and archetypes. For each one, you develop a well-founded view of what quality means.

  • Market intelligence and prioritization: Together with Sourcing, you map the project landscape across key regions and pathways. You identify the strongest projects and recommend them, based on methodological robustness, pricing, reputation and delivery record.

  • Contracting support: You help Sourcing draft contracts with approved suppliers. You focus on negotiating quality-related terms and amendments.

  • Partnership development: You help build relationships with important players in the ecosystem, such as rating agencies, registries, NGOs and other opinion leaders.

  • Pathway strategy: You work with colleagues in Science, Sourcing and the wider Commercial team to define the strategy for each nature-based pathway. You consider market trends, quality benchmarks, demand and supply.

  • Sales support: You advise on project selection and answer technical questions in customer discussions, pitches and tenders.

  • Knowledge sharing: You keep colleagues informed about scientific progress, new methodologies and market developments in nature-based solutions.


  • Education: You have a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as ecology, conservation science, environmental or natural sciences, forestry or geography. A PhD is an advantage.

  • Experience: You have hands-on experience in nature-based carbon projects. This could be project development, project design documentation, independent project ratings, MRV, carbon modelling or biodiversity research. Experience in carbon markets and CDR, and with standards such as Verra, Gold Standard, Plan Vivo or Isometric, is a strong plus.

  • Analytical skills: You work confidently with large and varied datasets, including GIS and statistical analysis. You are precise and scientifically rigorous, and you can reach sound conclusions even when data is incomplete.

  • Critical thinking: You question assumptions, spot inconsistencies and find practical solutions by connecting findings across projects.

  • Business judgement: You weigh commercial and strategic factors when assessing projects and shaping strategy.

  • Communication and language: You explain complex topics in a clear and credible way, and you can show how robust your assessments are. You are fluent in written and spoken English.

  • Way of working: You take ownership and manage several projects at once, with clean documentation. You are comfortable working across teams and in different environments. You balance independent judgement with close collaboration.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

  • Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

  • Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

  • Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

title: Scientific Software Engineer (Lab Integration)
descriptionHtml:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.

This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.

You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own.

Your Impact

You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

What You Will Do

  • Help shape how we connect to partner labs around the world, accounting for different levels of automation and AI-readiness, then design, build and operate the services that send experiment requests from our AI agents and reliably bring results back.

  • Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange.

  • Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

  • Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

  • Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly.

  • Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design.

  • Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines.

  • Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services.

  • Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design.

  • Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts.

  • Solid understanding of security practices for externally facing systems.

  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working in a small, multidisciplinary team, and can communicate clearly with experimental scientists, optimisation experts and engineers alike.

Bonus Points

  • Experimental lab experience in materials science, chemistry or chemical engineering.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Flyte, Prefect) or active learning loops.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and observability tooling.

  • Security or compliance experience or handling partner IP and confidential data.

  • Experience working across distributed teams and multiple time zones.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

title: Security Engineer III
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you’ll be doing:

As a Security Engineer within the Security Operations team, you will help design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — helping turn security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:

  • Alert Investigation & Triage: Investigate and triage security alerts from across our detection tooling, analysing logs, endpoint, identity, cloud, and network telemetry to determine impact and root cause. Work alongside the wider SOC to escalate and resolve confirmed threats, document findings clearly, and feed what you learn back into detections, tuning, and automation.
  • Incident Response & DFIR: Support the investigation and response to confirmed security incidents, applying digital forensics and incident response skills across endpoint, cloud, and identity data. Help with evidence collection and preservation, timeline reconstruction, containment, and root cause analysis, and contribute to post-incident reviews that turn lessons learned into improved detections and tooling.
  • SIEM Engineering: Contribute to the engineering of our SIEM platform, including onboarding and normalising log sources, building and maintaining parsers, and supporting high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin detection and investigation. Help improve log coverage, data quality, and platform performance.
  • Detection Engineering: Help develop and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — working with version control, peer review, and automated testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and contribute to improving coverage, precision, and resilience against evasion.
  • AI-Augmented Security Operations: Help explore and apply AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities — including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritisation of detection content. Contribute to evaluating emerging AI tooling and embedding it responsibly into team workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Help consume and operationalise threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, response playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to support a timely and structured flow of actionable intelligence into security operations.
  • Threat Hunting: Take part in proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.

What you’ll bring to the role:

We are looking for a technically capable security professional with hands-on experience in security operations. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Technical Security Experience: commercial experience in a security operations role, with a solid grounding in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.
  • Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Hands-on experience supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log and artifact analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tooling and methodologies is highly sought after, as is experience contributing to post-incident reviews and translating findings into actionable improvements.
  • Detection & Response Skills: Practical experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and participating in incident response activities.
  • SecOps Tooling: Hands-on knowledge of administering and operating core security operations tools, including SIEM platforms, EDR/XDR solutions, vulnerability scanners, and ticketing or case management systems. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds, and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. A working knowledge of threat hunting methodologies and the ability to proactively identify indicators of compromise or attacker behaviour across the environment is highly desirable.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) to build security tooling, automate workflows, and integrate security capabilities.
  • Application Security Knowledge: Familiarity with secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and the ability to perform code reviews or work with developers to remediate security findings.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Working knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to articulate technical security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally to deliver security outcomes.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.
