title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

title: Senior adviseur EMC
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw advies voorkomt dat hoogspanningsverbindingen risico’s voor de omgeving veroorzaken. Zo maak jij de uitbreiding van het Nederlandse energienet veilig en verantwoord mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je adviseert toonaangevende opdrachtgevers over complexe elektromagnetische beïnvloeding rond hoogspanningsverbindingen.

  • Je vertaalt normen en technische analyses naar heldere scenario’s, risico’s en praktisch uitvoerbare maatregelen.

  • Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise zichtbaar in te zetten, bijvoorbeeld bij klanten en binnen normcommissies.

Als senior adviseur EMC overzie je complexe vraagstukken rond elektromagnetische beïnvloeding. Je beoordeelt welke normen van toepassing zijn, doorziet vroegtijdig de gevolgen voor assets van derden en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. Je bent klantgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht en weet complexe normering begrijpelijk uit te leggen zonder de technische nauwkeurigheid te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en durft richting te geven aan klanten en collega’s.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, technische natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting;

  • ruime relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur circa tien jaar, met EMC, elektromagnetische beïnvloeding, hoogspanningssystemen of een aanverwant specialistisch vakgebied;

  • ervaring met technisch advies, projectmatig werken en het vertalen van normen en onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete maatregelen;

  • ervaring met GIS applicaties en programmeren in MATLAB of Python is een pré;

  • kennis van de NEN3654:2023 en RLN00398 is een pré.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen €6.250 en €7.250 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

De afdeling Energie is een gezellige en sociale club van ongeveer 50 collega’s. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Samen met je collega’s benader je deze enorme uitdaging procesmatig en vanuit de inhoud. Door een zeer professionele way of working kom je met elkaar tot creatieve en toekomstbestendige adviezen én ontwerpen die we aanbieden aan opdrachtgevers als TenneT, Stedin, ProRail, Provincies, Ministeries en Rijkswaterstaat. De afdeling Energie focust zich op duurzame energievoorziening, rail energiesystemen en EMC & netkwaliteit.

Movares is zeer ervaren en groot genoeg om succesvol te zijn in de meest uitdagende projecten van het land. Deze uitdagingen ga jij vanuit afdeling Energie aan binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Jij en je collega’s zijn zeer betrokken bij het werk. Samen met hen voer jij projecten uit in het werkveld Energie, voor ‘onze’ opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je met teams van andere afdelingen samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten. Zo proef je verschillende werkvelden en leer je van adviseurs en engineers in meerdere disciplines. Jouw ontwikkeling gaat altijd door!

title: Senior Agents Platform Engineer (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Agents Platform Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to build the platform that lets every feature team at Doctolib declare an agent once — and get a production-grade, secure, and compliant AI agent by default. You will work on the foundational layer that powers Consultation Assistant, Phone Assistant, Health Companion, and more: a shared agent runtime, a unified GenAI gateway, and the observability and evaluation infrastructure that makes it all trustworthy — contributing directly to safer, faster, and more reliable AI for patients and care teams across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own the agent manifest and registry — design the single declarative specification (skills, tools, memory, model, guardrails, sandbox, security) that wires any new agent into the full platform automatically, triggerable from product surfaces, other agents (A2A), schedules, or workflows

  • Own the GenAI gateway end to end (built on LiteLLM) — manage routing (including KV-cache-aware routing), failover, metering, cost attribution, reserved-capacity pooling, and guardrails across self-hosted (vLLM) and managed providers, serving several hundred million requests per month

  • Operate the infrastructure for long-running, streaming agent interactions — build production-grade reliability for SSE/WebSocket connections, queueing and retries, human-in-the-loop approvals, and snapshot/resume, in a sandboxed execution environment consistent with our existing application runtime

  • Build feature-flagged, progressive rollout for prompts, models, and configs — including an emergency kill-switch and the audit trail that lets agents act safely on sensitive healthcare data

  • Own reliability for the agents platform end to end — define SLOs, lead on-call and incident response, and build runbooks including provider failover for the GenAI gateway

  • Build the observability and evaluation layer — online traces and logs, offline evals (LLM-as-judge plus patient and practitioner simulators) gating CI, and the compliance-grade audit trail for health data

  • Validate the platform by shipping one or two reference agents yourself before product teams adopt it, and advise feature teams on agent architecture trade-offs

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, including hands-on production experience building or operating LLM-based agent systems (Google ADK or similar), with a solid understanding of agent design patterns: planning/reflection loops, tool calling, state and memory management, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints

  • Have experience with agent interoperability and tool protocols (MCP, A2A, AG-UI), control-plane concepts for asynchronous or long-running systems (queueing, retries, checkpointing), and feature-flagging or progressive-rollout systems including reliable kill-switches

  • Have experience managing cost and capacity for LLM usage — routing, caching, and reserved-capacity planning with managed model providers

  • Are comfortable owning production reliability (SLOs, incident response, on-call) and are security-minded when designing sandboxing, permission scoping, and audit trails for autonomous systems acting on sensitive data

  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy mindset, and are comfortable working in a founding role where shaping the right scope is part of the job

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience giving agents richer identity, memory, and knowledge (long-term memory, artifact stores, or RAG pipelines), ideally in partnership with a data platform team, or experience building a feedback loop that turns production traces into evaluation datasets

  • Have experience building Kubernetes-native abstractions (CRDs/operators) to manage an agent's lifecycle declaratively, and/or with durable stateful execution engines (e.g. Temporal) for long-running workflows

  • Have experience in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, public sector) and with frameworks such as GDPR, HDS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2

Our stack

  • Programming languages: Python, plus comfort with TypeScript/Go for agent SDKs and tool integrations

  • Cloud providers: GCP / AWS / Azure

  • Agent orchestration & runtime: Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), running as services on our application platform

  • Agent protocols: MCP, A2A, and AG-UI

  • Feature flags / progressive rollout: Flagd (or similar), including the emergency kill-switch

  • GenAI gateway: LiteLLM (owned end-to-end by this team) — routing, failover, metering, cost attribution, guardrails, reserved-capacity pooling (Azure OpenAI PTUs, Vertex AI GSUs, AWS Bedrock Provisioned Throughput)

  • Experiment tracking & model registry: MLflow

  • LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust and Datadog LLM Observability, plus distributed tracing for tool calls and agent decision paths

  • Container / Orchestration: Kubernetes (GKE / EKS), Docker, Helm, Kustomize

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform

  • Observability: Datadog

  • And any other tool you deem relevant!

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • HR interview by phone (45 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (1 hour)

  • Case study & case restitution (1 hour)

  • Behavioral interview (1 hour 30 minutes)

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Tech stack: Python, LiteLLM, Google ADK, Kubernetes

  • Full-time

  • Paris, France

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

Position Overview

CRA’s Forensic Services practice supports companies’ commitment to integrity by assisting them and their counsel in independently responding to allegations of fraud, waste, abuse, misconduct, and non-compliance. We are noted for deploying cross-trained teams of forensic professionals to assist our clients in gaining deeper insights and greater value more quickly. We provide accounting and forensic services as well as cybercrime investigation services.

The opportunities to contribute to the team in this Senior Associate role may include (but are not limited to):

  • Execute security and privacy investigations for CRA clients, in preparation of, and in response to, data security matters, which may include ongoing breach detection, threat analysis, incident response and malware analysis;
  • Perform forensic analysis of digital information using standard computer forensics and evidence handling techniques and computer forensics tools;
  • Improve the ability of the incident response team to react to incidents by evaluating and implementing new tools and processes;
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of effective relationships with local, state and federal law enforcement agencies to assist in criminal matters;
  • Prepare client communications for project milestones and senior leadership;
  • Manage risk by implementing quality control measures and documentation;
  • Participate in team recruiting and retention efforts and manage team morale. Manage the growth and professional development of junior staff members;
  • Provide management support to engagement teams led by senior personnel;
  • Support engagement planning and management. Participate in project team execution, analysis, and work product. Manage and supervise teams as appropriate;
  • Provide technical assessment/audit and guidance to clients on the adequacy of cyber security controls in accordance with cybersecurity frameworks that are included in one or more of the following - NIST CSF 2.0, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and 27002, SOC2, NERC-CIP, 
  • Interface with client personnel;
  • Assist in business development efforts by drafting proposals and coordinating with other practice areas within the firm.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferred) in a related field;
  • 5-7 years’ experience in cyber intrusion investigation or incident response analysis;
  • Ability to effectively prioritize multiple projects and meet timely deadlines;
  • Experience in a hands-on technical role functioning as an incident responder, network forensic analyst or malware analyst;
  • Experience with data analytics engagements and contributing to the execution of technology-based best practices;
  • Working knowledge of computer hardware components, operating systems, file systems, computer networks, e-mail systems, mobile devices, IT security or incident response;
  • Deep knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, design, traffic flow, protocols, sessions), operating systems (Windows / *nix) and web technologies.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in the United Kingdom, we require the following:

  • CV/Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

If you are interested in applying for one of our international locations, please visit our Careers site to view and apply for available jobs.

title: (Senior) Backend Engineer – Golang (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
(Senior) Backend Engineer – Golang (f/m/d)

The essentials

  • Team: Product & Engineering
  • Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Salary band: shared before your first interview
  • Working language: English (German: a plus)

Your impact

At 7NXT Health Group, our apps help people train, eat better, sleep and meditate across our brands Gymondo, 7Mind and BuddyFit. We are a small backend team, so every engineer owns their work end to end: the code, the infrastructure, the deployment and what happens in production afterwards.

As (Senior) Backend Engineer – Golang (f/m/d), you enjoy that kind of ownership and help us keep the platform simple, reliable and cheap to run. We work AI-first across the whole product cycle, not only when writing code.

What you’ll drive

  • You build and own backend services: APIs for our web and mobile apps, and handlers for platform events
  • You design reliable event flows that are safe to retry and easy to recover
  • You model data around how it is read and written
  • You own the infrastructure for what you build, as code
  • You continuously ship to production and own post-release activities, monitoring both product and engineering metrics
  • You investigate production issues end to end, from root cause to fix
  • You work on critical data systems for subscriptions, payments and partner integrations, where correctness matters most
  • You keep the platform simple by retiring legacy parts we no longer need
  • You take features from idea to release together with product, mobile, web and data colleagues

What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years of professional backend experience with Golang and its ecosystem, following best practices
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless: Lambda, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB and IAM — you know how cold starts, timeouts, concurrency and payload limits affect a design
  • Experience with event-driven systems: at-least-once delivery, idempotency, ordering, retries and dead-letter queues
  • Experience changing system infrastructure with Terraform or a similar infrastructure-as-code tool
  • Solid data modelling in both NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB) and relational databases
  • Experience designing and documenting REST APIs with OpenAPI for mobile and web clients
  • Good testing habits: unit tests for complex business logic, integration tests against real dependencies and thorough peer code reviews
  • Comfort debugging live systems with observability tools and direct data queries
  • Fluent English — German is a plus, not a requirement

How you work

  • Product engineer mindset: you balance technical quality with business impact and point out trade-offs that favour user value and speed to market without hurting the long-term health of the system
  • AI-first product engineering: you use AI across the whole product cycle, not only to write code — shaping ideas, writing specs, building, testing, reviewing and investigating production issues, and spotting where AI can make the product itself better
  • Ownership: you ship a change, watch it in production and fix it if it misbehaves
  • Clear communication with the whole Product & Engineering team and with stakeholders such as customer support and partners
  • You write things down: useful tickets, feature documentation, PR descriptions that explain the why, and a proper post-mortem after an incident
  • You keep good relationships in the team, stay humble, are always willing to learn from others and share what you know

Our tech stack

  • Language: Golang
  • Libraries and tooling: Golang ecosystem, Gin, AWS SDKs for Go, testify, testcontainers
  • Compute: AWS Lambda, EC2
  • Events: SNS, SQS and scheduled jobs
  • Data: DynamoDB, Amazon DocumentDB (MongoDB), MySQL, ElastiCache, OpenSearch
  • Identity: Amazon Cognito, OIDC and SSO with externals
  • Infrastructure as code and delivery: Terraform, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD
  • Observability: New Relic (APM, logs, alerts) and CloudWatch
  • Integrations: payment providers, App Store and Google Play billing, CRM, CMS and AI services

People who make things happen

Gymondo is one of the leading digital fitness and nutrition platforms in the DACH region — with over 2,000 workouts, holistic training programmes and smart nutrition plans. As part of 7NXT Health Group, we help millions of people make movement a lasting part of their everyday lives.

Our team pushes each other, thinks critically and grows together. We take responsibility — for our users, our products and our planet.

We welcome what makes you unique.

At Gymondo we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of fitness & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

title: Senior Cloud Native Storage Engineer Ceph (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die noris network AG steht für innovative, sichere und nachhaltige IT-Lösungen. Mit über 600 engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir leistungsstarke Services in den Bereichen Cloud, Datacenter, Network & Security sowie Managed Applications – betrieben auf einer hochmodernen, mehrfach zertifizierten IT-Infrastruktur mit eigenen Hochsicherheitsrechenzentren. Seit 1993 sind wir kontinuierlich gewachsen und zählen heute zu den führenden IT-Spezialisten in Deutschland. Unser größtes Kapital? Ein starkes, diverses Team mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mitzugestalten. Deshalb fördern wir Eigenverantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und frische Ideen – in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit vereint.

Du willst Storage nicht nur betreiben, sondern wirklich gestalten?

Dann werde Teil unseres Cloud Native Teams und gestalte die Storage-Basis unserer souveränen Cloud-Plattform. Wir setzen auf Open Source, eigene deutsche Rechenzentren und Technologien wie Ceph, OpenStack und Kubernetes. Dabei verbinden wir technische Freiheit mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Auditierbarkeit.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere produktiven Ceph-Cluster und entwickelst deren Architektur kontinuierlich weiter

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Engineering und Betrieb komplexer Linux- und Storage-Infrastrukturen

  • Solides Verständnius von Netzwerktechnologien wie Routing, DNS, Firewalling und NAT
  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Legal team plays a crucial role in advancing our mission by tackling innovative and fundamental legal issues in AI. You will support OpenAI’s business across EMEA, with Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH) as the primary market focus. You will work with Go-To-Market, Product Partnerships, Procurement, Finance, Product, Infrastructure, and Engineering.

This is a great opportunity to join OpenAI’s commercial legal team, negotiating high-impact agreements and helping to build scalable frameworks for responsible growth.

This role can be based in Dublin, Ireland or Munich, Germany. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice to teams including GTM, Product Partnerships, Finance, Procurement, and Operations.

  • Identify and address commercial, product, regulatory, privacy, and other legal issues arising from EMEA commercial transactions.

  • Develop strategies and processes for handling legal issues in creative and scalable ways that support growth.

  • Monitor and advise on regulatory and compliance matters affecting AI and technology.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across OpenAI’s global legal team to ensure alignment across jurisdictions.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Hold a German legal qualification and have 10+ years of experience in independently drafting and negotiating complex commercial contracts, including enterprise technology deals in DACH and product or technology partnerships.

title: Senior Concept Creative (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a creative storyteller to join our Brand Team: someone who comes up with big ideas and knows exactly how to communicate them.

About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As our Senior Concept Creative, you’ll join our Brand team, where we own the brand core: what we stand for, how we sound and the stories we tell. You’ll create the ideas the rest of the team builds on. Some weeks you’re creating the big concept for a product launch, the one idea that runs through the campaign, the packaging and the visual direction, and then finding the name and the messaging that sells it. Other weeks you’re pitching a PR box nobody has done before, or developing the concept for an event people will queue to get into. You can deliver a launch concept and turn around a sharp story for a 4-day sales moment in the same week. You love both: the big idea, and the words that make it sell.

Your Tasks

  • Create concepts for product launches, brand and marketing campaigns, commercial moments, PR boxes and events, built on business needs and marketing expectations, with the brand in mind

  • Adapt your ideas across markets, formats and channels.

  • Name things in a unique and memorable way: products, set boxes, campaigns, commercial moments and formats.

  • Write the lines that sell, from taglines and campaign claims to key messages and launch copy, and build the messaging hierarchy for every launch so everyone tells one story, in the right order.

  • Spot opportunities in culture, on social media and in beauty, pitch them, and lead brainstorms that keep pushing ideas until they are sharp.

  • Turn ideas into clear concepts, scripts, content briefings and mood boards.

  • Work with Design and Content to translate your concepts into visual direction, shoots and UGC, and partner with our Campaign Manager so concepts are delivered on time across every channel.

  • Team up with our Brand Experience Manager on packaging and PR boxes, our Brand Activation Manager on launch events, and PR & Comms to take your story to press.

Your Profile

  • You have 5 to 10 years of experience in a creative, concept or copy role at an agency or brand, ideally in beauty or lifestyle.

  • You’re a storyteller. You find the story in a product and make people care about it, and you understand how stories travel across countries such as France, Italy, Spain and the US.

  • You think in big ideas, and you know why they’ll work and how they’ll sell. You come up with lots of ideas quickly, dare to pitch the crazy ones, know which one to fight for, and take feedback as fuel, not criticism.

  • You write short, sharp copy in fluent English, and you know the difference between a nice line and one that sells.

  • You’ve worked on launches or campaigns with sales targets and understand promotions, retail and marketplaces. You use campaign and channel performance (paid social hooks, CRM, PDP conversion, influencer reach) to learn which stories sell, and feed that into the next concept.

  • You have taste in humor, visuals and aesthetics, a real love for beauty, and you consume a lot of social media.

  • You have a portfolio of concepts and copy you created yourself, and you’re up for a short creative task as part of the process.

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lawhive

Lawhive is an AI-native law firm operating in the US and UK. We partner with leading Main Street law firms and give their lawyers and back-office teams what they need to grow faster than they could alone: our own AI platform, plus marketing and operational support.

We build that platform ourselves, alongside the people who use it every day. That means no guessing what users want, no six-month feedback loops, and no compromises to fit someone else’s product. At its heart is Lawrence, our AI agent for legal work. Lawrence takes on the heavy lifting so lawyers can put their judgement where it belongs: at the centre of every matter. We’re a team obsessed with building the best tools in legal.

We're backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.

So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

The Role

We’re rapidly acquiring law firms and bringing them onto our platform. Every one comes with its own case management system, its own reporting and its own messy data, and how quickly we bring it together shapes how fast Lawhive can grow.

As our Senior Data Engineer, you’ll own our data engineering, including the hands-on work behind every migration. Working with our Head of Data, you’ll make each migration faster than the last.

You’ll sit at the foundation of a small, AI-native data team, building the pipelines our Analytics Engineer and product analytics rely on, so data actually improves the product. You’ll work alongside our staff engineers and bring the DevOps, infrastructure, security and governance know-how to run your own platform.

Our stack: BigQuery, dbt, Hex, Dagster, K8s, Elementary, Claude Code, GCP and AWS.

Why This Role Matters

  • You’ll build data engineering for AI and humans. What you build doesn’t just serve people. It feeds Lawrence, our AI agent for legal work, and makes it better.

  • You’ll make every migration faster than the last. You’ll work out what we can standardise across firms, what needs to stand alone, and how we move faster each time. You’ll work with Analytics Engineering on a shared model that scales to every firm, with the right access and privacy controls in place.

  • You’ll lay the foundations for product insight. Good data engineering leads to good analytics engineering, product analytics and product insight. You’ll build the layer everything else sits on.

  • You’ll own the platform. Pipelines, orchestration, infrastructure, security and governance. You’ll keep BigQuery fast and cost-efficient as volumes grow.

  • You’ll help build the function. The data team is small and the company is scaling fast. There’s real scope to grow into leading a team and building out data engineering as a central function.

What You’ll Bring

  • Senior data engineering experience at a startup or scale-up. You’ve owned production pipelines and seen your work through to real business outcomes.

  • Data migration and integration. You’ve brought together messy data from very different source systems. The more varied the industries you’ve worked across, the better.

  • Modern tech stack. Strong BigQuery (or similar), Python and orchestration (Dagster, Airflow or similar).

  • Platform engineering. Experience across DevOps, infrastructure, security and governance.

  • AI-native, with opinions. AI is part of how you work every day, and you’re clear on where it helps and where you draw the line.

  • Commercial instinct. You care about what your work does for the business, not just whether the pipeline runs.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Protection Engineer (Backup & Cyber Resilience)

Location: Windsor, UK

Introduction

We’re hiring a Senior Data Protection Engineer to join a global hosting and managed services team. The team runs business-critical, highly regulated systems for organisations around the world, many of them in healthcare, where losing data or failing to recover it is not an option.

This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. You’ll also help shape where data protection services go next, at a time when cyber resilience matters more than ever.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Run the platform globally. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. This covers configuration, upgrades, capacity planning, health monitoring, security hardening and lifecycle management.

  • Set the rules. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls.

  • Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures.

  • Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments.

  • Keep operations healthy. Monitor backup, replication, archiving and restore activity. Fix failed jobs, capacity pressure, performance issues and policy exceptions before they become risks.

  • Prove that recovery works. Plan and run restore tests, disaster recovery exercises and readiness reviews, and keep the evidence that recovery targets and controls are met.

  • Strengthen cyber resilience. Work with security and incident response teams on ransomware readiness, anomaly investigations, clean-recovery planning and privileged-access controls.

  • Build strong governance. Write the runbooks, standards and procedures that define good practice, and help regions and technology teams adopt them consistently.

  • Lead when it counts. Take technical ownership during incidents and service disruptions, and drive root cause analysis and lasting corrective actions.

  • Automate. Use APIs, scripting and orchestration tools to automate routine operations, compliance checks, reporting and workflows.

  • Report clearly. Give regular insight into protection coverage, recoverability, compliance, capacity, platform risk and operational performance.

  • Work across teams. Partner closely with infrastructure, cloud, database, application, security, risk and business continuity colleagues, and take part in a shared on-call rota for critical production services.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

  • A solid track record of engineering and running enterprise-scale backup, recovery and data protection services

  • Extensive hands-on production experience with Rubrik

  • A current Rubrik Certified System Administrator (RCSA) certification

  • Experience designing and rolling out data protection policies, standards and operating models across multiple regions

  • A strong grasp of retention, immutability, encryption, access control, RPO and RTO, and recovery validation

  • Hands-on involvement in disaster recovery, cyber recovery or ransomware-resilience initiatives

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

Benefits & Culture

  • Global reach and visible impact: Your work will directly protect critical services, including healthcare systems that clinicians and care providers rely on every day.

  • Real ownership: You’ll have a strong voice in policy design, retention strategy, cyber resilience, automation and the long-term direction of the service.

  • Collaborative environment: You’ll join experienced engineers and architects who value shared ownership, operational excellence and openly sharing knowledge.

  • Growth and development: You’ll keep developing your skills on an enterprise-grade platform, with support for certifications and continuous learning.

  • Competitive rewards: The package includes market-aligned pay and comprehensive benefits that reflect a senior technical role.

If you want to make data protection dependable at a global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior DevOps & Cloud Engineer – Defense (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Deine nächste Projektperspektive mit New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und bringen erfahrene Spezialist in Kundenprojekte entlang des digitalen Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Unsere Wurzeln liegen im UX- und UI-Design. Diesen Fokus erweitern wir um Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, Cloud, Data und Informationssicherheit.

Für zukünftige Projekte im Defense- und sicherheitskritischen Umfeld möchten wir erfahrene DevOps- und Cloud-Expert kennenlernen, die bereits in dieser Branche gearbeitet haben. Du bringst praktische Erfahrung mit den besonderen Anforderungen sicherheitskritischer und regulierter Projektumgebungen mit und entwickelst sichere, automatisierte und zuverlässig betreibbare Plattformen.

Deine möglichen Aufgaben

  • Du baust containerbasierte Plattformen mit Kubernetes und/oder OpenShift auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du automatisierst Infrastruktur und Deployments und etablierst reproduzierbare Konfigurationen.

  • Du entwickelst und betreust CI/CD-Pipelines, beispielsweise mit GitLab CI, und unterstützt Entwicklungsteams bei sicheren Release-Prozessen.

  • Du arbeitest je nach Projekt mit privaten oder abgeschotteten Cloud- und Virtualisierungsumgebungen.

  • Du unterstützt bei Monitoring, Logging, Fehleranalyse und der Sicherstellung eines stabilen Plattformbetriebs.

  • Du setzt Sicherheitsanforderungen um und dokumentierst Architektur, Konfigurationen und Betriebsprozesse nachvollziehbar.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im DevOps-, Cloud- oder Plattform-Engineering.

  • Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse in Linux sowie Kubernetes und/oder OpenShift.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code und automatisierten Deployments.

  • Erfahrung mit passenden Werkzeugen, beispielsweise Helm, GitLab CI und Terraform oder Ansible.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Netzwerken, Routing, DNS, VPN sowie Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten.

  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung im Defense-Bereich, beispielsweise bei Unternehmen der Verteidigungsindustrie, der Bundeswehr oder deren IT-Dienstleistern.

  • Vertrautheit mit den besonderen Sicherheitsanforderungen, Freigabeprozessen und Dokumentationspflichten in diesem regulierten Umfeld.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes einschlägiges Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Reisebereitschaft für projektabhängige Kundeneinsätze innerhalb Deutschlands.

Ergänzend sind Kenntnisse in abgeschotteten Betriebsumgebungen, deklarativen Linux-Systemen oder Virtualisierungslösungen wie VMware und Proxmox von Vorteil. Voraussetzung ist deine nachweisbare Projekterfahrung im Defense-Bereich sowie im Aufbau und Betrieb sicherheitskritischer Plattformen.

Besonderheiten im Projektumfeld

Die Bereitschaft, eine erforderliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung zu durchlaufen, ist Voraussetzung. Für einzelne Projekte wird bereits eine gültige erweiterte Sicherheitsüberprüfung (Ü2) verlangt. Weitere Zugangsvoraussetzungen klären wir anhand des konkreten Projekts. Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung an, ob bereits eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung vorliegt; vertrauliche Nachweise benötigen wir im ersten Schritt nicht.

Die Zusammenarbeit

Bei einem passenden Projekt ist eine Festanstellung bei New Monday vorgesehen, bei der du deine Expertise beim Kunden einbringst. New Monday arbeitet remote; im Defense-Umfeld können jedoch projektabhängig regelmäßige oder überwiegende Vor-Ort-Einsätze erforderlich sein. Arbeitsort und Remote-Anteil besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Schick uns deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf mit aussagekräftigen Projektbeschreibungen und vorhandenen Zertifizierungen. Ergänze bitte deine Verfügbarkeit beziehungsweise Kündigungsfrist und deine Gehaltsvorstellung als Bruttojahresgehalt.

Wir prüfen dein Profil und kommen bei einer passenden Projektmöglichkeit auf dich zu.

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.

title: Senior Director, Reporting & Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Director to lead our Enterprise Reporting and Analytics Engineering organization, a team of analytics engineers, report developers, visualization specialists, and people leaders. This organization focuses on the last mile of the enterprise data supply chain: the semantic models, curated data products, metric definitions, and consumption experiences that turn engineered data into decisions.

This is not a traditional reporting leadership role; the classic notion of “reporting” in the form of a myriad of dashboards and filters is racing towards obsolescence. But the need for data and insights, and the need to deliver it in a way that is digestible and actionable, is timeless. Yes, governed dashboards and trusted reporting remain the foundation, and this leader must be excellent at that foundation. But the mandate is to move the organization decisively beyond static reporting toward a proactive, intelligent analytics capability: partnering with Data Science to productize and visualize their models, enabling generative AI and LLM-based access to our data, building exception-based systems that alert users when outcomes deviate from expectation in a statistically meaningful way, and designing agents that monitor data continuously and deliver insight without being asked.

Analytics engineering shares much of its DNA with data engineering — modeling, transformation, testing, version control, CI/CD, performance and cost discipline — but is oriented toward business enablement rather than platform and pipeline. Success in this role therefore depends as much on partnership as on technical depth. This leader will work shoulder to shoulder with Data Engineering on the boundary between platform and consumption, with Product Management on roadmap and requirements, with Data Science on advanced analytic products, and with Analytics Operations on a disciplined intake and prioritization process that makes the best possible use of finite capacity.

The ideal candidate has spent years building the traditional foundations — governance, metadata, lineage, dimensional modeling, engaging with enterprise BI platforms— and is now looking to apply that rigor to a fundamentally different generation of analytic products in new and innovative ways.

What you'll be doing:

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop an organization of approximately 30 people, including managing through frontline managers; own hiring, role clarity, career pathing, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Define a multi-year vision and roadmap for enterprise reporting and analytics engineering, and translate it into quarterly outcomes the team and its partners can measure. Partner closely with Product Management to jointly shape the multi-year enterprise end-to-end data strategy.
  • Own the organization's budget, vendor relationships, and contractor or offshore capacity.
  • Establish and sustain an engineering culture within an analytics function: peer review, automated testing, documentation standards, source control, CI/CD, etc.

Analytics Engineering and Data Architecture

  • Drive maturity of the last-mile architecture in partnership with Data Engineering: curated marts, semantic layers, reusable data products, and certified datasets that serve reporting, ai enablement, data science, and downstream applications.
  • Define and enforce dimensional modeling standards, transformation frameworks, and modular, tested, version-controlled analytics code.
  • Own the enterprise metric layer so that key business measures carry a single, governed definition regardless of where they are consumed.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to define clear contracts and handoffs between pipeline and platform work and last-mile modeling, including shared tooling, standards, and escalation paths.
  • Manage query performance, warehouse consumption, and platform cost as first-class engineering concerns.

Data Governance, Metadata, and Lineage

  • Own cataloging, business glossary, data certification, and stewardship workflows, leveraging tools such as Atlan as the primary metadata platform.
  • Maintain column-level lineage across the analytics estate to support impact analysis, change management, audit, and root-cause investigation.
  • Leverage data access provisioning and entitlement models, including row- and column-level security, in partnership with Security, Privacy, and Compliance.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to drive data quality monitoring, freshness and availability SLAs, observability, and incident response for analytic assets.

Enterprise Reporting and Data Visualization

  • Drive analytics engagement by leveraging enterprise visualization and provisioning platforms, including Domo and Tableau, in partnership with Data Engineering. Ensure best practices are followed in data architecture, governance, adoption, performance, and total cost management.
  • Set visualization and information design standards that make reports readable, consistent, accessible, and decision-oriented.
  • Rationalize the existing reporting portfolio: retire redundant and unused assets, consolidate overlapping content, drive down tech debt and drive consumption toward certified sources.
  • Build a durable self-service capability through training, templates, community, office hours, and clear guardrails on what belongs in self-service versus centrally managed content.

Advanced, Proactive, and AI-Enabled Analytics

  • Partner with Data Science to productize their work: build the visualization, interaction, monitoring, and feedback loops that turn models and research into products the business actually uses.
  • Partner with Product Management and Data Engineering to enable generative AI and LLM access to enterprise data. This includes preparing the semantic and metadata foundation that makes data legible to models, delivering conversational analytics, text-to-SQL, and retrieval-augmented experiences on governed sources, and establishing guardrails, evaluation, and accuracy monitoring so that answers can be trusted.
  • Build exception-based analytics that detect when an outcome deviates from its expected value in a statistically significant way, using seasonality-aware baselines, forecast residuals, control limits, and anomaly detection rather than static thresholds.
  • Route those exceptions to accountable owners with context, likely drivers, and a recommended next action; actively tune sensitivity and volume to prevent alert fatigue and preserve signal.
  • Design and deploy analytic agents that proactively monitor data, investigate variances, assemble narrative explanations, and deliver insight into the tools where people already work.
  • Shift the organization's consumption model from pull to push: the measure of success is not how many people opened a dashboard, but whether the right person was told the right thing at the right time.

Cross-Functional Partnership, Intake, and Prioritization

  • Operate as a true partner to Product Management: contribute to roadmap, requirements, user research, and release planning, and run analytics with a product mindset covering personas, adoption metrics, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Analytics Operations to run a transparent intake, triage, sizing, and prioritization process, with published capacity, explicit tradeoffs, and reliable delivery commitments.
  • Make capacity constraints visible to stakeholders and executives, drive reuse over one-off builds, and decline or defer work with evidence rather than friction.
  • Serve as a senior, executive-facing partner to business functions, translating ambiguous business questions into well-scoped analytic solutions.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, or business intelligence, including 8+ years leading teams and 4+ years managing managers.
  • Demonstrated experience leading an organization of 25 or more people in a large, matrixed enterprise.
  • Strong hands-on foundation in SQL, dimensional modeling, and ELT/ETL design, with production experience on a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse (for example Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or Synapse) and a transformation framework such as dbt.
  • Experience applying software engineering practices to analytics work, including Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD.
  • Enterprise-scale leveraging of BI and data visualization platforms such as Domo, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, including governance, provisioning, adoption, and cost management.
  • Demonstrated ability to participate in driving data governance program covering catalog, lineage, glossary, stewardship, quality, and access, using platforms such as Atlan, Collibra, Alation, or Informatica.
  • Proven track record of delivering jointly with Data Engineering and Product Management, with clear ownership boundaries and shared accountability.
  • Direct experience partnering with Data Science, including operationalizing, visualizing, and monitoring model output for business consumption.
  • Working command of the statistical concepts underlying exception detection, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, variance and control limits, seasonality, and forecasting.
  • Experience running a formal intake, prioritization, and capacity planning process for a shared services or platform organization.
  • Excellent executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Experience managing budget, vendor contracts, and platform licensing.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master's degree or MBA in a related field.
  • Production experience delivering LLM-based analytics: retrieval-augmented generation over governed data, text-to-SQL or conversational BI, semantic layers designed for model consumption, and prompt, evaluation, and cost monitoring frameworks.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows and orchestration for monitoring, investigation, and notification use cases.
  • Hands-on experience with Atlan, Domo, and Tableau specifically.
  • Proficiency in Python or R for prototyping, and familiarity with common statistical and ML libraries and MLOps concepts.
  • Experience deploying anomaly detection at scale, including alert routing, suppression, and fatigue management.
  • Familiarity with data product and data mesh operating models, domain-aligned ownership, and data contracts.
  • Experience operating in an Agile or product operating model at scale, including portfolio, OKR, and roadmap management. Deep experience with the “Silicon Valley” school of Product Management, as exemplified by the “Marty Kagan”-style academic approach a significant plus.
  • Experience leading global or matrixed teams, including offshore or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Track record leading a major platform migration, consolidation, or reporting rationalization effort.
  • Demonstrated success attracting, developing, and retaining senior technical talent in a competitive market.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.
