title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems.
  • Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance.
  • Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware.
  • Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems.
  • Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces.
  • Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning.
  • Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error.
  • Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software.

    • Who you are
  • An senior embedded software engineer with 8+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems.
  • Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints.
  • Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
  • Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers.
  • Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them.
  • Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour.
  • Curious about FPGA-adjacent workflows and comfortable interfacing with low-level logic when required.
  • Motivated by building flight-critical software in a small team where your code directly affects system behaviour.

    • What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

    • Security and Eligibility Requirement

    Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Senior Global Manager, Enterprise Ads & Promos
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Global Advertising Manager

​​Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Advertising team sits at the intersection of commerce, data and marketing helping restaurant and grocery partners accelerate growth through smart, insight-led media solutions. From shaping high-impact campaign strategies to optimising performance at scale, we combine commercial acumen with deep marketplace insight to unlock value for our partners while driving sustainable revenue growth for Deliveroo.

We’re looking for a Senior Global Advertising Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us craft and execute advertising strategies that exceed the needs of our restaurant partners and drive quarterly growth, both directly with key partners and at scale through enabling and leading global commercial teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Ads and Account Management team. We focus on building deep partnerships, enabling commercial teams, and crafting tailored media strategies to accelerate partner growth across our marketplace.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Identify Data-Led Opportunities: Proactively identify scope to increase advertising penetration and spend using a combination of data analytics and commercial insight.

  • Develop Processes & Go-To-Market Programs: Originating programs and reporting frameworks that organise commercial teams behind key opportunities to track progress effectively.

  • Enable Teams & Build Playbooks: Build playbooks, training, and go-to-market materials that equip global commercial and account management teams to maximise advertising revenue.

  • People & Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and support team members, setting clear goals and fostering a culture of high performance and professional growth.

  • Partner Strategy & Campaign Management: Work directly with major restaurant partners to understand marketing objectives, propose tailored ad solutions, and coordinate campaign launches, management, and reporting.

  • Performance Monitoring & Optimisation: Proactively monitor campaign performance, identifying, communicating, and resolving any issues to exceed partner objectives.

  • Shape Product Solutions: Act as the voice of our partners to feed structured feedback back into internal teams, informing how we iterate and build improved advertising and reporting products.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Commercial Advertising Experience: Significant experience in commercially focused roles, with a strong background in performance advertising or account management.

  • People Leadership & Management: Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop team members, driving high engagement and performance against commercial targets.

  • Strategy & Process Scaling: Demonstrated capability in defining, launching, and scaling go-to-market strategies and operational processes across teams.

  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional relationship-building skills with a proven ability to work effectively and build trusted relationships with multiple internal and external partners.

  • Analytical & Innovative Thinking: Highly analytical mindset with strong capability to interpret data and turn findings into strategic commercial recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Digital Marketing & Marketplace Experience: Prior exposure to digital marketing environments, e-commerce, or aggregator platforms.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

MultiTankcard | MoveMove has been active in business mobility for over 30 years. Through our self-developed IT platform, we authorise, process and invoice tens of millions of mobility transactions every year for more than half a million active users.

With MultiTankcard, we serve business lease drivers through nearly all major leasing companies in the Netherlands. With MoveMove, we focus on a fast-growing group of entrepreneurs and SMEs.

The mobility market is changing rapidly. Electric driving, public transport, parking and other forms of mobility are increasingly coming together. As our business continues to grow, both nationally and internationally, our organisation needs to grow with it.

Your mission

Your mission is to help build an organisation that is ready for its next phase of growth.

As Senior HR Business Partner, you are responsible for HR across MultiTankcard | MoveMove and part of the Management Team. You report directly to the CEO and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO, the MT and the wider leadership team.

You translate business strategy into a clear people and HR agenda, while staying close to what is happening across teams and the organisation.

What the role looks like

This is a broad senior HR role where strategy and execution come together.

You’ll shape the HR vision and priorities for the organisation and help answer the people questions that come with growth: what does our future organisation look like, what kind of leadership do we need, which capabilities do we need to build, and how do we create a culture in which people can perform and develop?

At the same time, you remain visible and approachable across the organisation. You support leaders and employees on day-to-day HR topics and make sure our HR processes are professional, pragmatic and effective.

What you’ll do

  • Shape and drive the people and HR strategy, aligned with the overall business strategy and growth ambitions.

  • Develop leadership across the organisation, acting as a sparring partner and coach to the CEO, MT and other managers.

  • Build a strong approach to learning and development, helping employees grow both professionally and personally.

  • Drive organisation development, including structure, culture, capabilities, talent, succession and workforce planning.

  • Further professionalise our HR framework, including performance management, compensation, benefits and HR policies.

  • Strengthen recruitment, retention and employer branding so we can attract and keep the people we need.

  • Advise on complex HR and employment matters, while keeping the approach practical and business-focused.

  • Turn plans into action, setting the annual HR agenda and making sure priorities are actually delivered.

What you bring

  • Significant experience in a broad senior HR role, such as HR Business Partner, HR Manager or similar.

  • Experience as a strategic sparring partner to senior leadership or a Management Team.

  • A strong track record in organisation development, leadership development and learning & development.

  • Experience building and professionalising HR policies, processes and tools.

  • Good knowledge of Dutch employment law and current HR developments.

  • A pragmatic, entrepreneurial mindset and the confidence to challenge, advise and give push-back when needed.

  • Strong communication and influencing skills in both Dutch and English.

  • Bachelor’s-level thinking and working ability, gained through education or experience.

We are looking for someone with substantial relevant HR experience, but we care more about the impact you can make than ticking every box.

What we offer & what happens next

You’ll have a lot of freedom to shape the HR agenda and make a visible impact on the organisation. We work with short lines, encourage initiative and like to move quickly.

We offer:

  • A gross monthly salary of €4,700 to €6,200 on a full-time basis, depending on your experience

  • 25 holiday days based on a full-time working week

  • Hybrid working: around 40% from home and 60% from our renovated office in Hoofddorp

  • The option to work fully remote for periods of time

  • Full pension contribution

  • A phone allowance and home-working allowance

  • A contribution towards your health insurance

Interested? We’d love to meet you.

The process is simple: first, an informal conversation to get to know each other and explore the role. If there’s a match, we’ll continue the conversation and move quickly from there.

Questions about the role or application process? Feel free to contact Maaike de Koningh via 06 21977997

title: Senior Konstruktionsingenieur (w/m/x) (80-100%)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unseres Design Engineering Teams als hoch erfahrener Individual Contributor. Du löst anspruchsvolle mechanische Konstruktionsaufgaben selbst, von Konzepten und CAD-Modellen über Fertigungszeichnungen und Prototypen bis zu getesteter Hardware, und unterstützt gleichzeitig das erweiterte Team bei fundierten technischen Entscheidungen.

Als Senior Konstruktionsingenieur (w/m/x) bist du ein Hands-on-Mitglied unseres Design Engineering Teams und konstruierst die CO2 Collectors von Climeworks, das Herzstück unserer Direct-Air-Capture-Anlage. Wie leistungsfähig diese Collectors sind, wie sie gefertigt werden und wie sie sich skalieren lassen, ist entscheidend für den künftigen Erfolg von DAC.

  • Mechanisches Konzept- & Produktdesign: Du verwandelst neue Konzepte eigenständig in robuste physische Produkte: Du entwickelst mechanische Konzepte, erstellst CAD-Modelle, konstruierst Komponenten und komplette Kollektorbaugruppen, erstellst Fertigungszeichnungen und begleitest die Hardware durch Fertigung, Montage und Tests.

  • Technische Problemlösung & Risikoreduktion: Deine Erfahrung hilft dir, schneller die richtigen Lösungen zu finden, Probleme frühzeitig zu erkennen und Risiken zu reduzieren, bevor sie sich in der Fertigung oder bei Tests auswirken.

  • CO₂-Kollektordesign: Du entwickelst mechanische Systeme von den Anforderungen und ersten Konzepten bis hin zu detaillierten, fertigungsgerechten Konstruktionen. Du erarbeitest Lösungen, führst technische Berechnungen durch und triffst die notwendigen Entscheidungen, um robuste industrielle Hardware zu entwickeln.

  • Engineering nach grundlegenden Prinzipien: Du nutzt deine Erfahrung und dein Denken nach grundlegenden technischen Prinzipien, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen, Alternativen schnell zu bewerten und einfache, robuste Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du setzt Berechnungen, Toleranzanalysen, Design Reviews und Tests ein, um Unsicherheiten zu reduzieren.

  • Design vom Konzept bis zur Kommerzialisierung: Du arbeitest direkt in SolidWorks, um Teile, Baugruppen und Systemlayouts zu erstellen und anzupassen. Du steuerst komplexe Schnittstellen, Bauraumbeschränkungen und Designänderungen, damit das Gesamtsystem optimal zusammenspielt. Du erstellst und pflegst hochwertige 2D-Fertigungszeichnungen, einschließlich geeigneter GD&T-Angaben, Toleranzen, Materialien, Oberflächen und Fertigungsanforderungen.

  • Prototypenfertigung, Montage & Tests: Du bleibst auch nach Abschluss der CAD-Arbeiten eng eingebunden. Du unterstützt die Fertigung, Montage und das Testen von Prototypen, untersuchst auftretende Probleme und lässt die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse wieder in das Design einfließen.

  • Technische Führung & Design Reviews: Du fungierst als erfahrene technische Ansprechperson für das Team und unterstützt die Leitung des Design Engineering Teams bei Design Reviews, Engineering-Standards und der Freigabe kritischer Designs. Du unterstützt das erweiterte Team mit deinem technischen Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen mechanischen Designentscheidungen, trägst zur Einhaltung hoher Engineering-Standards bei und teilst deine Erfahrung durch die tägliche Zusammenarbeit, Mentoring und konstruktives Hinterfragen.

  • Interdisziplinäre Engineering-Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit Fertigung, Testing, Process Engineering, Procurement, Lieferanten und anderen Engineering-Disziplinen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass mechanische Designs als Teil des Gesamtprodukts funktionieren. Bei Bedarf bindest du externe Designressourcen ein.


Was dich auszeichnet

Deine Erfahrung macht deine Ingenieurarbeit wirksamer: Du erkennst vielversprechende Lösungen früh, deckst Schwachstellen auf, bevor sie teuer werden, und lieferst Konstruktionen, die klar, fertigungsgerecht und bereit für den Einsatz in der Praxis sind.

  • Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion: Du bringst 15+ Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion mit, idealerweise in der Entwicklung komplexer Industrieanlagen von der Konzeption über Fertigung und Montage bis zum Test.

  • Blechkonstruktion und Fertigung: Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Blechteilen, Strukturen und Baugruppen für die Fertigung in grossen Stückzahlen. Du kennst Biegen, Schweiss- und Fügeverfahren, Umformen, Toleranzen sowie die Wahl von Material und Blechdicke und weisst, wie sich Konstruktionsentscheide auf Werkzeuge, Kosten, Montage und Qualität auswirken.

  • CAD und Zeichnungen: Du bist SolidWorks-Expertin bzw. -Experte und arbeitest weiterhin selbst im CAD. Du erstellst hochwertige Fertigungszeichnungen persönlich und bist sicher im Umgang mit GD&T und Toleranzketten.

  • System Design und technisches Urteilsvermögen: Du hast Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Komponenten und Mechanismen über Subsysteme und Schnittstellen bis hin zu komplexen Baugruppen. Du verstehst, wie sich Entscheidungen auf einer Ebene auf den gesamten Collector auswirken, und wägst Strukturen, Luftführung, Bewegung, Abdichtung, Prozessschnittstellen, Fertigbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosten ab, um zu robusten Lösungen zu kommen.

  • Fertigung und DFMA: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse über zerspanend gefertigte Teile, Schweisskonstruktionen, Werkstoffe und Fertigungsverfahren und wendest DFMA an, um robuste und kostengünstige Konstruktionen zu entwickeln.

  • Zusammenarbeit und Technical Leadership: Du arbeitest gut mit Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieuren, Technikerinnen und Technikern, Fertigungspartnern und Lieferanten zusammen. Du teilst deine Erfahrung, hinterfragst konstruktiv und hilfst anderen, bessere technische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Ausbildung: Du hast einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Maschinenbau oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst fliessend Englisch. Dies ist ein Muss-Kriterum, da unsere Unternehmenssprache Englisch ist.

Diese Stelle ist nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du hauptsächlich Personen oder Projekte führen möchtest.

  • du hauptsächlich Simulation, Konzeptarbeit oder System Engineering ohne eigene CAD-Arbeit betreibst.

  • du keine Erfahrung mit Blech, Schweisskonstruktionen oder Fertigung in grossen Stückzahlen hast.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

  • Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

  • Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

  • Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

  • Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

  • Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

  • This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The role:

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a senior member of the Paddle legal and compliance team, reporting directly to Paddle’s Director of Legal. The Paddle legal team is well-respected and integrated into Paddle’s business. As a result, this role will require you to collaborate with other teams across the business, and advise cross-functionally, always with a view to empowering the business to achieve its goals while taking a long-term strategic view.

The role itself will be broad and varied, with a core regulatory element. You will be delivering first-rate legal advice in a fast-paced dynamic environment, identifying risk and balancing common sense with your legal expertise. You will be an excellent generalist, comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity.

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will consider the longer-term impacts whilst also being able to react quickly to deliver level-headed, creative and context-appropriate solutions to ensure the best possible customer experience in the ever changing tech space.

The role will be based in the UK but will be global in scope.

 

What you'll do:

You will support the Director of Legal in their duties and advise and partner with every team from across the business on a wide range of matters, including the following:

  • Leadership remit: As a senior member of the team, you will work as part of a small team of lawyers in a wide range of legal work, including corporate and governance matters, administration of Paddle’s international branches and subsidiaries, negotiating commercial agreements, regulatory research and advising our product and support teams. Your duties may include supervising in-house trainee lawyers seeking their SRA qualification.

  • Strategic commercial work: You will assist in the negotiation of strategic commercial contracts, including key supplier and customer agreements.

  • Strategic corporate work: You will assist with the negotiation of strategic corporate contracts, including financing agreements.

  • Regulatory advice (incl data protection):

    • You will lead on the identification and analysis of evolving rules and consumer regulations relevant to Paddle’s global MoR business model.

    • You will collaborate with the compliance function to develop and implement risk and compliance policies and procedures relevant to Paddle’s operations and the MoR business model.

    • You will draft, negotiate, and advise on data protection agreements, terms of service, privacy policies, and other privacy- and data-related contracts and disclosures, collaborating closely with the compliance function.

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a minimum of 8+ years of legal experience, with at least 3 years in-house at a regulated high-growth tech scale-up preferably in payments, FinTech, SaaS or related sectors.

  • You are a UK-qualified solicitor (preferably) or qualified in another common law or European jurisdiction.

  • You enjoy leading and working with junior team members, helping them to grow and realise their potential.

  • You are smart, curious, keen to learn and have a proven ability to quickly get across new and complex legal concepts.

  • You are used to working from first principles, applying common sense, and excited about answering questions you have never dealt with before.

  • You are an excellent and persuasive communicator used to partnering with a range of stakeholders across the business and externally.

  • You are skilled at tailoring your legal advice to the recipient, whether they be senior management or a junior contributor.

  • You are commercially-minded and able to deliver creative, helpful and practical solutions to a rapidly growing business, often operating under pressure and in an area characterized by ambiguity.

     

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

 

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

 

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

 

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

descriptionHtml:

If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Verbatim squad sits within the Enrichment & Content Intelligence product area and is focused on helping Spotify better understand audio, text, and visual content through machine learning. The team develops technologies that power experiences across Spotify including content skipping, transcription, moderation, and visual understanding. Working at the intersection of large-scale machine learning and product innovation, the squad partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to build intelligent systems that improve how users experience content across the platform.

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing un-crewed maritime and air domain systems that leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep experience developing, testing, validating and deploying machine-learning based sensor processing and the technical toolchains they rely on. The Senior Machine Learning Engineer strives to leverage their experience to rapidly architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design, development, integration and support of machine learning models for perception and data pipelines for a variety of autonomous systems across multiple sensor modalities
  • Develop software to manage and automate the machine learning lifecycle, including data management, pipelining, labeling and training
  • Manage model selection, training, validation, evaluation, deployment and regression testing
  • Manage training data sourcing and integration, and quality
  • Develop tools and processes for machine learning in a classified environment
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers, to ensure effective system integration and testing

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in a senior role with the delivery of a production grade software system with a mature machine learning component
  • Experience with the design, implementation and maintenance of ML Operations, including data acquisition, labeling, data curation, pipeline management, continuous integration, model versioning, and monitoring
  • Ability to collaborate with data scientists and stakeholders to define and implement robust validation and verification strategies
  • Experience with the delivery of computer vision capabilities, from the data side as well as the model side
  • Capacity to work holistically on machine learning enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2) 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with the delivery of capability with a public sector customer
  • Experience with workflow management tools such as flyte, airflow, and kubeflow
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch
  • Experience with edge ML applications
  • Experience with inference engines such as TensorRT
  • Experience writing C++, Go, Python or Rust
  • Proficiency in data management and traceability techniques to maintain high-quality datasets and enable reproducibility of experiments and results
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!

Benefits

title: Senior Manager, Growth
descriptionHtml:
Crypto.com is a global cryptocurrency platform serving traders and investors in markets around the world. The CDC product line is our international crypto trading app — spanning spot, perpetual contracts, and card rips — and we are building the next generation of trading products for a global audience.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Growth to sit at the intersection of user acquisition, creative strategy, martech, and measurement. This is not a single-lane role. You’ll own the day-to-day performance of our UA program across paid channels and every market we operate in, but you’ll also lead three critical sub-functions — creative, martech, and measurement — that today sit with senior leadership and need a dedicated operator to take them to the next level.

You’ll work directly with our agency partners, product teams, data science, and platform reps (Meta, Google, Apple) across regions. You’ll inherit a scaled UA program with multiple products launching simultaneously, a global market footprint, and a martech stack that’s being built in real time. If you’re the kind of person who can context-switch between a Meta CAPI payload spec and a creative brief in the same afternoon, this role was made for you.


Responsibilities

User Acquisition Operations

  • Own the weekly operating rhythm for CDC paid UA — spend plans, pacing, optimization decisions, and performance reporting across all channels (Meta, Google, Apple Search, programmatic DSPs, affiliates, regional platforms, and emerging networks), across every market we operate in
  • Manage the relationship with our performance agency on a daily basis — standups, creative briefings, channel strategy, spend allocation, and trading decisions
  • Drive channel-level optimization using CAC, CPFT, pLTV ROAS, and lower-funnel conversion metrics. You’re expected to know what’s working, what’s not, and why before anyone asks
  • Lead GTM execution for new product launches and market openings (spot, perpetual contracts, card rips, new offer structures) — from tracking readiness through creative production through spend activation
  • Build and maintain the weekly trading deck and leadership updates. Present performance narratives to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence
  • Own the competitive monitoring cadence — Sensor Tower, app store rankings, ad intelligence — across key markets, and translate competitive signals into channel and creative decisions
  • Own market prioritisation — which countries we open, in what order, and what each market needs in localisation, payment rails, and channel mix before we commit spend

    • Sub-function: Creative Strategy

    Our creative pipeline is currently managed between agency and leadership. This role takes ownership of the full creative lifecycle for performance marketing.

  • Own the creative learning agenda — what hooks, formats, and concepts we’re testing, what’s winning, and what to kill. Maintain a structured view of creative performance by channel, format, and audience
  • Lead creative briefing for the agency and UGC creators. Translate product updates, offers, and cultural moments into production-ready briefs with clear deliverables and timelines, localised for each market we run in
  • Drive format expansion beyond static display — UGC video, social-native content, meme-format creative, and AI-assisted production pipelines
  • Establish a rapid refresh cadence to combat creative fatigue across channels, and ensure channel-specific sizing and placement specs are met
  • Coordinate with brand and content teams on production shoots, scripting, and asset capture for UA use

    • Sub-function: Martech

    Our martech stack spans AppsFlyer, Segment, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, Impact (affiliates), and multiple ad platform integrations. Today this is led by our VP with execution support from a solo martech lead. This role becomes the strategic owner.

  • Serve as the growth team’s primary point of contact for all tracking, attribution, and signal infrastructure. You’re the person who knows whether events are firing, payloads are complete, and platform signals are flowing
  • Partner with our martech lead to prioritize and unblock implementation work — new product event instrumentation, platform pixel/CAPI builds, conversion upload pipelines, and deep link configuration
  • Own the relationship with platform measurement teams (Google gTech, Meta measurement partners, AppsFlyer TAMs) across regions and ensure their recommendations translate into shipped work
  • Drive martech readiness for every product launch and offer change. If tracking isn’t ready, you’re the one who flags it and owns the escalation
  • Understand the full signal chain from user action to ad platform optimization loop — SDK events, server-to-server integrations, CAPI payloads, consent parameters, and AEM eligibility requirements
  • Handle the multi-market layer — regional MMP configuration, multi-currency revenue handling, and market-specific consent and privacy regimes

    • Sub-function: Measurement

    Measurement maturity is the constraint on scaling. This role owns the roadmap for closing attribution gaps and building toward incrementality-based decision-making.

  • Own the attribution framework — last-click, MECE logic, promo code overlap rules — and ensure it’s consistently applied across reporting, agency data, and leadership updates
  • Define and maintain measurement plans for each product line (spot, perps, rips) including KPI definitions, LTV attribution windows, and what “success” looks like at each funnel stage
  • Lead the build-out of conversion feedback loops for each platform — Google Ads click ID upload pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and Apple SKAN/AdAttributionKit readiness
  • Partner with data science on pLTV model validation, cohort economics tracking, and the eventual transition from CPA to ROAS-based bidding
  • Scope and prioritize incrementality testing (geo holdouts, per-channel lift measurement) and marketing mix modeling as the program matures
  • Maintain reporting credibility — when agency data and Tableau data don’t match, you’re the person who investigates, explains, and fixes it
  • Normalise reporting across currencies and markets so performance is comparable country to country, and so a CAC in one region means the same thing as a CAC in another

    • Requirements:
  • 5+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct ownership of paid UA budgets across Meta, Google, Apple Search, and at least one programmatic partner
  • Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), server-to-server integrations, and ad platform conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Ads S2S)
  • Experience marketing trading or investing products — you understand funding rates, spreads, deposit and withdrawal flows, and why an active trader’s value profile looks different from a casual user’s
  • Track record running paid UA across multiple international markets — localisation, regional channel mix, a multi-time-zone operating rhythm, and market-by-market regulatory nuance
  • Strong working knowledge of attribution models, SKAN/AdAttributionKit, AEM eligibility, and the privacy-era signal landscape
  • Experience managing or closely partnering with a performance creative function — you’ve briefed UGC creators, reviewed ad concepts, and made data-backed creative decisions
  • Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. You’ll be launching multiple products, fixing attribution gaps, and building new measurement infrastructure simultaneously
  • Exceptional communication skills — you can explain a CAPI payload issue to an engineer and a CAC trend to a CMO in the same day
  • Experience in crypto, trading, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred — you’ve marketed a product where the user is putting capital at risk. What matters most is that you’ve scaled paid UA in a high-velocity, multi-product environment

    • Why This Role:
  • You’re joining at an inflection point — new products launching, measurement stack being built, creative pipeline evolving. The person in this seat will shape how all of it comes together
  • You’ll have real ownership across UA, creative, martech, and measurement. This is not a channel manager role — it’s a multi-discipline growth operator role with a clear path to director
  • You’ll work with a small, senior team that moves fast and makes real decisions. No layers of approval — the VP is your skip and the CMO is one level above that
  • Part of Crypto.com — a global platform with the resources and ambition to build a category-defining product, and the speed and autonomy of a startup growth team
  • Global remit — the markets you open and the playbooks you build will define how we scale internationally, not just in one country

title: Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale


Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers.  Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At Nscale, our Legal & Compliance team plays a critical role in driving business success by partnering with stakeholders to anticipate regulatory change, operationalize compliance requirements, and deliver solutions that protect the company while enabling commercial opportunities, to scale confidently, sustainably, and with integrity.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Indirect Procurement will support strategic sourcing and procurement activities across Nscale’s indirect spend categories, helping the business scale efficiently while maintaining strong commercial discipline, supplier governance and cost control.

The role will partner closely with Finance and functional leaders across the organisation to develop category strategies, support or lead supplier negotiations, improve procurement processes and ensure Nscale receives strong commercial value from its third-party spend.

The remit will focus primarily on indirect categories outside of core AI Infrastructure and Data Center equipment procurement.

What You'll Be Doing

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement

  • Support procurement across IT & software, professional services, marketing, HR/recruitment, travel, facilities and other corporate services.
  • Co-create and execute category strategies aligned with business requirements and growth plans.
  • Lead competitive RFP/RFQ processes, supplier selection and commercial negotiations.
  • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, service levels and contract renewals.
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier consolidation and demand optimisation.

Business Partnering

  • Partner with functional leaders to understand requirements, planned expenditure and upcoming procurement needs.
  • Provide commercial challenge to ensure purchasing decisions deliver appropriate value for money.
  • Work closely with Finance to improve visibility of committed and forecast spend and support budget management.
  • Support stakeholders in evaluating suppliers and commercial proposals.

Supplier & Contract Management

  • Manage supplier relationships and establish appropriate performance governance.
  • Monitor supplier performance, pricing, contractual commitments and service levels.
  • Partner with Legal and business owners on contract negotiations, renewals and commercial risk.
  • Maintain visibility of key contract dates and proactively manage renewals.

Procurement Governance & Operations

  • Drive adoption of appropriate purchase requisition, PO and approval processes.
  • Support procurement policies, controls and delegated authority requirements.
  • Improve spend visibility, procurement reporting and supplier data.
  • Support development and optimisation of procurement systems and workflows.
  • Maintain appropriate procurement audit trails and support the wider financial control environment.

Key Categories

  • Technology: SaaS, software licensing, corporate IT and telecoms
  • Professional Services: Consulting, legal, accounting and advisory
  • People: Recruitment agencies, contractors, training and benefits
  • Marketing: Agencies, events, sponsorship and communications
  • Travel: TMC, airlines, hotels and related services
  • Corporate Services: Facilities, workplace, insurance and other indirect spend

Core GPU/AI infrastructure and Data Center construction/equipment procurement would sit outside the role’s primary remit, with collaboration across those procurement teams as required.

About You

  • Significant procurement experience, ideally within a technology, cloud, infrastructure or high-growth international business.
  • Strong experience across multiple indirect procurement categories.
  • Demonstrated success in strategic sourcing, competitive tenders and complex commercial negotiations.
  • Strong understanding of supplier economics, contracts and total cost of ownership.
  • Commercially minded with strong analytical and financial skills.
  • Ability to challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Experience with procurement/P2P platforms such as SAP Ariba or equivalent advantageous.
  • Comfortable operating in a rapidly scaling international organisation.

Measures of Success

  • Sustainable procurement savings and cost avoidance.
  • Increased spend under Procurement management.
  • Improved contract and supplier visibility.
  • Greater use of competitive sourcing.
  • Reduced supplier fragmentation and unnecessary spend.
  • Improved PO and procurement-policy compliance.
  • Strong commercial support to business leaders.

Overall focus: Build a commercially focused indirect procurement capability that enables Nscale to scale efficiently, strengthens control over third-party spend and delivers measurable value across the organization.

What We Can Offer You

  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions will make a real impact.
  • A competitive compensation package (base + equity).
  • A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support.
  • Flexibility: We see you as individuals first, employees second. This approach includes all the expected perks but goes beyond that to offer true flexibility. We’re proud to be a workplace that trusts our Nscalers to excel in their roles while giving you the freedom to shape your day- whether that means fitting in a school drop-off or taking a midday break for a walk with your dog.
  • Hybrid Working: Join our hybrid team, and enjoy the flexibility of self-led remote work, allowing you to create a productive and balanced work-life setup, while staying connected with your global team.

Equal Opportunity


At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range$130,000—$220,000 USD

title: Senior Mechanical Designer
descriptionHtml:

Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production.

You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up.

You bring practical experience turning designs into manufactured products. You understand how CAD decisions affect tooling, part consistency, assembly effort, and cost. You are comfortable discussing details with suppliers and working alongside the people who assemble your designs.

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer - Humanoid Torso
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As a Senior Mechatronics Engineer, you join the early team and own the torso of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. It is where energy, computing and heat come together: the battery, the compute and the E/E backbone, packaged with a cooling system that keeps them within limits through every duty cycle. Working alongside the engineer responsible for torso structure, you own the system - its architecture, package, interfaces and thermal behavior - and you take pride in turning a dense, high-power system into a safe, serviceable and manufacturable product.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Torso System Architecture: Own the system architecture and package of the torso - from layout concepts to production-ready CAD - balancing volume, mass and center of gravity, thermal, EMC, safety and serviceability, and defining the interfaces to the rest of the robot together with the adjacent engineering teams.

  • Battery Integration: Integrate the battery system into the torso, including mounting, impact protection, thermal propagation safeguards, venting and service or swap concepts.

  • Compute & E/E Backbone: Package the compute units and the E/E backbone - power distribution, harnesses, connectors and networking - into one coherent, EMC-robust system.

  • Thermal Management: Own the cooling architecture for battery and compute - from thermal budgets and heat paths to the cooling hardware - and validate it under real duty cycles together with Thermal Simulation.

  • Safety & Validation: Define and drive the verification of the torso system - thermal, electrical, ingress, vibration and abuse testing - in line with the relevant battery and machine safety standards.

  • DFM/DFA Excellence: Design every component for manufacturability and assembly at scale from day one, working closely with the workshop, suppliers and supply chain to eliminate late-stage redesigns.

  • Mentorship & Standards: Establish the organization's standards for system packaging, E/E integration and thermal design, and mentor junior engineers in mechatronic integration best practices.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation - and who think in systems rather than parts.

Must have

  • Experience: 5+ years in mechatronic or system-level product development in automotive (e.g. EV battery systems, central compute, power electronics), robotics, consumer electronics or similar high-tech industries. A proven track record of shipping dense, high-power hardware systems is essential.

  • Mastery of CAD & Packaging: Expert level in CAD, including complex system packaging, harness routing and digital mock-up.

  • Thermal Engineering: Profound understanding of heat transfer and cooling for batteries and high-power electronics - air and liquid cooling, heat sinks, cold plates and thermal interface materials - backed by hands-on testing.

  • Battery Systems: Proven experience integrating lithium-ion battery systems, including mechanical protection, thermal runaway mitigation and the relevant safety and transport standards.

  • E/E Integration: Hands-on experience integrating compute modules, power distribution, harnesses and connectors - including ECAD/MCAD collaboration, grounding, shielding and EMC-aware mechanical design.

  • DFM/DFA Proficiency: Strong command of design for series production, focusing on manufacturing-driven design optimization, parts reduction, assembly-friendly tolerancing and cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) reduction.

  • Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You keep the whole system in view while sweating the details - and you design for the heat, vibration, impacts and dust a robot faces outside a rendering.

Nice to have

  • Thermal Simulation: Hands-on experience with thermal simulation or CFD for quick concept studies.

  • Power Electronics: A good understanding of DC/DC conversion, high-current power paths and their thermal behavior.

  • Functional Safety: Knowledge of functional safety standards (e.g. ISO 13849, IEC 61508, ISO 26262).

  • Electrification & Charging: Experience with charging and docking interfaces or battery swap systems.

  • Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Media Relations Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.

You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.

Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.

What you would do

  • Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.
  • Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.
  • Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.
  • Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.
  • Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.
  • Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.
  • A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.
  • Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.
  • AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.

Nice to have

  • French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.
  • Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.
  • Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.
Germany€71.500—€93.000 EUR

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

You’ll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You’ll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You’ll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK

ESSENTIAL

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance 

  • Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers

  • The ability to collate data and provide support to our Head of Underwriting to enable them to monitor and analyse the portfolio

  • Provide feedback and continuously improve the process for gathering risk information from our clients, in order to ensure frictionless quoting and onboarding for all clients and brokers

  • Identify and surface to our Underwriting Manager areas where we can improve our policy wording and coverage

  • Follow rapidly evolving market trends, continuously refurbishing your knowledge of cutting-edge products and services in the Motor Fleet

  • Actively train and develop members of the Underwriting and operations teams and to help promote Underwriting knowledge across Flock

  • Comfortable using AI in underwriting work, for example extracting and checking risk information or speeding up quoting, while keeping your own judgement on every decision

PREFERABLE

  • Experience in dealing with large corporate customers 

  • ACII qualified or working towards

  • Experience of working closely with product teams to ensure product, process and customer journey enhancements are included within the product roadmap

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

title: Senior Partner Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, in the office 3–4 days a week, with travel across Europe and North America
Regions: UK & Ireland, Nordics, DACH, Benelux, North America
Reports to: Partner GTM Lead

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. People don’t just use Light, they enjoy it.

We’re an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one workflow at a time, you’re in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes.

Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The Role

Partners are central to how Light grows. Accounting firms, advisory practices and implementation partners bring us into deals, deliver alongside us and help finance teams move off legacy ERPs.

As Senior Partner Sales Manager, you’ll own partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue across a portfolio of strategic partners in five regions. You’ll recruit the right partners, build plans with them and turn those relationships into qualified pipeline and closed deals, working hand in hand with our account executives. You’ll work closely with Sales, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, Marketing and Legal.

This is a senior seat in building Light’s partner programme. You’ll own a revenue target, and you’ll help shape how partnerships work here for years to come.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a revenue target for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings across your portfolio

  • Recruit and sign new strategic partners: accounting firms, Big 4 and mid-tier advisory practices, ERP implementers and VC/PE networks

  • Build a joint business plan with each partner, covering target accounts, how you’ll sell together and quarterly pipeline goals

  • Co-sell with partners and our AEs through account mapping, joint prospecting, introductions and deal strategy

  • Negotiate partner commercials with Legal, including referral and rev-share terms, MOUs and reseller agreements

  • Get partner teams confident on Light’s positioning, pricing and demo, including running bootcamps and certification

  • Keep deal registration, attribution and partner data clean in HubSpot, and report pipeline weekly to leadership

  • Build executive relationships inside partner firms and represent Light at partner events and industry forums

  • Bring what you learn from partners and the market back to Product, Marketing and Sales

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: You know Light’s product, pricing and ideal customer, and you’ve met every partner in your portfolio and the AE team in each region.

  • First 90 days: Each priority partner has an agreed joint business plan, the first partner-sourced opportunities are in pipeline, and you’ve signed a new partner.

  • First 12 months: You’ve hit your partner-sourced bookings target, priority partners are delivering a steady flow of qualified opportunities, and partner teams are certified.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Around 7 years in B2B SaaS sales or partnerships, with real time carrying a partner or channel number

  • A track record of hitting partner-sourced revenue targets on mid-market and enterprise deals

  • Existing relationships with accounting, advisory or ERP implementation firms in at least one of our regions

  • Working knowledge of finance software (ERP, accounting, close, spend or FP&A) and how CFOs buy it

  • Confidence negotiating partner agreements and commercial terms

  • Strong CRM discipline in HubSpot or Salesforce, and comfort reporting on pipeline and attribution

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to present with confidence to partner leadership and CFOs

  • A collaborative spirit. You build trust with partners and colleagues alike, and you win as a team.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a finance software company such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday or a modern finance platform

  • A background at a Big 4 or mid-tier accounting firm

  • Experience launching a partner programme or entering a new market

  • German, Dutch or a Nordic language

The Good Stuff

🏢 3–4 days a week in our London office, working alongside a small, sharp team.
💸 Competitive base plus variable pay on partner-sourced revenue.
📈 Equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
✈️ Budget for partner travel and events.
🚀 Define what winning looks like with our partners from the very first deal.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!

Light is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, just let us know.

How To Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a partner relationship you turned into meaningful revenue.

Our process:

  1. A call with the Partner GTM Lead

  2. A meeting with Sales leadership

  3. A partner business plan case study

  4. A final conversation with the leadership team
