title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering.

No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments

Responsibilities

  • Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions.

  • Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes.

  • Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency.

  • Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes.

  • Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation.

  • Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders.

  • Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop.

  • Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices.


Requirements

  • Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries.

  • Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals.

Nice to Have

title: Senior Product Engineer (TypeScript, Full-Stack)
descriptionHtml:
REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We turn hundreds of pages of complex regulations, like MDR and FDA guidance, into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers' development and quality processes.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

About the job

As a Senior Product Engineer, you'll build the product our customers use every day: requirements formulation, document comparison, compliance checks against internal SOPs, and the AI agents that work alongside regulatory and quality experts.

Product thinking is as important here as engineering execution. You'll sit close to customers, product and design, figure out what actually needs to be built, and then build it end to end, from the data model and the backend workflow to the agent and the interface on top.

Because we operate in a highly regulated industry, correctness, traceability and reliability are central to how we build. A feature is done when it works for the customer, not when the ticket is closed.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

We are not looking for someone to just complete tickets. We want an engineer who owns outcomes, challenges assumptions and helps decide what we build.

  • Own product areas end to end. Take a workflow, such as document comparison or compliance checks, and own how well it works for customers: quality, reliability, speed and how it evolves.

  • Shape what gets built. Work with product and domain experts on discovery, challenge requirements, and turn fuzzy customer problems into clear, shippable slices.

  • Build across the stack. Design and ship features across React frontends, TypeScript services, durable workflows and PostgreSQL.

  • Make AI features trustworthy. Build LLM- and agent-driven features that regulatory experts can review, correct and rely on, with the guardrails, evaluation and traceability that requires.

  • Raise the bar. Review designs and code, share context, and help the team ship faster without lowering quality.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript-first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, our own design system

  • Backend and workflows: Express-based services, DBOS for durable workflows

  • Data and storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma, Azure Blob Storage

  • AI: Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks such as Mastra and the Vercel AI SDK

  • Observability: Sentry, Datadog, OpenTelemetry

  • Dev experience: AI-assisted development with Cursor and Claude Code as first-class tools

What you'll bring

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering, with a strong record of shipping product features that real users depend on.

  • Strong TypeScript across the stack: React on the frontend, Node.js services on the backend, and comfort moving between them.

  • Product judgement. You can talk to a user, understand the job they're trying to do, and push back when the requested feature isn't the right answer.

  • Solid data fundamentals: data modelling, migrations and query performance, ideally in PostgreSQL.

  • Experience building on LLMs or agents in production is a strong plus, especially where output quality has to be measured, reviewed or corrected.

  • A high quality bar and a pragmatic mindset. You ship maintainable, well-tested software and use AI tools as leverage without compromising reliability.

  • Ownership. You care whether the thing works for the customer, and you follow it into production.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked on B2B software for complex, document-heavy or regulated domains (MedTech, pharma, legal, finance or similar).

  • Have been an early engineer or founder and owned a product area with little structure around you.

  • Have built review and correction flows for AI output, where experts stay in control.

Why this is a great opportunity

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale.

The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.
We are headquartered in London, with engineering and operations across the UK and Germany. Our investors include Highland Europe, Brookfield, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

 

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product surface on our platform. This spans diagnostics, intake, scheduling, status updates, and communications across web, mobile, messaging, WhatsApp, SMS, chatbot, and voice channels, together with the hand-offs into the operational workflows behind them.


You will sit in the Product team and report to the Head of Product. You will work closely with design, engineering, data, operations, customer teams, and AI specialists to build product experiences that are simple, reliable, and practical to operate.


This is an AI-native product role. We expect you to use agentic prototyping and spec-driven product development as part of your normal workflow, and to judge which models fit a given problem: when a hosted commercial model is the right call, and when privacy, GDPR, or data-residency constraints mean an open-source model in our own cloud environment is better. You do not need to build these systems yourself, but you do need the technical understanding to navigate the trade-offs and direct the work. You will turn user problems into clear specs, define quality gates for AI-powered experiences, and decide when automation is ready for production.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy, Discovery, and Delivery

  • Identify and model the jobs-to-be-done and workflows for users, providers, and operational teams, weighing operational constraints and commercial outcomes, and capture them as clear specs that engineering and design can act on.

  • Prioritise work using product analytics, operational data, support contact drivers, customer commitments, and AI-readiness risk.

  • Own the roadmap for the product suite, spanning diagnostics, scheduling, communications, chatbot, voice-agent, and self-service surfaces.

  • Lead discovery with users, housing providers, customer teams, operations, and internal users.

  • Translate ambiguous service problems into sequenced bets, measurable outcomes, and crisp trade-offs for senior stakeholders.

  • Own go-to-market for customer-facing launches: launch readiness, release sequencing, enablement, and internal and external launch communications with product marketing, customer, and operations teams.

  • Align product, engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, implementation, and support teams around scope, launch readiness, and adoption.

  • Improve user journeys that cross multiple operational systems, including issue classification, contractor availability, scheduling changes, notifications, and case escalation.

  • Measure product outcomes through experiments, cohort analysis, operational metrics, qualitative research, and post-launch reviews.

 

AI-Native Product Development

  • Use agentic prototyping tools to test interaction patterns, conversation flows, scheduling logic, and multimodal diagnostics before committing engineering capacity, deciding whether a problem calls for straightforward automation, a copilot feature, a fully agentic workflow, or a mixture.

  • Define specifications, acceptance criteria, and launch criteria for AI-powered product experiences.

  • Build and own evals for these experiences: define what good output looks like, assemble eval sets that check outputs against the required format and quality, and use the results to improve the solution.

  • Partner with engineering and AI specialists on LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, context management, prompt iteration, model selection, and cost-performance trade-offs.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls for cases where AI confidence, safety risk, or operational complexity requires escalation.

  • Establish quality metrics for chatbots and voice agents, including task completion, containment, hand-off success, latency, retrieval precision, and hallucination rate, and account for how voice agents integrate with telephony and contact-centre tooling.

  • Define the privacy, consent, auditability, and data-handling requirements for customer-facing AI features, especially where personal or sensitive data is involved.

  • Work with Security, Legal, Privacy, and customer stakeholders to agree guardrails for automated decisions, user communications, and autonomous workflows.

 

Requirements

  • Product management experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, workflow, healthtech, proptech, fintech, or another regulated or operational domain.

  • Demonstrable experience building native mobile app products, including ownership of a native iOS or Android app from discovery through release and ongoing iteration.

  • Demonstrable experience shipping AI-powered product features from prototype to production, including controlled rollout and post-launch iteration, ideally across conversational AI, voice agents and telephony, workflow automation, decision support, diagnostics, or intelligent self-service.

  • Strong working knowledge of multimodal models, LLM capabilities and limitations, prompt engineering, tool calling, embeddings, RAG, and AI observability.

  • Fluency with evals: defining what good output looks like, building eval sets to check that outputs meet the required format and quality, and using the results to improve the solution.

  • Hands-on fluency with agentic prototyping and AI-assisted product development tools, such as agentic IDEs and prompt-driven prototyping environments, used to produce testable prototypes.

  • Working knowledge of low-code automation platforms such as n8n, Tray.io, Workato, or Zapier, enough to prototype workflows, scope feasibility, and direct engineering, without owning production builds yourself.

  • Sound understanding of AI risk in production, including hallucination, retrieval failure, automation bias, latency, cost, drift, privacy, and human escalation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across technical, non-technical, and senior stakeholders.

  • High ambition and a strong bias for action, with the drive to deliver a large roadmap at pace and a positive, can-do attitude.

 

Experience and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of customer-facing product surfaces from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, design, data, operations, customer success, and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with products that involve scheduling, logistics, case management, customer support, field operations, regulated workflows, or high-volume service journeys.

  • Located in London and able to work from our London office on a hybrid basis.

  • Right to work in the United Kingdom.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Flexible working environment, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners, and social gatherings

  • Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, and breakfast cereals

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.

Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.

As a Senior Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on important strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to clients at well-known organisations on their product and AI strategies.

  • Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

  • Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

  • Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

  • Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

  • Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

  • Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

  • Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

  • Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

  • Coaching and developing other product managers.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale.

  • You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

  • Strong commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with leaders.

  • You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

  • You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

  • You have demonstrable experience in working with cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development practices and processes.

  • You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

  • You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.

Desirable experience

  • You have meaningful professional services or consulting experience, ideally with large enterprises.

  • You’ve worked in at least one scaled-up, fast-moving product-led organisation, owning significant scope and achieving meaningful impact.

  • You have experience in public speaking about product development and/or product management.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Security Architect - Product & Cloud
descriptionHtml:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

You'll join the Security Engineering Team and will be the Senior Security Architect for Ledger's products, the cloud they run on and the partners built into them, from our consumer apps and services to our enterprise custody platform. You shape how our products are designed, how environments are separated and how secrets and keys are handled, so that security is built in rather than added later.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead threat modelling and design reviews for Ledger's products and services, hands-on: new features, APIs, backend services and the enterprise custody platform.

  • Set the cloud security architecture: account and network design, separation of development, test and production, identity and access, and guardrails for Kubernetes and serverless workloads.

  • Define how secrets, keys and credentials are managed across environments.

  • Design and own the key ceremonies and the processes around them, with the teams that operate our HSMs.

  • Review the path to production with engineering: CI/CD, code signing and release integrity.

  • Assess the Web3 and fintech partners behind the features we deliver to users, such as transaction checks, card, swap and buy/sell: how they protect our users' data and transactions, what we share with them, and what happens if one is compromised.

  • Use offensive security techniques to challenge every design the way an attacker would, and work with the Red Team and external testers to validate it.

  • Turn findings into owned, prioritised engineering work, and track them to closure.

  • Mentor the security engineers and help them grow into architecture work.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in security engineering or architecture, including 5+ years in product or cloud security architecture, and still hands-on.

  • Solid knowledge across the security disciplines: AWS (or another major cloud), networking, endpoints, identity and access management, Kubernetes, and application and API security.

  • Experience designing secrets management and environment separation at scale.

  • Knowledge of offensive security techniques: how attackers move from a test system, a leaked secret or a vulnerable service to production.

  • Understanding of applied cryptography (secure channel protocols, signing schemes, HSM-based flows and key management), ideally gained on custody, signing or payment platforms.

  • Low-level development experience (C or Rust, embedded or secure-element code), enough to read the code running on our custom OS and in our HSMs.

  • Ability to challenge engineering leads, and to be heard.

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

 

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security Operations Analyst to serve as our primary operational anchor for EMEA, bridging follow-the-sun operations across global time zones (APAC and the Americas). In this role, you will analyse security events, investigate potential threats, validate and manage high-priority incidents, and execute decisive containment actions to minimise overall impact while escalating unresolved incidents to security engineering teams.

This person will monitor and remediate security incidents across on-prem, identity, and cloud-based environments for internal corporate infrastructure and enterprise client engagements. As the primary responder on shift during EMEA business hours, you should possess deep operational muscle memory, strong technical composure under pressure, and the initiative to challenge assumptions and propose continuous improvements. This is a remote role from either the UK, Ireland, or Poland. 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead triage, scoping, containment, and eradication for medium-to-high severity security incidents across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud environments.
  • Perform deep-dive investigations, threat isolation, and query hunting leveraging CrowdStrike Falcon (Host Timeline, Real Time Response).
  • Investigate identity compromises, phishing campaigns, and suspicious account activities using Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing).
  • Analyse ingress edge telemetry, CDN traffic patterns, WAF events, and web server logs (including Cloudflare and Acquia application environments) to detect, trace, and mitigate web attacks, DDoS conditions, and botnet/scraping abuse.
  • Maintain and continuously update incident response plans and runbooks for efficient incident response, collaborating with engineering to automate containment workflows.
  • Coordinate cross-departmental remediation tasks and escalate unresolved incidents with clear technical root-cause analysis (RCA) aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Collaborate with content production for security awareness and mentorship.

About You

The essentials:

  • 5+ years of direct experience in Security Operations (SOC), Incident Response, or similar hands-on technical operational roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering/Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep operational experience utilising CrowdStrike (investigation workflows, Host Timeline, Real Time Response, and query hunting).
  • Proven experience leveraging Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing) for phishing, BEC, and identity investigations.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-leading security tools across EDR, SWG, SIEM, and MDM platforms.
  • Solid understanding of network protocols, traffic flow, and the OSI model.
  • Experience with log analysis, malware triage, and digital forensics.
  • Proven track record of operating autonomously during incidents with minimal supervision.
  • Practical experience leveraging AI tools, LLMs, or agentic workflows to assist analysis, scripting, or automation.
  • Working ITIL knowledge and functional familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Courteous, articulate, and educated in interpersonal delivery. Maintains a polite, respectful, and calm demeanor with internal teammates, leadership, and external clients even during incident bridges.
  • Ability to confidently and politely present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-directed, resourceful, and critical thinker with proactive problem-solving instincts.
  • Strong personal anxiety management and self-organisation during high-pressure incidents.
  • Eager to learn, experiment with emerging tooling, and actively suggest process enhancements.

Not a must, but a plus:

  • Demonstrated hands-on and reflexive triage/containment instincts over theoretical knowledge or paper certifications (certifications like CISSP, Sec+, or CEH are welcome, but secondary to proven live-fire execution).
  • Experience analysing Cloudflare edge/WAF logs and Acquia/Drupal web server access logs for application-layer anomalies, scraping, and volumetric spikes.
  • Hands-on experience with modern SIEM / SecOps platforms:
  • Cloud security experience (GCP, AWS, Azure) in production environments.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automated triage and API data collection.
  • Exposure to Blue/Red/Purple team simulation exercises.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team

At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.

What you’ll be doing

  • Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.
  • Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.
  • Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.
  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.
  • Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.
  • Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.
  • Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

We’re excited if you have

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).
  • Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.
  • Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.
  • Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.
  • Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

  • Design and deliver compelling demonstrations that solve customer problems, quantify the value of solving those problems, and tell a clear, credible story of how Synthesia solves them better than anything else.

  • Understand and overcome technical objections and integration concerns; identify blockers early and develop solution paths with customers.

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, designing Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

Product and industry expertise

  • Maintain deep expertise on Synthesia’s platform capabilities across all product lines, roadmap and positioning to highlight value-driving use cases.

  • Develop deep vertical knowledge, establishing yourself as a subject matter expert and building trust with executive buyers.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect product and competitive feedback with pre-sales leadership and Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

  • Enablement: review and enhance enablement content based on what works best in preparing team members for client engagements, and deliver and evaluate certification as needed to accelerate understanding in the commercial team.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering or customer-facing technical experience at SaaS companies.

  • Strong consultative discovery, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both executive decision-makers (CHRO, CLO, Head of L&D, CTO) and technical audiences (IT, security, developers).

  • Technical depth in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations such as LMS, HCM, CRM and identity, security, or compliance) and a willingness to learn quickly across domains.

  • Fluency with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and comfort translating technical requirements into business value and ROI conversations.

  • A problem-solving approach built on gathering requirements, asking clarifying questions and adapting solutions to customer needs.

  • Excellent business and technical presentation skills, in person and remote, and the ability to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple POCs, demos and customer conversations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

  • A collaborative mindset; you thrive working with AEs, Product, Customer Success and other teams to drive customer and company success.

We’d be particularly excited if

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

The role

Physical engineering is one of the hardest domains for AI. Designs have to meet standards, calculations must be deterministic and checkable, and a wrong number can end up in a power system or a data centre. CurieOS is built to let agents do real engineering work and to show exactly how every output was produced.

The platform team builds the foundation that every workflow, agent and product on CurieOS depends on, and runs it in production for people who need to trust it. Your work sets the floor for how reliable our AI is, and the ceiling for what it can do.

This is a small team, and you'll shape what we build as well as how. You'll see the results of those decisions in production within days. If you want a narrow, well-defined slice of a large system, this isn't the role. If you want to own a platform while it scales, it is.

How we work

We build with agents, not just for them. Everyone on the team works with the latest frontier models and coding agents every day, and token budgets won't hold you back. Part of what we build is CurieOS's ability to work on itself: triaging defects, proposing fixes and opening pull requests for engineers to review. So engineers here spend more of their time on design, review and judgement, and less on typing. If you already work this way, you'll feel at home. If you want to see how far it can go, this is the place to find out.

You'll also work alongside our AI researchers, turning cutting-edge research and evals into things that run in the platform and in production.

What you'll work on first

In your first six months you'll work across the parts of CurieOS that customers have to be able to trust. Like everyone on the team you'll touch most of them, and go deepest where your interests take you:

  • Tenancy, isolation and identity. How CurieOS keeps each customer separate, from shared multi-tenant accounts to dedicated single-tenant deployments. That covers data isolation, SSO and access control. You'll also be an engineering voice in customer security reviews.

  • Release and production. How changes get to production safely: release gates, staged rollouts and rollback, automated smoke tests, on-call and incident response. We ship often, and you'll build what lets us keep doing that without breaking what customers rely on.

  • Agent quality in production. Measuring how well agents perform on real customer workflows, working with our researchers to bring the latest evals into the platform, and using those measurements to decide what is good enough to release. A model or prompt change should have to pass the same gate as a code change.

  • Observability and cost. Knowing the platform is healthy and what it costs. That means SLOs, tracing and alerting, plus cost telemetry and usage metering for every workflow and every customer, so we can see where model and compute spend goes and make deliberate choices about it.

  • Infrastructure and deployment. One standard for how CurieOS is deployed, configured and upgraded in each environment, across our own cloud accounts, GPU capacity and customer-dedicated deployments.

Where the platform is going

Once those foundations are solid, there's a lot to shape next:

  • Traceable results. Provenance for every number an agent produces: which inputs, tools, models and versions went into it, so our users can check it and sign it off.

  • Agent runtime and context. How agents plan, call tools, manage context across long-running work and hand off to people at the right moment.

  • Durable workflows. Orchestration that survives failures, retries and runs lasting hours, mixing agent steps with deterministic calculations.

At Staff level, you'd set technical direction across these areas, not just within one. You'd own one of them end to end, run the design reviews that our research and forward deployed teams build on, make the architecture calls that are hard to reverse, and help shape how we hire and grow engineers.

Our stack

Python services on Kubernetes, running on AWS plus specialist GPU clouds for heavy compute. Strong engineers from Go, Kotlin, Java or a comparable stack will pick up the language quickly. What matters more is that you've run real systems in the cloud.

You'll have most of these

  • Designed and built backend services that other teams or customers relied on, and made the key decisions yourself.

  • Owned a system in production after it shipped: the cloud infrastructure it ran on, on-call, incidents, how changes went out, and the monitoring that told you it was healthy.

  • Built and run something where LLMs do real work for real users, and dealt with the cost, latency and quality trade-offs that come with it.

  • Used coding agents heavily in your own work, with opinions on where they help and where they break.

  • Led a project end to end, made trade-offs you can explain, and raised the bar for the engineers around you.

Bonus points

  • Shipped software to external enterprise customers: SSO, tenant isolation, per-customer deployments, security reviews.

  • Run infrastructure as code at scale, or GPU workloads across more than one cloud provider.

  • Helped a system or a company through a scaling phase, such as a platform going from internal use to many external customers.

  • Worked closely with researchers, scientists, engineers or other domain experts and built what they actually needed.

  • For Staff: a track record of setting technical direction beyond your own team, such as architecture other teams adopted, a migration you led across several teams, or engineers you've grown into senior roles.

You don't need a background in materials, chemistry or engineering. You'll pick up the domain from the people who have it.

Why Orbital

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company. We put frontier AI into the making of critical physical products, from advanced materials to data-centre engineering. Our research team works at the cutting edge, from universal interatomic potentials to GPU-native simulation, and we turn that research into tools engineers use every day. CurieOS is the platform that brings it together: the AI operating system the whole company runs on, which customers are starting to depend on for their own engineering work too.

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
descriptionHtml:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team. The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS.


What will your job look like:
  • Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints.
  • Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components.
  • Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.
  • Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
  • Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.
  • Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack.
  • Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware.

    • All you need is:
  • Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work.
  • Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel.
  • Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout.
  • Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch).
  • Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image.
  • Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.
  • Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup.

    • Nice to have:
  • Background in Automotive Software.
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).
  • Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.
    • Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

title: Senior Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Compensation: €60 – €75,000

title: Social Media & External Communication Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own how Agent F and its founder show up in the world: on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, on the blog and in the newsletter, in the press, on podcasts and stages, and in the ecosystem around us. You will create and distribute content every day, run the founder’s profiles, manage relationships with journalists and media makers, and keep the network warm.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

You will work closely with the Online Marketing Manager, who owns paid channels and the funnel. You own the organic, owned and earned side: the brand, the voice, the content and the relationships.

What you will build and own

  • The founder’s presence. Positioning, editorial calendar, drafting and publishing, replies and community. The founder reviews; you run it.

  • The company’s channels. LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, blog, newsletter. One voice, one visual identity, a cadence that does not slip.

  • Daily content. Posts, short videos, articles, visuals. Take one idea and make it work across formats and channels.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. You can show us a channel you grew, a piece that worked and one that did not, and a press placement you earned. You are fast, consistent and allergic to empty posts, and you are comfortable approaching journalists and strangers.

Core experience

  • Daily content production across LinkedIn and at least one video platform, with measurable audience growth.

  • Writing in German and English for a professional audience; editing short video; working with design and AI tools.

  • Running a founder’s or an executive’s public profile.

  • Press and media relations: pitching, placing, maintaining relationships.

  • Community and network management in a B2B context.

  • Reading analytics and adjusting content to what works.

Useful additional experience

Experience in fintech, software or Mittelstand communications; newsletter growth; event and speaking logistics; working with PR agencies; podcast production.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set the editorial rhythm for the founder and the company, get daily publishing running, refresh the channels and the brand assets, and place the first press and podcast appearances around our announcements.

We would look for the daily cadence holding, audience growing in the right segments, engagement rising and the first inbound conversations that trace back to content.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a brand that is consistent and a voice that is credible. Content ships daily, including during launches and travel. Press and public reactions are monitored and answered the same day.

When an announcement, a launch or a public issue needs attention outside normal hours, you are there, you keep the founder informed and you handle it with judgement.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founder on their presence, with the Online Marketing Manager on content and amplification, and with sales on customer stories. You will use AI tools for drafting, editing and analysis and remain responsible for the voice and the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

Start a conversation

Share a channel you grew and three pieces of content you are proud of (at least one of them for a B2B audience). Tell us what worked, what did not and what you would publish for Agent F in your first week.

title: Software Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

The role 

We are looking for a strong Software Development Manager to lead high-impact teams within the PlayStation SDK Developer CPU Toolchain department. 

This role is centred on people leadership and operational excellence, rather than hands-on technical ability. This role requires a balanced leader, someone who can manage high-performing teams, and have a solid understanding of development tools. You will be responsible for supporting and developing the team members, including setting goals and ambitions; supporting and mentoring team members across a range of career levels from graduate to staff software engineer. The role requires working with teams in multiple time zones and may require some travel through the year. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Lead, mentor, and help develop a team of engineers, fostering a positive and collaborative work environment. 
  • Define team member development and career path opportunities with team members and mentor them to achieve goals. 
  • Work together with other groups and teams across different time zones. 
  • Monitor and review team members' performance, deliver regular performance appraisals. 
  • Manage team capacity planning, hiring, onboarding and ensure effective succession planning for your teams. 
  • Recognize challenges, help remove obstacles, and clarify tasks in situations that are not well defined. 

What we are looking for 

  • 3–5+ years of experience managing software development teams. Proven success in people management including mentorship. 
  • Effective leading of multiple Agile teams in software engineering domains. 
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, which encompass presenting to senior leadership, product managers, software engineers, project managers. 
  • Significant experience with software engineering practices, software automation and testing systems (for example, Jenkins). 
  • Enough development tools experience to provide guidance in high-level goal-setting discussions. 
  • A solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and driving reductions in technical debt. 

Nice-to-haves 

  • Solid grasp of Confluence, JIRA (or similar project management tools) and support ticket management frontends. 
  • Prior experience with console or PC game development. 
  • Development and debugging tools experience on Windows and/or Linux. 
  • Experience in low-level languages such as Rust and C++. 
  • Knowledgeable about the Clang for LLVM open-source project (or GNU GCC toolchains).

title: Solutions Integration Architect - Ariba
descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments (ECC, S/4HANA) or procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

descriptionHtml:

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

About the Role:

We're hiring a Product Lead for two of our largest categories - established businesses that serve millions of customers and represent a significant share of company revenue. You will lead a dedicated cross-functional team, owning top-line business growth and a strategic roadmap to achieve results. You’ll own the end to end customer journey: how customers find us, the acquisition funnel, and their experience on treatment.

The core of the job is disciplined, high-velocity experimentation. We’re looking for someone who is systematic about finding those opportunities, rigorous about testing them, and uses learnings to inform the roadmap.

This role also sits inside a broader shift in how our product development organization works. We’ve rebuilt our operating model around AI, and are especially reinventing how AI can drive growth experimentation. This role sits at the center of that.

You Will:

  • Own growth targets, including new customer acquisition and retention
