  • Build and run a continuous experimentation program with cross-functional partners: maintain a prioritized hypothesis backlog, keep multiple tests in flight, define success metrics and guardrails before launch, and hold a high bar on how results are interpreted

  • Improve the end-to-end customer experience across acquisition surfaces, onboarding, checkout and pricing presentation, refills, and long-term subscription retention

  • Communicate the state of the business to leadership and cross-functional partners on a regular cadence through clear written updates on metrics, experiments, and learnings

You Have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including several years in a growth, funnel, or monetization role where you owned business metrics

  • An established practice of working with AI agents in your day-to-day product work, and a clear point of view on what that changes about how teams operate and what products should be

  • Strong communication and a low-ego, high-EQ style. You build alignment, partner well across functions, and bring people with you.Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving environment

title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

 

The opportunity

  • Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

  • Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

  • Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

  • Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

  • Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

  • Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

  • Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

  • Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

 

What you bring

  • You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

  • Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

  • Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

  • Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

  • Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

  • Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

  • Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

  • Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

  

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

title: Sr. Security Risk Management Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s world-class Security Team is growing. As we continue to scale and mature our information technology controls program, we are seeking a senior professional with a strong background in risk management to help build and operate a program designed for enterprise scale.

Kraken is seeking a Senior Risk Analyst to join the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SecGRC) team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Security Risk Management, this role is a key contributor to the execution and maturation of Kraken's Security Risk Management program. You'll conduct rigorous risk assessments, produce high-quality analysis, and help build the operational infrastructure that makes the program run — all in close partnership with program leadership. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact both within Kraken and across the broader industry.

The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, process-minded, and energized by turning ambiguous risk signals into clear, repeatable, and scalable workflows. Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort with iterating quickly is a must. This is a fully remote role.

 

The opportunity

  • Execute security risk assessments end-to-end — scoping, data gathering, analysis, findings documentation, and communicating results to stakeholders — in alignment with program methodology set by leadership

  • Support the development and continuous refinement of risk assessment templates, workflows, and process guides that make the program consistent and scalable

  • Maintain risk registers and ensure identified risks are tracked accurately and progressing through mitigation, remediation, or acceptance workflows

  • Assist in building and maintaining Key Risk Indicators (KRI) tracking and risk reporting outputs, translating raw data into clear, well-structured deliverables for review by senior leadership

  • Partner with technical teams including Vulnerability Management, Application Security, and Blue Team to gather risk-relevant data and incorporate operational findings into assessment work

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate risk processes and bring those recommendations to program leadership for prioritization

  • Contribute to the documentation and upkeep of risk program standards, procedures, and guidance materials

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Compliance, Internal Audit, Engineering, and Legal to ensure risk findings are well-contextualized and properly actioned

  • Support audit preparedness activities and risk-related reporting as directed by program leadership

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in information security risk management, cybersecurity governance, or GRC

  • Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments and owning findings documentation — not just supporting assessments, but running them

  • Strong working knowledge of risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27005, PCI DSS, or DoCRA

  • Demonstrated ability to build repeatable processes — you've taken something ad hoc and made it structured and scalable

  • Strong data analysis skills; able to clean, interpret, and present risk data clearly and accurately

  • Experience contributing to KRI tracking and risk reporting for internal stakeholder audiences

  • Familiarity with GRC tools such as AuditBoard, Archer, OneTrust, or ServiceNow GRC

  • Proficient in Google Workspace; SQL and/or Tableau experience a strong plus

  • Excellent written communication — your deliverables are clear, well-organized, and don't require heavy editing

  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in ambiguity; you take direction well and run with it

  • Bachelor's degree or above in IT, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field

  • CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 credentials a plus; experience in fintech or regulated industries preferred

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view.

We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same.

At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary.

What you'll be doing

  • Ship features end to end: Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence.

  • Author the contracts and the roadmap: Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area.

  • Drive consistency and lead migrations: Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you.

  • Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards: Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria.

  • Own the build and deployment story: Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs.

  • Develop other engineers: Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards.

  • Lead AI-assisted engineering: Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products.

What you'll have

Minimum requirements

  • At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects.

  • The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority.

  • Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team.

  • Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice.

  • Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them.

  • Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching.

  • Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance.

  • Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges.

  • A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow.

Additional or preferred requirements

  • Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams.

  • The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained.

  • Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria.

  • Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale.

  • Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides.

title: Staff Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

Job Description

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.

 

This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it.

At Enpal, you would be:

  • Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team.

  • Setting technical standards. Establish best practices for Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code, and ensure they are adopted consistently across teams.

  • Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.

  • Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.

  • Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.

  • Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.

  • Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.

  • Proven, hands-on expertise with cloud environments and containerized applications (Azure, Kubernetes and more), including designing and operating production-grade clusters.

  • Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tooling, Helm and observability tooling, with the judgment to choose the right approach for a given problem.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, including through code/design review and documentation.

  • Strong system design skills, with the ability to reason about trade-offs in reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Clear communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Knowledge of German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience setting up or scaling platform teams in a fast-growing organization.

  • Deep understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices, including on-call ownership and postmortems.

  • Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.

  • Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (e.g., energy, fintech).

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

Amsterdam - Bij de Volkskrant zijn het hele jaar door op alle deelredacties stagiairs welkom. Journalistiek talent bieden wij een leuke en leerzame periode, van minimaal drie maanden.

Tijdens je stage krijg je volop kansen om in een plezierige werksfeer zelf aan de slag te gaan. Je draait volledig mee op een deelredactie: je schrijft artikelen, helpt mee bij audiovisuele producties of doet ander werk binnen onze journalistieke organisatie.

Deze vacature is bedoeld voor stageplekken van maart tot en met mei 2027. Stuur je sollicitatie voor deze periode uiterlijk woensdag 16 december 2026 in. De weken daarna gebruiken wij voor de selectie van stagiairs. Voor latere stageperiodes kun je al wel solliciteren, maar over de invulling van die plekken nemen we pas later een besluit.

Solliciteren?
Dat kan via de button op de website. Om een goed te kunnen beoordelen of een stage bij de Volkskrant bij je past, vragen we je om het volgende aan te leveren:

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Motivatiebrief

  • Drie Nederlandstalige artikelen of producties van jouw hand. De artikelen of producties hoeven niet daadwerkelijk gepubliceerd te zijn. Voeg deze artikelen integraal of via een url toe onderaan je motivatiebrief.

  • Vergeet niet te vermelden op welke redacties je zou willen werken en in welke periode.


We bieden stages aan op de volgende deelredacties:

  • Binnenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het nieuws uit Nederland.

  • Politieke redactie (in Den Haag): je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten en debatverslagen over de landelijke politiek.

  • Buitenland: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, interviews, profielen of korte analyses over het nieuws uit andere landen.

  • Economie: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, reportages, interviews of korte analyses over het economisch nieuws uit binnen- en buitenland.

  • Wetenschap: je schrijft veel nieuwsberichten, analyses of interviews over het nieuws uit de wetenschappelijke wereld.

  • Data-, osint- en onderzoeksjournalistiek: je schrijft artikelen op basis van data of andere openbare bronnen of werkt mee aan langlopende onderzoeken.

  • V (kunst, cultuur en media): je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de culturele wereld in binnen- en buitenland.

  • Sport: je schrijft nieuwsberichten, analyses, interviews of reportages over het nieuws uit de sportwereld.

  • Visuele redactie: je helpt en denkt mee aan de productie van onderscheidende online verhalen, waarbij tekst samengaat met foto, video en andere verhaalelementen.

  • Video, audio en event: je helpt en denkt mee bij de productie van onze podcasts, video’s en bij de organisatie van live-evenementen van de Volkskrant.

  • Foto / beeldredactie: je helpt en denkt mee bij de keuze van foto’s bij onze nieuwsartikelen en andere verhalen.

  • Digitaal team: je helpt en denkt mee bij de verspreiding van onze artikelen via de mobiele app, website, nieuwsbrieven en pushberichten.


Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat?

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, hebt journalistieke ambitie en affiniteit met de Volkskrant.

  • Voor de verslaggevende redacties: je hebt schrijftalent en -ervaring.

  • Je bent gewend om zelfstandig te werken.

  • Je bent minimaal drie maanden fulltime beschikbaar. Een vierdaagse werkweek is bespreekbaar.

We hebben een voorkeur voor studenten van een hbo-opleiding of een master journalistiek, maar ook anderen zijn van harte welkom om te solliciteren. De Volkskrant streeft een diverse redactie na: we nodigen stagiairs met een biculturele achtergrond nadrukkelijk uit werkervaring bij ons op te doen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een leuke en leerzame periode bij de grootste kwaliteitskrant van Nederland.

  • Intensieve begeleiding door je chef en ervaren redacteuren.

  • De stage duurt in principe drie maanden. Een verlenging is tijdens je stage bespreekbaar.

  • Een stagevergoeding van 400 euro per maand (exclusief een reiskostenvergoeding).

  • Een abonnement op de Volkskrant gedurende je stageperiode.


Vragen?
Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met stagecoördinator Pepijn de Lange via het e-mailadres .

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Role: Imagine selling a solution that will predict for your customers (with an 85% accuracy) who is going to buy, what they’ll buy and when.  As a Strategic Account Executive at 6sense, you’ll be an instrumental player to our growth as we build upon the success we’ve had delivering predictions for enterprises like Cisco, Centrify, Dell, Qlik, and Oracle.  We will trust you to evangelize 6sense, run your business like a CEO, and consistently exceed quarterly and annual targets.  This is not your average start-up; you’ll be closing large deals.  And you’ll be rewarded very well for doing so.

The Fit: We’re looking for hunters who not only have a track record of being the best of the best, closing big deals and passion for fundamentally changing B2B marketing and sales, but can also think critically about driving customer growth and building our sales organization.  This is a unique opportunity to help shape and accelerate our success.

Here are the traits you exhibit;

  • Intrinsic drive to be successful, love to win – You’ll take initiative to figure it out, are motivated to do your absolute best work. (That’s why you’ve ended up at top across your career.)
  • Clear, succinct communicator – Using your customer’s language, you’ll help them clearly understand the value 6sense delivers
  • Technical expertise – You’ll demonstrate and speak to how 6sense drives success
  • Innately curious – You’ll know your buyer, their business, and what 6sense means to their success
  • Empathetic listener – You’ll listen more than you talk. And, you really get what they mean. 
  • Collaborate and win as a team – You’ll compete, but above that you’ll collaborate, you’ll share what is working, you’ll help the team win, you’ll take on projects outside of closing deals.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 7+ years of quota carrying software or technology sales, closing complex sales cycles
  • Consistent track record of over-achieving quota (top 10-20% of company)
  • Experience closing transactions >$250k ACV to line of business executives
  • Experience bringing on net-new logos

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience selling to Enterprise CMOs, VPs Demand Gen, Marketing Operations, Sales leaders
  • Experience closing $1M+ transactions
  • Familiarity with marketing tech stack (Marketo, Eloqua), b2b publishers/media, data providers
  • Strong and demonstrated written and verbal communications skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment
  • 4-year BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong C-level customer references

6sense is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. We will process your personal data for the purposes of the recruitment exercise, which may include assessing your suitability for the role, background, and reference checks, where applicable. Please see our recruitment privacy policy for more information: Recruitment Privacy Notice

Our Benefits: 

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. 

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to  

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the ----- domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

  • Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts

  • Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution

title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Growth Partnerships + New Audiences
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer

About the Team

The EMEA Consumer Strategy & Operations team drives efficient customer growth across Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to help consumers discover the best in their neighborhood and make ordering a trusted, valuable part of everyday life. We identify emerging customer needs and translate them into strategies that attract new customers, deepen engagement, and build lasting loyalty. Ultimately, we champion the consumer at every step—making Deliveroo and Wolt feel local, relevant, and delightful.

About the Role

In this role, you will work cross-functionally with business development, marketing, product, engineering, and design teams to drive growth across growth partnerships and under penetrated audience segments. You will identify, launch and develop growth partnerships across our EMEA markets to acquire and retain new customers. You'll go deep on customer segmentation to identify the next segment of customers we need to win to angle change growth.

You will be responsible and accountable for projects from hypothesis to implementation to results and will get to the lowest level of detail in order to execute on high-impact experiments. The results of your work will accelerate consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement.

You will report into the Director of EMEA Growth, within the broader consumer organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Strategize – Shape our team's strategy and help decide "what we should do next"
  • Build – Design and launch new initiatives from the ground up
  • Analyze – Analyze experiment results to inform business decisions and future experiments
  • Influence – Partner with other teams - Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics - to drive cross-functional and go-to-market execution

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic & Analytical Depth: Significant experience in product, consulting, investment banking, or technology environments with a proven ability to build insight-driven models and solve complex problems.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Strong understanding of how to build trust and drive alignment across diverse senior Commercial and Technology leaders.
  • Complex Project Management: Proven ability to manage large-scale projects from scoping to execution, maintaining momentum across multiple functions and markets.
  • Entrepreneurial Drive: A bias for action and a comfort with ambiguity, with the proactivity to build and iterate where playbooks are still being defined.
  • Structured Communication: Ability to drive clarity through structured, confident communication, translating data into compelling narratives for both upwards and downwards influence.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: System Performance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior, about 3 years of relevant experience

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in active build phase, small, and growing.

The role

You measure, reconstruct and analyze real samples to find out how well our tool performs, and what holds it back. You work between the optics lab, the algorithm team, and our customers' samples, and you become our in-house expert on system performance.

You will:

  • Develop full recipes for new samples: decide what and how to measure, run scans on the lab tools, configure and run reconstructions in our Python/JAX pipeline, and judge the quality of the output

  • Run measurement campaigns on customer samples and report results on repeatability, accuracy against reference data, and throughput

  • Qualify the tool on reference samples, track image-quality KPIs against a baseline, and spot drift before it affects results

  • Investigate when a result does not look right: artifacts, convergence, noise, alignment, or calibration, and trace the cause to the module that owns it

  • Design experiments with the optics and hardware engineers, and feed findings back into the algorithms and the tool design

  • Automate recipes and checks into a single-button-press workflow

Your profile

  • About 3 years of hands-on experience in a technical role (industry, PhD, or equivalent) with imaging, optics, or scientific data analysis

  • Practical experience with computational imaging, for example phase retrieval, coherent diffractive imaging, holography, ptychography, or tomography. You have run reconstructions on real data and interpreted the results

  • You are at home in the lab: you plan measurements, run them, and know what to change to get a better result

  • Strong Python with NumPy. You write reproducible analysis code and maintain a pipeline from data ingest to results

  • A rigorous approach to measurement quality: repeatability, uncertainty, and comparison against a reference

  • You work well with optics, hardware, and software engineers and turn vague questions into repeatable tests

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Experience with metrology or inspection, ideally in the semiconductor industry

  • PyTorch or JAX, GPU computing

  • Numerical optimization (gradient-based methods)

  • Lab automation, HDF5 and large datasets, Linux

We care more about rigor and learning speed than about a perfect match. If you are earlier in your career but have worked with reconstruction data, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the measurement-to-result workflow and the performance of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

  • Funnel Data: Track response rates, conversion by stage, time to fill and offer declines in our ATS, keep the data clean, and use it to show hiring managers where a search is stuck and what to change.

  • Hiring Quality & Manager Accountability: Run and improve our structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs, and hold hiring managers to the standards we agreed on.

  • Recruiting Productivity & AI: Test automation and AI to save time on sourcing, screening prep and candidate communication. Measure time saved and quality kept, not the number of tools deployed.

  • Candidate Experience & Employer Brand: Make every candidate journey sharp and human, from first message to offer, and help leadership and marketing grow ScorePlay’s visibility as an employer.

  • Sourcing Expertise: Proven ability to identify and engage niche talent, with a track record of successful outreach and conversions.

  • Builder Mindset & AI: Curious and hands-on with AI and automation. You try new ways of working and keep what actually makes you faster or better.

  • Collaboration Skills: Strong ability to partner with hiring managers, challenge assumptions, and guide them to sharper decisions.

  • Communication: Fluent English, written and spoken, at a level where you can lead calls and close candidates with ease. French is a plus.

  • Location: Based in Paris or remote from France or UK.

Why ScorePlay?

  • Own the function: you decide how ScorePlay hires, with direct access to the founders and leadership team.

  • Hire internationally: roles across Europe and the US, from engineers to enterprise sellers, for teams spread between Paris and New York.

  • Work on a high bar: quality comes before speed here, and you’re the one who keeps it that way.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable.

At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define.



What you'll do

  • You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to.

  • You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied.

  • With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels.

  • You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard.

  • You'll have the freedom  to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people.

This is for you if

  • You've outgrown your current role and want to build something.

  • You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them.

  • You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear.

  • You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one.

  • Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones.

You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not.

What’s worth knowing

Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites.

So this probably isn't for you if:

  • You want a settled process to run.

  • You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way.

  • You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work.

  • You need a clear path with little ambiguity.

What you'll bring

  • You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted.

  • You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view.

  • You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it.

  • You're fluent in English. German is a plus.

It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way.

How we hire

  • A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron.

  • A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager.

  • A practical exercise: 60 minutes with one of our technical hiring managers, to work through a live role-intake and search calibration meeting to assess how you apply your knowledge, work directly with a key stakeholder and how you get to the most effective outcome together.

**You can also have an informal coffee with the other team members at any point.

Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed.

If you've read this far and you're already thinking about what you'd change first, we'd like to hear from you!

title: Team Lead Data Science – Pricing & Forecasting (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Data department and lead the Data Science team behind rebuy’s dynamic pricing: the people and the roadmap for the forecasting and price elasticity models that steer our high-stakes commercial decisions.

At rebuy, data science isn’t a side project. The models your team builds ship to production and directly shape what we buy, what we sell and at what price. We care about outcomes, not just predictions, and we’re looking for someone who connects commercial priorities with technical execution.

You are a player-coach: you lead from inside the work. Sometimes that means unblocking your team, aligning requirements with Commercial or translating business strategy into clear technical deliverables. Sometimes it means reviewing an architecture, pairing on a tricky modeling problem or shipping code yourself. You set the priorities and the pace, make sure the team’s work reaches production, and keep the quality bar high across our models and pipelines.

Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and grow your team: Manage, mentor and coach a focused team of Senior Data Scientists through regular 1:1s, clear performance expectations and support for their career growth. Build a culture where impact counts more than model accuracy alone

  • Own the roadmap: Work with Commercial and Data leadership to turn commercial goals into an actionable data science roadmap. Own prioritization, capacity planning and sprint execution, and make the call when not everything fits

  • Stay hands-on: Keep engineering and modeling standards high. Take part in architecture design, code reviews, feature research and modeling work alongside your team, and keep shipping code yourself

  • Make sure it works in reality: Design and run A/B tests for new launches, and make sure forecasting models get rigorous offline validation and backtesting before they go live

  • Bridge business and tech: Translate commercial needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business language. Keep stakeholders informed early and build trust in what the models do


Requirements:

  • Substantial experience in data science, including at least 2 years leading or managing data scientists or ML engineers. You’re accountable for results, not only for model quality, and you’re comfortable owning and reporting on the impact of your team’s work

  • A strong quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or similar, or equivalent practical experience), with strong Python and SQL and experience bringing ML models to production

  • Hands-on experience with forecasting and pricing models: classical forecasting, ML (e.g. linear models, LightGBM/XGBoost) and rigorous time-series backtesting. You don’t need to know every method, but you can challenge modeling choices and form an objective view of your team’s work

  • Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, and a solid grasp of causal inference

  • The ability to flex between roadmap discussions with Commercial, sprint planning with your team and debugging a model in a notebook

  • Clear communication of model behavior, uncertainty and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and fast, well-reasoned prioritization when not everything fits

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • German (a big plus)

  • Experience in high-volume e-commerce, retail or marketplaces, ideally in re-commerce or secondary markets

  • Probabilistic/Bayesian modeling (e.g. PyMC)

  • Experience with Snowflake/Snowpark (or Spark), dbt and Airflow; ML workloads on Kubernetes, on a platform run by a dedicated team

  • You use AI coding and research tools in your daily work and help your team do the same

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 1 day per week)

Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin)

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Openup

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

title: Team Lead - Perception
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Perception

Build and lead the team that teaches SE3's autonomous systems to see, and ship perception that holds up on real missions.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Perception Team Lead, you'll own SE3's perception stack end to end: the technical roadmap, the architecture and the core algorithmic decisions behind object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation. You'll hire and grow the team, set the engineering bar and stay hands-on, working closely with our founders and autonomy engineers as systems move from recorded data to field trials. What you build decides how well our platforms understand the world around them in real operations.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Perception Roadmap: Own the technical roadmap for perception, deciding what we build, in which order and how we measure progress.

  • Architecture & Algorithms: Define the architecture of the perception stack and make the core algorithmic decisions across detection, tracking, segmentation and depth.

  • Detection & Tracking: Ship object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data from our autonomous platforms.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Deliver semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a dependable picture of the scene.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team iterates mostly on recorded data, with clear metrics, benchmark datasets and regression tests.

  • Real-World Deployment: Take models from training to onboard compute and field trials, and improve them until they work under real operating conditions.

  • Team Building: Hire the perception team, set the bar for engineering quality and mentor engineers while staying hands-on in the code.

     
 

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of hard technical problems and lead from the front, staying hands-on while setting direction for others.

  • You hold a Ph.D. with 3+ years of industry experience, or an M.Sc. with 6+ years, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • You have a proven record of building perception systems that shipped and worked in the real world, in robotics, autonomous driving, AR/VR, drones or adjacent domains.

  • You bring deep expertise across modern perception, including object detection, tracking, segmentation and depth estimation, and you base architecture decisions on evaluation data.

  • You have led engineering teams, including hiring, setting technical direction and growing people.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS or similar venues.

  • Experience building a team or technical function at an early-stage company.

  • Supervising students or researchers and turning research into product.

  • Deploying models on real-time, resource-constrained compute such as Jetson-class platforms.

  • Field experience with UAVs or other robots that get tested outside the lab.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min): We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  3. Technical Interview (1 hr): We dive into perception systems you have built and shipped, the hardest technical decisions you have made and how you raise the bar for a team.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

descriptionHtml:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with a focus on web applications

We’re more than just a provider of smart emergency watches—we develop technologies that empower people to live independently: We create a world where aging is delightful.

In doing so, we ensure safety and literally save lives. It’s our gateway to improving the lives of older adults, their loved ones, and caregivers—and making the healthcare system more effective. title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now.

The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build.

The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job.

You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel.

What you'll do

Architecture above DATEV

  • Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath.

  • Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck.

  • Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read, never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project.

Reproducibility and control

  • A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers.

  • Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did (version, source, decision) and can sign off on it.

  • Build evaluation on decades of audited, completed work.

Team and scale

  • Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee.

  • Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved. You start hiring in your first quarter.

  • Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review.

Questions you'll answer

  • Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin?

  • How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility?

  • A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not?

What success looks like

  • 6 months: Architecture decided. One real use case from the core business runs in production and is used daily. Your first engineers are hired.

  • 12 months: Several agentic use cases in regular operation. The control layer holds up in a real review, and evaluation runs against closed cases, not test data.

  • 24 months: Automation is a capability of the organization, not of individuals. Every acquired firm runs on the same base, and your team ships without you in the room.

Where it leads: the full CTO mandate, a management career earned by contribution, not by years served.

What you bring

  • You have built something that ran in production and was used by people who did not build it, as founding engineer, engineering lead, technical co-founder or in a comparable role.

  • You have taken agentic systems into production and know where they break.

  • You have integrated against systems that fight back: legacy ERPs, banking backends, badly documented interfaces.

  • You write production code. AI is your everyday tool, and your position on the stack comes from what you built and threw away.

  • You work in German, because our clients and tax advisors do, and you build in person in Munich.

  • You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you.

A plus, not a requirement

  • A regulated field where mistakes have consequences: fintech, banking tech, payments (N26, Trade Republic, Solaris, Klarna, Mollie, Pleo) or software for professional services (Personio, Workato).

  • Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV.

  • No conventional CV required: a technical co-founder of a sold or failed product, or someone who can show publicly what they have built, is explicitly invited. We assess contribution, not labels. The salary range shown refers to the primary profile; a different background starts at a different market price and converges after twelve months of proven performance.

What this role is and what it isn't

  • Building, not managing. You lead engineers and stay in the code. If you want to run managers, this is the wrong role.

  • An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. IT operations, tool rollouts and the product work sit with Operations; what we build and in which order is decided together with management. You own how it is built and run.

  • In person in Munich, not a distributed team. An architecture being decided and a team finding its standards need a shared room.

Why join us

  • Turn our data into the edge. Decades of audited, completed work become the test every agent has to pass before a human sees its result.

  • Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build. One decision of yours reaches several thousand clients from day one, and more with every acquisition.

  • Yours to decide. The architecture and the stack of this layer are open. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater.

  • Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your team exists.

The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Doch unsere Arbeit endet nicht mit der Auslieferung. Wenn bei unseren Kunden technische Fragen auftreten, eine Anlage nicht wie erwartet funktioniert oder ein Serviceeinsatz erforderlich wird, braucht es jemanden, der zuhört, Zusammenhänge versteht und die richtige Lösung auf den Weg bringt.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

  • Du begleitest technische Anliegen so lange, bis für den Kunden eine tragfähige Lösung gefunden wurde.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, lösungsorientiert denkst und gut mit Menschen umgehen kannst, als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

  • Auch als technisch versierter Quereinsteiger solltest du dich bei uns melden.

  • Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge strukturiert erfassen und verständlich erklären.

title: Teilzeitkraft Küche (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Über Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification ist ein innovatives Unternehmen, das mit dem Ziel gegründet wurde, den Übergang zur elektrischen und vernetzten Mobilität zu beschleunigen. Wir entwickeln innovative elektronische Steuergeräte für Elektrofahrzeuge und stationäre Speichersysteme für unsere Kunden weltweit. Unser internationales Team setzt sich aus hochmotivierten und exzellenten Ingenieur: innen zusammen. Als kleines und spezialisiertes Team sind wir uns der Bedeutung jedes/r einzelnen Kolleg: in bewusst und fördern jede/n Mitarbeiter/in nach ihren Fähigkeiten und Bedürfnissen. Unser Büro mit angeschlossenem Prototypen- und Testlabor befindet sich im Herzen von München am Heimeranplatz.

 

Das ist es, wofür wir stehen:

– Technologische Führerschaft: Wir stellen Normen infrage, sind innovativ und antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse. Wir gehen bewusst Risiken ein, lernen aus den Ergebnissen und sind so immer einen Schritt voraus.

– Nachhaltigkeit: Wir treiben aktiv den Wandel für eine nachhaltige Zukunft voran, sind uns unserer Auswirkungen bewusst und inspirieren andere, eine bessere Welt zu schaffen.

- Teamkultur: Wir glauben, dass Arbeit Spaß machen sollte, und fördern einen Geist der Inspiration, des Feierns und der Teamarbeit auf der ganzen Welt.

- Unternehmerischer Geist: Wir sind offen für Veränderungen, denken in großen Dimensionen und gehen mit Leidenschaft an unsere Grenzen.

 

Erfahre mehr über uns auf unserer Website.

 

Deine Rolle

Wir sind ein junges Münchner Unternehmen in der Nähe vom Westpark und essen mittags am liebsten gemeinsam ein frisch zubereitetes, vegetarisches Essen in entspannter Runde. Deshalb suchen wir ab sofort eine motivierte Person, die uns als Teilzeitkraft für 20-30h/Woche in der Küche unterstützt - idealerweise von Montag bis Freitag, bis Donnerstag ist aber auch völlig in Ordnung! Wir haben eine top ausgestattete Küche, einen tolles Küchenteam inkl. Küchenchef, die sich über deine Unterstützung sehr freuen werden. Du unterstützt unseren Chef de Cuisine bei der Essensplanung und die Kolleginnen beim Vorbereiten, Schibbeln, Kochen, Reinigen etc., damit es bei uns Montag bis Freitag leckeres, frisch gekochtes und gesundes Essen für unsere Mitarbeiter gibt. Du bringst das Essen mit unserem Firmenwagen zu unserem zweiten Standort, der nur wenige Minuten entfernt liegt. Anschließend reinigst du den Küchenbereich verantwortungsbewusst und bringst die genutzten Utensilien zurück in unsere Hauptküche an unserem Hauptsitz.

  • Du beteiligst dich bei der wöchentlichen Essensplanung.

  • Du reinigst anschließend gemeinsam mit dem Team den Küchenbereich verantwortungsbewusst.

  • Kreativität, Begeisterung und Enthusiasmus für die Arbeit in der Küche

  • Sinn für Hygiene und Sauberkeit

  • Eigenständiges Arbeiten

  • Teamfähigkeit

  • Kommunikativ, hilfsbereit und freundlich im Umgang, gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse

  • Führerscheinklasse B

Was wir dir bieten

Du hast die Chance, Teil eines hochinnovativen, agilen und einzigartigen Teams zu sein, das mit den renommiertesten Kunden im Automobilsektor zusammenarbeitet. Außerdem kannst du deine Kenntnisse im Bereich der Batterien für vernetzte und elektrische Fahrzeuge, Batteriemanagement und Elektronikentwicklung vertiefen. Das Ganze in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld mit verschiedenen inspirierenden Teamevents. Dich erwartet eine angemessene und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gesundes Mittagessen, sowie täglich frische Snacks.

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment
